hits.title: Planko
hits.description: Planko is a strategy game where you need to make the ball travel from one point to another. By tapping on the targets you can make the planks move by making them fall. Be sure to make sure you make them fall at the right time to ensure you don't miss your chance.
hits.howToPlayText:
Your goal is simple: get the red ball safely to the green target.

Each level is a small physics puzzle made up of balls, planks, platforms, and obstacles. The red ball moves with gravity, but its path is often blocked by other balls.

Tap the removable balls in the correct order to make them disappear. Removing one can change the balance of the level, allowing the red ball to roll, slide, bounce, or fall onto the planks below.

Think before you tap. Removing the wrong ball too early could send the red ball in the wrong direction or make it miss the target completely.

Plan your moves, clear the right obstacles, and use the planks to guide the ball all the way to the finish.

Simple to understand, but each new level introduces a different puzzle to solve.

hits.title: NumMerge Clash
hits.description: A dynamic number puzzle where you connect adjacent cards with matching values. Tap a card to merge it with all neighbors of the same value, increase its worth, and clear space for new cards falling from above. Use energy for tactical moves: swap adjacent cards or remove obstacles. Simple at first glance, this mechanic hides deep strategy: plan your moves, adapt to the shifting board, and chase high scores under limited conditions.
hits.howToPlayText:
Become a Master of Number Combinations!
Your main goal is to achieve the highest score and survive as long as possible. Connect adjacent cards with matching values, increase their worth, and clear space for new cards. The game ends when there are no available moves left and you lack energy for tactical actions. Plan your strategy, watch the upcoming card queue, and use tactical moves to avoid deadlocks!

Left Click on Card: Merge the card with all neighbors of the same value.
Long Press on Card: View card description and properties.
Swap Button: Activate mode to swap two adjacent cards.
Destroy Button: Remove selected card using energy.
“+” Button near Card Queue: Open shop and buy cards with coins.
Mobile Controls:
Tap on Card: Merge the card with all neighbors of the same value.
Long Press on Card: View card description and properties.
Energy Panel: Select swap or destroy mode.
Destroy Button: Remove selected card using energy.
“+” Button near Card Queue: Open shop and buy cards with coins.

hits.title: Parking Journey Car Puzzle
hits.description:
Get ready to test your logic, planning, and parking skills in Parking Journey: Car Puzzle! 🅿️🚘

Your goal is simple: move every car to the parking bay that matches its color. But there’s a catch — the parking lot is crowded, cars block one another, and the correct path is rarely obvious. You’ll need to think ahead, move vehicles out of the way, and create a clear route before the timer runs out. 🧠⏱️

Unlike ordinary parking games, you are in control of the route. Hold a car and draw the path you want it to follow, and the vehicle will drive along that line. You can also tap an available position to move a car using a shorter route. 🚙➡️🅿️

Sometimes the car you need is trapped behind another one. Move blocking cars onto open spaces or even temporarily place them in a different parking bay to create room. A wrong temporary parking spot isn’t necessarily a mistake — clever repositioning is part of the puzzle! 🧩

With 5,000 levels divided across 50 chapters, the challenge keeps growing as new traffic layouts, parking-lot shapes, colors, and tighter time limits are introduced. Every board is designed to be solvable, so there are no impossible dead ends — if your plan goes wrong, rethink your moves and try another route. 🏆

As you progress, you’ll encounter up to six different car colors, making later puzzles much more complex. Different street environments also keep the journey visually fresh while you solve increasingly difficult parking situations. 🚘🟢🔵🟡🔴

Need some help? Use useful boosters when a level gets difficult:

🚘 Valet — automatically parks the next car using a valid solution move.
⏰ Extra Time — adds 60 seconds to the clock.
↩️ Undo — reverse your previous moves all the way back to the beginning of the level.

There’s more waiting outside the parking lot too! Visit the game lobby to collect rewards and enjoy extra activities including a timed reward chest, lucky wheel, jigsaw puzzles, card collection, daily quests, and timed tasks. 🎁🎡🧩

Can you organize the traffic, find the perfect route, and clear every parking lot? 🚗✨
hits.howToPlayText:
Your objective is to park every car in the parking bay that matches its color before time runs out. 🚗🅿️

👆 Select a car by pressing or holding it.
✏️ Draw a route from the car to the place where you want it to move.
🚘 The car will follow the path you created.
🎨 Look at the car's color and find its matching parking bay.
🚧 If another vehicle blocks the way, move that vehicle somewhere else first.
🔄 Use empty spaces to temporarily reposition cars and create a clear path.
🅿️ Move each vehicle into the correct colored parking bay.
⏱️ Keep an eye on the timer — the level must be cleared before time runs out.
↩️ Use Undo if you want to reverse a bad move.
🚘 Use the Valet booster when you need help finding the next correct move.
⏰ Use Extra Time to add another 60 seconds when the clock is running low.
✅ Park all the cars correctly to complete the level and continue your journey.

The key is to plan several moves ahead. Sometimes you need to move the wrong car first so you can free the vehicle you actually need. 🧠🚦

Think carefully, draw the route, clear the traffic, and become the ultimate parking puzzle master! 🚗🅿️🏆

hits.title: Noodle Pull
hits.description:
Master the art of hand pulled noodles in a skill based arcade cooking game where every successful pull doubles your strands.

Hold, watch the tension meter, and release in the green zone.

Serve customers, earn stars and tips, improve recipes, upgrade your kitchen, and unlock chef styles across 30 levels. Know when to serve and when to risk one more pull.
hits.howToPlayText:
Serve each customer enough noodles to earn stars. Collect at least 10 stars during a level to unlock the next one.

Hold the left mouse button anywhere in the play area, or hold Space, to pull the dough.

Release the mouse button or Space when the tension marker reaches the green zone. A successful pull doubles your strands.

Choose Pull Again to risk your current strands and pursue a larger reward.

Choose Serve once you have enough strands to complete the customer’s order.

hits.title: Merge Shoot Run!
hits.description:
MERGE SHOOT RUN is a one-touch runner where your whole squad fires while you steer. You drag left and right to guide a crowd of little shooters down a lane, and they shoot on their own, constantly. Break the towers ahead and the riders on top drop down and run to join you. Steer onto the people scattered along the ground and they fall in behind. Your shooters carry numbers and merge into heavier ones as the crowd grows, so a big crowd is worth far more than the sum of its people.

The decision the game is built around is what your firepower is worth spending on. Gates stand in your path with a number on them, and shooting a gate makes that number climb — run through and you collect whatever you charged it to. But every bullet you put into a gate is a bullet that never reached the tower behind it, and a gate you ignore stays in the red and takes people off you instead. There is no right answer, only the one you can afford.

Crossing the finish line is not the end of it. The horde comes at you, and every attacker that reaches your crowd kills a shooter and cuts your damage with them, so a run you scraped through can still fall apart at the last. Win and you land in a new world — Lagoon, Sunset, Deep, Jade and on — with your winnings and a clean slate, each one its own build-up rather than one endless ramp. Every run pays whether you win or wipe, that cash buys fire rate and start power, and the first wipe of any run is free.
hits.howToPlayText: Drag left/right to steer (the only control — they fire on their own) · steer onto people to pick them up · shoot towers to drop their riders · charge gates by shooting them, then drive through · your shooters merge as the crowd grows · hold the line after the finish · first wipe is free.

hits.title: Jelly Links
hits.description: A jelly-bright take on Sudoku. Every row, every column and every connected line must hold each number exactly once. 1000 puzzles from gentle 4x4 warm-ups to 12x12 boards that really make you think, plus a 500-stage Sandbox. No timer, no lives — just you and the logic.
hits.howToPlayText:
Fill every row, every column and every connected line with the numbers 1 to N, using each number exactly once.

- Tap a bead to change its number. Tap again to cycle.
- Beads with a gold ring are yours to change. The rest are fixed clues.
- Lines are the twist — beads joined by a line form a group of their own, just like a row or a column.
- Pinch with two fingers to zoom in on the bigger boards. (On desktop: mouse wheel over an empty area.)
- Stuck? HINT fills in one bead for you. RESET clears everything you entered and leaves the clues.

Three ways to play
- Tutorial — 3 short boards that teach the line rule.
- Normal — 1000 stages. Boards grow from 4x4 to 12x12 and clues thin out as you go.
- Sandbox — 500 open boards with a single clue. No guidance, just the line structure.

hits.title: Seven Down
hits.description:
Seven Down is a rolling-die puzzle game with a rule you can hold in one sentence: the face touching the ground is your number, and opposite faces always add up to seven — so the number you cannot see is always the one you can work out.

Three games share that die. Puzzle is 60 hand-checked boards plus a daily one that is the same for everybody: reaching the pad is easy, arriving on the face it asks for is the puzzle, and your number is decided entirely by the route you took. Action is 120 stages across six places with something hunting you — gaps, spikes, crumbling tiles, sweeping arms, conveyor belts and turrets, with powers you pick up by landing on the number they ask for. Maze is 60 dark labyrinths where you see only what is near you, and everything you have walked stays uncovered.

Par is never guessed. Every level is proved by a solver before it ships, so the shortest route is always reachable and matching it always means something. Every texture, every piece of music and every board is generated as the game runs, so it works offline and always will.
hits.howToPlayText:
The Number You Can't See

Roll a die across a board — and the number that counts is the face touching the
ground, the one you can never see. Opposite sides of a die always add up to
seven, so the hidden number is always the one you can work out. Three games are
built on that single rule: 60 puzzle boards, 120 chased action stages, and 60
mazes drawn only where you have already been.

Desktop Controls:
↑ ↓ ← → (Arrow keys) or W A S D: Roll the die. In the action stages the die
keeps rolling for as long as you hold the key.
1: Bridge — lay a crossing over a gap.
2: Guard — blunt the spikes.
3: Shield — survive one hit.
C: Change camera.
V: Overview — pull back and see the whole board.
Spacebar: Skip the countdown.
Esc: Menu.

Mobile Controls:
Drag anywhere: Roll the die in that direction.
Tap a power chip: Use bridge, guard or shield.
Everything else is on screen — there is nothing to memorise.

hits.title: Ricoshield
hits.description:
You have no weapon. You have a guard that orbits your core — and everything attacking you is also your only ammunition.

Catch an enemy on your guard and it becomes a bolt fired straight back out, tearing through whatever is behind it. Catch it dead centre, on the white sweet-spot, and you get a PERFECT: a bigger bolt, double combo, and the world slows while the chain reaction plays out.

The catch is that your ammo supply is the thing killing you. Clear the screen and you have nothing left to shoot with. Let it fill up and one missed angle ends the run. Armoured enemies can't be blocked at all — the only way to kill them is a ricochet, so you have to keep threats alive on purpose.

Every 20 seconds you pick one of three upgrades from a pool of seventeen. Every fourth wave a Crucible ring surrounds the arena, and its armour nodes can only be reached by ricochet. Shards from every run unlock six cores that play as genuinely different games, plus three permanent perks.

Every run is ranked. Your ten best are kept side by side so you can see exactly which one you have to beat, and where the platform supports it your score goes onto the global board too. A seeded daily challenge sets a new rule every day — the same seed for every player — and a streak counter rewards coming back for it.

Runs last a couple of minutes. Restarting takes one tap.
hits.howToPlayText:
Move your mouse or drag your finger to aim the guard around your core — it follows the angle of your pointer, so you can hold your thumb anywhere on the screen.

Catch incoming enemies on the guard to deflect them. A deflected enemy becomes a bolt that flies outward and destroys anything it hits.

The white tip in the centre of the guard is the PERFECT zone. Time a deflect there for a stronger bolt and double combo.

Red armoured enemies bounce off your guard and cannot be deflected — kill them with a ricochet from another enemy instead.

Keep your combo alive for a bigger score multiplier. You have three core plates; lose them all and the run ends.

Every run is ranked when it ends. Open RANKS from the game over screen or the pause menu to see the global board and your own ten best runs — the one you just finished is highlighted, so you always know which score to beat next.

Keyboard: A/D, Q/D or arrow keys to turn. 1/2/3 to pick upgrades. Space to restart. Esc to pause.

hits.title: Run from 67
hits.description:
A first-person game of hide-and-seek in a dark school. Find 6 backpacks on each
floor to unlock the seventh door and get out before Sixseven catches you.

He hunts by sound, not by sight. Sprinting carries far, walking half as far,
crouching almost nothing — and if you stand perfectly still, you make no sound
at all. A circle on the minimap shows exactly how far away you can be heard
right now.

Your flashlight both saves and betrays you: you see nothing without it, but
shine it in his face and he charges from across the floor. It runs down fast and
recharges at wall panels. Throw a coin to send the noise somewhere else and slip
past while he investigates.

Seven floors, each with its own light: night blue, emergency green, sodium
orange, ultraviolet, the pool, a fire alarm, and a total blackout.
hits.howToPlayText:
Goal: find 6 backpacks hidden around the floor. Collect them all and the seventh door opens, and that is the exit.

Sixseven hunts by ear. Sprinting is heard from 20 metres, walking from 10, crouching from 4, and standing perfectly still makes no sound at all. The circle on the minimap is how far you can be heard right now. Jumping is quiet; the landing is what gives you away.

The flashlight is a trade. Without it you see nothing, but shine it at Sixseven and he charges from across the floor even if you were silent. The light cone is drawn on the minimap as a second danger zone. The battery lasts about a minute; hold E at a wall panel to refill it.

Coin: press Q to throw one. It clinks where it lands and he goes to investigate. It has its own hearing radius, shown on the map, so you can see exactly where you sent him.

Desktop: WASD to move, mouse to look, Shift to sprint, C to crouch, Space to jump, E to open doors, climb into lockers and hold at charging panels, Q to throw a coin, F for the flashlight, P to pause.

Mobile: left stick to move, pushed fully forward it sprints on its own. Drag on the right side of the screen to look, double tap to jump. The hand button opens doors and lockers, tapping the battery toggles the flashlight, crouch is in the bottom left corner.

Sprinting drains the blue stamina bar, so do not run all the time. A burger permanently raises it, cola gives unlimited sprint for 10 seconds. When he is close, hide in a locker: press E to climb in, Space to get out. Inside he cannot see you even if he walks right past.

hits.title: Mosaicat
hits.description:
Cut the grid into rectangles and uncover the picture hiding underneath.

Uncover the Picture! Every number on the board is the size of the rectangle it
belongs to. A 6 sits inside a rectangle of six squares. Find where that
rectangle goes, and the tiles it covers turn into part of a picture you have
not seen yet.

Draw them one at a time and the picture arrives a piece at a time - a cactus, a
teapot, a small orange cat - built out of the moves you made rather than shown
to you at the end.

There is no timer, there are no lives, and there is nothing to lose. A
rectangle that does not belong is simply refused, and you try another. The game
waits for as long as you want to look at it.

757 puzzles, every one checked by machine to have exactly one solution, so a
board is never a guess. They start small enough to learn on and grow with you.
When you reach the end they come round again as new puzzles on the same
pictures.

Ten colour themes, light and dark. A hint for when a board will not open. And a
cat called Tuna, who turns up when you finish one.
hits.howToPlayText:
The board is covered in tiles, and some of them carry a number. Every number is
the size of the rectangle it belongs to.

1. Find a number and work out where its rectangle can fit. A 6 needs six
   squares: 1x6, 2x3, 3x2 or 6x1.
2. Drag across the grid to draw that rectangle, and release to place it.
3. The tiles it covered turn into part of the hidden picture.
4. Repeat until every square on the board is inside a rectangle.

Rules:
Each rectangle covers exactly one number.
That number is how many squares the rectangle covers.
Rectangles never overlap.
Every square ends up inside one.

A rectangle that does not belong is refused. Nothing is lost and nothing is
counted against you - draw another one.

Stuck? The hint button opens one rectangle for you. You have three, and after
that a short video buys another.

Desktop Controls:
Mouse drag: Hold the left button and drag across the grid to draw a rectangle.
Release: Place the rectangle.
Hint button: Opens one rectangle for you.
Restart button: Clears the board and starts the same puzzle again.
Settings button: Sound, music, and ten colour themes.

Mobile Controls:
Touch drag: Press and drag across the grid to draw a rectangle.
Lift your finger: Place the rectangle.
Hint button: Tap to open one rectangle.

hits.title: Pocket Tile
hits.description:
Pocket Tile is a colorful puzzle game where every placement counts. Place tiles on a 5×5 board and connect three matching numbers and colors. When they glow, choose where to merge them into a higher tile!

Use Clone tiles to copy matching-color numbers and Change Color tiles to recolor a neighbor. Plan ahead, make room, and 

keep your merges going.

Enjoy three ways to play:
- Daily Puzzle: A fresh shared puzzle every day.
- Adventure: Complete tile goals across 50 levels.
- Rank Game: Start with an empty board and compete for a high score.

Simple tap controls, charming cartoon artwork, and satisfying merges make Pocket Tile easy to learn and fun to master.
hits.howToPlayText:
1. Place the current tile in an empty space on the 5×5 board. The Next preview shows what’s coming.
2. Connect three tiles with the same number and color horizontally or vertically. Diagonal tiles don’t connect.
3. Matching tiles glow automatically. Tap any glowing tile to merge the three—the upgraded tile stays where you tap.
4. Three 1s become a 2, three 2s become a 3, and so on. A normal merge scores the new tile’s value.
5. Mint tiles have a circle marker; violet tiles have a diamond. Both number and color must match to merge.
6. Change Color tiles have a paintbrush icon and a neutral background. They switch the pointed neighboring number from mint to violet or vice versa, keeping its value. The Change Color tile is consumed when it activates.
7. Clone tiles become the number they point toward if it matches their color. The original tile stays. Both specials wait if no valid numbered neighbor is present.
8. Keep placing and merging while moves remain. In Adventure, create all the displayed goal tiles and keep them on the board together to complete the level.

Controls: Tap or click tiles and buttons. No keyboard controls are required.

hits.title: Fantasy Soccer Manager
hits.description:
Fantasy Soccer Manager is a lightweight 7-a-side football management game set in a night league where four peoples — Humans, Orcs, Elves and the Undead — settled an ancient war with a fixture list instead of a battlefield. Pick a club from four divisions, build a squad of 13–20 players, and climb from the bottom to the top over a 3-, 5- or 10-season career.

You never control the players directly. Each match plays out as live highlights, and whenever play stops — a corner, a free kick, a goal — the touchline opens: pick which flank to attack, how to build up, change formation or make a substitution. Every people plays differently: Orcs rage when behind, Elves see passes nobody else can, the Undead feel no pain and never age, Humans adapt to any position. Between matches you manage energy, injuries, suspensions, finances, stadium upgrades and four transfer windows a season, while players grow, decline and retire around you.

Win promotion, lift the cups, do the double, and post your career points to the manager leaderboard. 22 achievements, cloud saves and three career slots.
hits.howToPlayText:
GOAL — Finish the campaign you chose (3, 5 or 10 seasons) with the best record you can: promotions, league titles and cup wins. Your career points go to the global leaderboard after every league match.

START — Skip or read the arrival diary, choose a campaign length, then pick a club from Division 1–4. Lower divisions are harder but climb higher.

BEFORE A MATCH — Check the opponent report, set your starting seven and up to two player orders (Finisher, Playmaker, Run in Behind, Focus Play), then kick off.

DURING A MATCH — Watch the highlights. When play stops, a touchline card appears: 
- Pick a side (LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT) — the whole team shifts that way. Attack where the defence is thin or tired.
- Pick a build-up (Wide, Central, Direct, Balanced) — the top option fits the current situation.
- Use Subs (3 per match), Formation and Squads from the top row when needed.
Speed buttons (1× / 2× / 3×) and Highlights / Full view are on the match screen.

BETWEEN MATCHES — Rest tired players, manage injuries and yellow cards, spend prize and gate money on facilities, and sign or release players in the transfer window (to bring one in, send one out first). Save from the league screen; progress also syncs to the cloud.

CONTROLS — Mouse or touch only. Tap or click every button; no keyboard required. Drag to scroll lists.

hits.title: Color Sorting
hits.description:
Color Sort is a puzzle made entirely of colour — not a water sort, and nothing is poured. Each board is one continuous gradient cut into tiles and shuffled. The pinned tiles never move and the corners are what fix the gradient, so every other tile has exactly one place it belongs — you are reading the board, not guessing at it.

Drag a tile onto another to trade them, or tap one tile and then a second. Par is the fewest swaps that can finish the board, and it is computed rather than estimated, so it is a target you can actually beat instead of a grade. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard for 5×4, 7×5, and 9×6 boards, take a hint that is always an optimal swap, and keep personal best and average times for every difficulty.

Colours are generated in OKLab, so an equal step in the gradient looks like an equal step. No board is ever shown unless it stays readable with red and green removed, and a colour-blind palette option in Settings raises that floor further.
hits.howToPlayText:
Desktop and mobile: drag a tile onto another to trade the two, or tap (click) a tile and then a second one.
Pinned tiles never move — they are what fix the gradient.
Undo takes back one swap, Reset returns to the shuffle, Hint plays an optimal swap, New puzzle deals a fresh board.
Goal: put the shuffled gradient back in order until colour flows evenly across the whole board. Par is the fewest swaps that can finish it, and there is no time limit.

Drag shapes onto the board, complete horizontal and vertical lines, and chain consecutive clears to build combos and increase your score. Chase a new high score in endless Classic Mode or progress through 150 handcrafted Adventure levels featuring score targets, collectible objectives, unique layouts, and increasing difficulty. With smooth controls, polished visuals, and satisfying block-clearing effects, Block Blast Master is easy to learn, challenging to master, and perfect for both quick breaks and longer puzzle sessions.
hits.howToPlayText:
Drag and place block shapes on empty spaces on the board. Complete a full horizontal row or vertical column to clear the blocks and earn points. Clear multiple lines at once or keep completing lines with consecutive moves to build combos and increase your score.
In Classic Mode, keep the board open and try to beat your high score. The game ends when none of the available shapes can fit on the board.
In Adventure Mode, complete each level by reaching the target score or collecting the required items.
Desktop Controls:
Left Mouse Button: Hold and drag a block onto the board.
Release Left Mouse Button: Place the block.
Mobile & Tablet Controls:
Touch and Drag: Move a block onto the board.
Release: Place the block.

hits.title: 3D Triple Match
hits.description:
Dive into 3D Triple Match, an addictive and relaxing 3D puzzle matching game designed to test your observation and sorting skills. Find, match, and clear vibrant 3D objects from a messy pile before the timer runs out. Featuring smooth animations, satisfying physics, and hundreds of challenging levels, it is the perfect brain trainer for players of all ages.
Key Features
- Stunning 3D Visuals: High-quality 3D items ranging from toys, food, and animals to everyday household objects.
- Brain-Training Gameplay: Sharpen your memory, focus, and visual recognition with every puzzle.
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: Enjoy seamless offline gameplay whenever you need a quick mental break.
hits.howToPlayText:
- Spot & Tap: Tap on three identical 3D items from the pile to collect them into the bottom tray.
- Match to Clear: Once three identical items are placed in the tray, they merge and disappear automatically.
- Complete the Objective: Clear all target items listed at the top of the screen before the countdown timer hits zero.
- Watch the Tray Limit: Avoid filling up all slots in the bottom collector bar with mismatched items, or the game ends.

hits.title: Draw & Save
hits.description:
🚤 You're the last boat on the beach.

Someone's gone under past the buoys — and the fins are already circling. 🦈

You get one shot. Trace a route across the water with your finger, let go, and watch it happen. No steering. No brakes. No takebacks. ⚡

🦈 Sharks patrol in loops that do not wait for you.
🪨 Rocks don't move. They also don't forgive.
💥 Clip either one and the entire run is gone.

Easy to draw. Brutal to plan.
hits.howToPlayText:
Five steps, then four rules that actually decide runs — and those rules are the part most listings get wrong. I pulled them from the code rather than guessing:

Everyone, or nobody — leave one swimmer and the level fails
All the clocks run at once from release, so a half-empty bar means that swimmer goes first
One touch and you're done — rocks and sharks both sink you and reset the count to zero
Sharks move while you do — draw for where they'll be, not where they are

hits.description:
+1 Pickaxe: Break Blocks 3D — Ready to turn an ordinary pickaxe into a true weapon of destruction? Embark on an exciting 3D adventure where sturdy blocks, valuable rewards, and plenty of upgrade opportunities await you!

Explore diverse zones, mine resources, collect rewards, and unlock new types of pickaxes. The higher your level, the more powerful your gear becomes, and the faster you can take down even the toughest blocks.

Purchase upgrades, unlock new workbenches, and gradually make your way into uncharted territories.

Gain experience, level up, and improve your character’s stats. Unlock additional pickaxes, increase your mining speed, and become stronger.

For your victories, you’ll receive rewards that can be spent on new pickaxes and upgrades. More powerful gear will help you break through sturdy blocks faster and advance to the next zones.

Explore new territories, upgrade your gear, and try to reach the farthest zone!

- Look for Hidden Objects: Drag background items, peel off stickers, or move obstacles to reveal hidden keys or solutions.
- Use Hints Wisely: When completely stuck, tap the lightbulb icon to unlock step-by-step hints to crack the puzzle.

hits.title: Tower Of ASMR
hits.description:
Tower Of ASMR is a cozy 3D parkour climber built entirely around satisfying sound. Every surface reacts under your feet — slime squishes, baked crusts crack apart, giant keyboards click — so climbing feels as good to hear as it does to play.

Climb procedurally coloured towers, tag every checkpoint on the way up, and bounce off speed and jump springs to reach ledges you couldn't otherwise. Each tower is its own world, from the Butter Tower to the Neon Ascent, and the portal at the top opens the next one.

Along the way you collect squishy pets from loot boxes. Squeeze them for coins, and carry up to three at once — they float in a line behind your back while you climb. Spend your coins on more boxes and glowing motion trails, spin the fortune wheel, and pick up daily gifts. Falling never punishes you: you simply drop back to your last checkpoint and keep going.
hits.howToPlayText:
Your goal is to reach the top of the tower. Touch every checkpoint in order on the way up, then step into the portal at the summit to unlock the next world.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, look around with the mouse, jump with Space and sprint with Left Shift. Walk into a ladder to grab it, then move up or down — press Space to jump off. Gamepads and touch controls are supported too: on mobile use the on-screen joystick and buttons.

Press 1–9 or scroll the mouse wheel to select an item from your bag, and left-click to use it. Clicking a pet squeezes it and earns you coins. Q puts the current item away, Tab opens the bag.

Springs give you a temporary speed or jump boost — grab one before a tricky gap. If you fall, you return to your last checkpoint for free, and after three falls in a row you can skip the stage entirely. Use the side buttons to open pet boxes, trails, the fortune wheel and your daily rewards.

hits.title: Go Balloons!
hits.description:
A fairground squirrel sells balloons — until a gust steals them skyward. There’s only one thing left to do: climb after them.

Go Balloons! is an endless pixel wall-runner. Cling to pavilion facades, tap once to leap to the opposite wall, and snatch balloons in mid-air. The higher you go, the faster the pace and the denser the hazards: sticking signs and pigeons eager to knock you off course.

Missing a balloon is safe — only collisions end the run. After each attempt you see height and haul, and your best daily height enters the champions board. Unlock achievement seals and come back for a new record.

Controls stay simple: tap or Space to jump. No combos — just timing, nerve, and another climb. How high can you rise today?
hits.howToPlayText:
1. Press Start at the booth — balloons soar, the squirrel clings to a wall.
2. Tap (or press Space) to leap to the opposite wall.
3. Catch balloons in flight; gold ones are worth more.
4. Dodge ledges and pigeons.
5. After a fall, check height and balloons, beat today's record, and try again.

Goal: maximize height per run. Height feeds the leaderboard; balloons fuel achievements.

hits.title: Snake Out: Maze Escape
hits.description:
Snake Out: Maze Escape is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game where your goal is simple: free every snake and escape the maze.

Slide snakes through tight paths, clear exits in the correct order, and avoid blocking moves. Every level is a handcrafted brain teaser that rewards planning and logic, not fast reactions.

Think Before You Move
This is not a classic snake game.

There are no timers, no pressure, and no reflex tests, just pure maze puzzle solving.

Plan every move carefully.

One wrong slide can trap the entire puzzle.

Each maze has only one correct solution.

hits.title: Deep Drill
hits.description:
Deep Drill Idle is a mining idle game that plays itself. There is no home screen: the page loads and the bit is already turning. Every metre it cuts pays ore, ore is the only thing you spend, and there is no timer, no lives and no way to lose — the well keeps producing while you read the panel, and it keeps paying while the tab is closed.

Twelve rig tracks are what you spend it on: a bigger bit for speed, coolant to cut the rock's hardness, a wider hopper for richness, a night shift that makes coming back tomorrow worth more. Ore is paid per metre rather than per second, so a hard layer is automatically both slower and poorer — and every one of the eight strata is harder and poorer than the one above it. The well decelerates rather than merely slowing, and that wall is the whole point.

When it stops being worth it, seal the well. Depth, ore and every rig level go back to zero, and the deepest point you reached pays out in cores. Twelve permanent core nodes never reset: speed, hardness liners, an old-workings charter that fast-forwards the shallows you have already drilled, a foreman that buys levels for you while you are away. The payout is superlinear, so one deep run always beats two shallow ones.
hits.howToPlayText:
Mouse or touch — the drill descends by itself, so every input is a purchase.
Rig: press a row's price key to buy a level; the mode key switches between Buy x1 and Buy max, which spends the whole affordable ladder at once.
Cores: spend the cores a sealed well paid out on twelve permanent nodes. They survive every future seal.
Surge: x3 ore for eight minutes.
Salvage: seal the well — depth, ore and rig levels reset and your deepest point pays out cores.
Goal: get deeper. There is no time limit and no way to lose, and time offline keeps paying ore within your night shift's window.

hits.title: Picture Shift
hits.description:
One board. A pile of mismatched blocks. A picture hiding inside them.

Somewhere in that mess is a cute little cow. Or a rocket. Or a slice of pizza. It's been torn into pieces and scattered across the grid — and the only way to see it again is to slide those blocks back into place.

Sounds easy. It isn't. 😏

The board is packed. Blocks come as squares, lines, L-bends, T-shapes, zigzags, crosses — and they only slide through gaps big enough to take them. Move the wrong one first and you've boxed yourself in. The real puzzle isn't where things go. It's what order you move them in.

And the timer? Already running.

It stops playing fair fast ❄️ — Ice freezes blocks solid until you clear other pictures. Chains lock them until you deliver a key. Pinned blocks go nowhere. One-way blocks move on one axis only. And bombs 💣 put a live countdown on your board.

Stuck? Spend your way out 🔨 — Freeze Timer (10s), Hammer (knock off a 1×1 chunk), Merge (slam a picture together instantly), Free Movement (slide through everything).

The part that gets you 🔁 — 100 handcrafted levels. Then it just… keeps going. Endless mode shuffles the whole deck and deals forever.
hits.howToPlayText:
🎯 Goal — Rebuild every picture before the timer hits zero. Targets sit at the top; their pieces are scattered across several blocks. Line them up correctly relative to each other and the picture snaps together on its own. They don't have to be in any particular spot on the board — just in the right formation.

🖱️ Controls — Drag a block. That's it. Blocks slide through empty space only. For boosters: tap the booster → tap your target (valid blocks glow).

💀 You lose if the timer runs out or a bomb hits zero. Costs a life — but you can revive on the spot.

🧠 Tips — Think backwards (which block moves last?). Shrink, don't shove (Hammer beats rearranging). Kill bombs early. Chase pictures, not tidiness — every completed picture clears blocks and thaws ice.

5. Return to the room and spend stars on renovations and upgrades.
6. If you run out of energy, wait for it to recover or refill it using an available option.

hits.title: Escape the Monster
hits.description:
You wake up at the bottom of a monster's lair. Fifty floors of maze stand between you and the way out.

Each floor has one exit. Find it before the monster finds you, and don't take too long, because the longer you stay the faster it moves.

Four different monsters live down here and each one hunts a different way. Some chase you, some wait for you, and one walks straight through walls. On the dark floors you can't see any of them coming. You just hear the music change.

Grab gems on your way out. Some doors stay locked until you find the crown. If you're carrying a mask, the next monster to touch you is stunned instead of taking a life.

Clear all fifty floors to escape. Then try Endless mode, where the floors keep going and all that matters is how deep you get.

Gems buy new cloaks, lanterns and masks. Nine of them can't be bought at all, and must be earned.
hits.howToPlayText:
Reach the green door on each floor before the monster catches you. You have three hearts. Every floor you clear takes you one closer to the surface, and every ten floors is a safe floor with no monster on it.

The monster speeds up the longer you stay, so keep moving. Gems you collect buy hearts on the safe floors and unlock new looks between runs. Some floors lock the exit until you find the crown. Some give you a mask that will stun the next monster that touches you instead of costing you a heart.

Clear all fifty floors to escape into the garden. Endless mode unlocks after floor nine and runs forever. Can you climb the leaderboard?

CONTROLS
Arrow keys or WASD to move. ZQSD also works on AZERTY keyboards.
On mobile, swipe anywhere on the maze, or use the on-screen pad when playing upright.
P pauses. M mutes.

hits.title: Fruit Mahjong
hits.description:
Fruit Mahjong is mahjong solitaire with a twist you can see from every angle. Juicy fruit tiles are stacked into layered arrangements in front of an ancient jungle temple — and the match you're hunting for might be sitting on the far side. Drag to orbit the board, spot the pair, clear the stack.

One six-minute clock runs across all 50 levels. Every board you clear buys you ten more seconds, so the deeper you go, the tighter it gets. Match fast to build a combo: each pair in a chain scores more than the last, and the match chime climbs in pitch as your streak grows — break the chain and the multiplier resets.

Boxed in? Burn a hint to clear a pair for you, or shuffle the remaining tiles into a fresh layout. Run out and you can watch a short video to earn another. Your best score is saved, so every run is a chance to beat it.
Tags: mahjong, match, puzzle, solitaire, 3D, fruit, casual, timed, brain
Rules

Clear the board by matching two identical fruit tiles.
A tile can only be taken if it has a clear side. Tiles hemmed in on both left and right, or both front and back, are locked until you clear around them.
Pick a tile, then pick its match. A wrong pair makes both tiles wobble and stay put.
Chain your matches. Land the next pair within about two seconds to keep the combo going — pair one scores 100, the next 200, then 300, and so on.
Watch the clock. You start with 6:00 for the whole run, and each cleared level adds 10 seconds. Hit 0:00 and the run ends.
Hint reveals and clears a matching pair. Shuffle rearranges the tiles still on the board. You get one of each; a short video earns another.
Lost a run? Play Again drops you back on the level you lost, not at the start.
hits.howToPlayText:
Controls

Select a tile — click or tap it. Your pick is shown at the top of the screen.
Rotate the board — drag with the mouse or one finger. It spins a full 360°.
Zoom — mouse wheel, or pinch with two fingers.

hits.title: Island Survival
hits.description:
🏝️ "Island Survival" is a unique blend of match-3, survival, and strategic crafting in a vibrant pixel art style.

🎯 Your goal — complete 6 stages, build a raft, and escape the deserted island. Start with primitive tools, build a house, furnish the interior, smelt ore, create workbenches, and prepare for your sea getaway.

🔄 The key twist: raw resources (stone, wood, food, water, leaves, fire, ore) reset between stages — you can't hoard indefinitely. But everything you craft (ropes, planks, ingots, nails, tools, raft parts) carries over to later stages. This forces you to plan every move: what to craft now, and what to save for later? Your foresight is the key to success!

⚙️ Progression stages: from a campfire and stone knife — to a furnace, workbench, iron tools, and finally raft assembly. Each stage brings new challenges and new recipes.

🚢 Ready to test if you can survive, build a raft, and escape?
hits.howToPlayText:

hits.title: Poofruits: Merge the Fruit
hits.description:
Eleven fruits, from blueberry to watermelon, and every one of them has a face. They blink, squint when something lands on them, beam when they merge, and start to doze off if you leave them alone.

The physics is honest: a dropped fruit rolls, shoves its neighbours and can set off a chain of merges worth far more than you planned. Stacking well beats stacking fast.

Now and then a bomb turns up in the queue. It scatters whatever has settled into a jam and gives a crowded cup a second chance.

There is a leaderboard and a personal best, kept in your Yandex account so it survives a change of device. A run is short, losing costs you nothing, and you will want to start again at once.
hits.howToPlayText:
Drag your finger or the mouse along the top of the screen and the fruit follows. Let go to drop it into the cup.

Two identical fruits that touch become the next one up: blueberry makes a cherry, cherry makes a kumquat, and so on to the watermelon. Merges chain, so one good drop can clear half the cup.

Swipe down to fling the fruit instead. It drives into a tight pile and opens a way through.

Watch the line near the top. If the fruit stays above it, the run is over. Put the big ones at the bottom and leave the small ones room up top, so they have time to find their pair.

The bomb can be dropped like any fruit, or tapped where it lies to set it off.

hits.title: Hexa Sort
hits.description: Hexa Sort is an addictive puzzle-sorting game that combines strategic matching and merging challenges. In this brain teaser, you will get to shuffle, stack, and strategize to create satisfying color matches. Featuring sleek 3D graphics, a dazzling array of vibrant hues, and soothing gameplay, this addictive challenge strikes the perfect balance between excitement and relaxation. Whether you’re seeking a mental workout or a calming escape, Hexa Sort delivers an experience that’s as rewarding as it is visually stunning.
hits.howToPlayText:
Hexa Sort is a captivating and brain-teasing puzzle game that combines strategy with vibrant design. Your mission is to arrange hexagons on a 19-space board by matching their bold primary colors—blue, red, yellow, green, and more. To clear the board, you must place hexagons of the same color close together. Once aligned and unobstructed, they stack automatically with satisfying ASMR-inspired sound effects, but there’s a catch—they must match exactly. The smooth 3D graphics and vibrant palette make every move visually appealing, creating a relaxing yet immersive gameplay experience.

The real challenge lies in the hexagons’ multiple-layered colors, which add a clever layer of complexity. To reveal and match the colors underneath, you must first stack the top layers. This means strategic placement is key; you’ll need to position hexagons near similar colors to ensure cascading matches when the top layers are cleared. It’s a puzzle that requires both foresight and precision and as the stacks build up, so does the satisfaction of mastering each move.

To keep things engaging, Hexa Sort includes exciting power-ups and boosters, giving you the tools to overcome even the trickiest situations. hits.title: Circle Car
hits.description:
Guide cars through busy roundabouts, avoid collisions, and keep traffic flowing! Fast reactions and perfect timing are the key to victory.

Traffic Car Circle is a fast-paced traffic puzzle game.
Tap to guide cars safely into the roundabout.
Avoid crashes, manage the traffic, and beat the clock.
Test your timing and keep the roads moving.


# Traffic Car Circle

Traffic Car Circle is a fast-paced traffic management puzzle game that puts your timing, focus, and decision-making skills to the test. Your mission is simple: guide a continuous stream of cars safely into a busy roundabout without causing collisions. While the controls are easy to learn, mastering the traffic becomes increasingly challenging as more vehicles enter the road.

Tap at the perfect moment to send each car into the circle, carefully watching the flow of traffic. Every successful move keeps the vehicles moving smoothly, but one mistimed tap can create a chain reaction of crashes. Stay alert, react quickly, and keep the roads clear as the pace continues to increase.

Each level introduces faster traffic and greater challenges that require precise timing and smart planning. Race against the clock, improve your high score, and discover how long you can keep the traffic flowing without an accident. Whether you're looking for a quick casual game or a satisfying skill challenge, Traffic Car Circle delivers addictive gameplay that is easy to pick up and difficult to master.

## Features

* Simple one-touch controls
* Addictive traffic management gameplay
* Challenging roundabout puzzles
* Increasing difficulty with faster traffic
* Race against the clock
* Smooth and colorful visuals
* Quick levels perfect for short play sessions
* Improve your timing and reaction speed
* Fun for players of all ages
* Play anytime, anywhere

Can you stay calm under pressure and become the ultimate traffic controller? Jump into Traffic Car Circle and keep every vehicle moving safely!
hits.howToPlayText:
Become the Ultimate Traffic Master!
Step into the high-stakes world of traffic control in Circle Traffic Car! Your main objective is to guide a queue of vehicles into a busy 3D circular intersection without causing a crash. Time your moves with precision to merge every car seamlessly into the moving traffic loop. Pay close attention to vehicle speeds, spacing, and tight timing gaps. Safely merge all queued cars onto the track to clear the level and advance to higher challenges!

How to Win:
- Analyze the Traffic Loop: Observe the speed and rhythm of vehicles already circling the roundabout.
- Time Your Move: Launch the next vehicle at the perfect moment to merge safely into an open gap.
- Avoid Crashes: A single collision will cause a traffic pile-up and fail the level!
- Clear the Queue: Successfully send every car in your queue onto the track to win the level.


Desktop Controls:
- Left Mouse Click / Spacebar / Up Arrow (↑) / W Key: Launch the next car into the traffic loop / Start or retry level.
- Mouse Drag (Click & Drag): Rotate and orbit the 3D camera around the intersection for the best angle.
- Mouse Scroll Wheel: Zoom in and out of the track.

Mobile Controls:
- Tap Screen: Tap anywhere on the screen to launch the next car / Start or retry level.
- One-Finger Drag / Swipe: Drag across the screen to rotate and orbit the 3D camera view.
- Pinch (Two Fingers): Pinch in or out to adjust camera zoom.

There are various locations at your disposal, filled to capacity with structures. The key feature is the possibility of their complete destruction. Using various methods, you can destroy everything you see. Have you ever dreamed of leveling a multi-storey house with your own hands? Now you have such an opportunity! The physics of destruction is close to reality. Use a variety of arsenal to destroy objects, from a hammer to a powerful bazooka.
hits.howToPlayText:
Choose any available location, take everything possible from the arsenal and start destroying everything you see, it is possible to destroy literally anything, have fun.

Control of the game:

WASD - Movement.
Space - Jump.
Esc - Pause.
Mouse - Overview.
Left Shift - Running.
Left mouse button - Shot, throw.
I - Inventory.
M - Map.

hits.title: Bloxorz: Color Block Roll
hits.description:
A rolling-cube puzzle where color is everything. Roll a painted cube to the exit, landing only on tiles that match the face touching the ground. Solve 60 levels of color-matching paths — with platforms that rotate, move, and teleport — in a satisfying test of spatial thinking.
Fans of classics like Bloxorz will feel right at home.
hits.howToPlayText:
Move — WASD or Arrow keys
Move (mouse) — hold the left button and drag in a direction, then release
Move (touch) — swipe in a direction

Move one step at a time. Choose up, down, left, or right to reach the goal.

on-screen controls

hits.title: Round Rush Jam
hits.description: Round Rush Jam is a bright casual puzzle game where every piece can move only in the direction of its arrows. Plan the order of your moves, open escape routes, and clear each hexagonal board before you run out of moves. New obstacles, linked pieces, rotating paths, and useful boosters keep every level fresh and satisfying.
hits.howToPlayText:
Tap or left-click a colored piece to send it along the direction shown by its white arrows. A piece leaves the board only when its path is clear, so move blocking pieces in the right order and use boosters when a puzzle gets tricky. Remove every colored piece before the move counter reaches zero to win the level.

Controls: left mouse button on desktop; tap on mobile and tablet. No keyboard controls are required.

hits.title: Tall Grass
hits.description:
Every blade of tall grass hides something: a shard, a heart or a monster.
Trample it and find out. Cleared tiles reveal how many monsters lurk in the
eight tiles around them, so every step is a read as much as a gamble.

The gate opens before the field is cleared: leave with what you have or push
deeper for the shards and upgrades you'll need when the Pumpking wakes.

No two days play the same. The weather turns over each morning — rain slows
the waking, mist shortens what you can read, frost slows the whole field,
dusk cuts the light — and something is hiding in every field that only a
careful eye will find.

One thumb, one verb, fully turn-based: nothing happens until you move, so
there are no reflexes to fail.
hits.howToPlayText:
Move: Arrow keys or WASD. On mobile, tap a direction or swipe.

Step into tall grass to cut it.
Step into a woken monster to strike it.
A number counts the hidden monsters in the eight tiles around it.

Choose a boon: 1 or 2, or Left and Right
Pause: P
Mute: M
Start or restart: Enter or Space

hits.description: Dancing Road is a fast-paced rhythm runner where you guide a glowing ball along a neon track and match balls of the same color to the beat. Dodge mismatched colors, react to color-changing gates, collect rewards, and master multiple music tracks. Simple one-touch controls, vivid cosmic roads, and music-synced challenges make every run easy to start and hard to perfect.
hits.howToPlayText:
Hold the left mouse button and drag left or right on desktop, or touch and drag on mobile. Guide your ball into balls of the same color and avoid balls of other colors. Color gates change your ball, so look ahead and move to the matching lane. Reach the end of the track, collect rewards, and improve your score to unlock more balls, roads, and songs.

Primary controls: left mouse button and horizontal mouse drag on desktop; touch and horizontal drag on mobile. No keyboard controls are required.

hits.description: Cardivo Adventure is a relaxing card-sorting puzzle game where every card belongs to a themed collection. Move cards between stacks, uncover hidden matches, and organize colorful sets before you run out of moves. Thoughtful level layouts, satisfying animations, useful boosters, and steadily increasing challenges make every round a fresh little adventure.
hits.howToPlayText:
Goal: Sort every card into its matching themed stack to complete the level before you run out of moves.

How to play:
- On desktop, use the left mouse button to select and move cards.
- On mobile and tablet, tap or drag cards with one finger.
- Match cards with the correct category and clear all required cards from the board.
- Use boosters when you need help with a difficult layout.
- Complete the level to unlock the next challenge. If you run out of moves, retry the level and plan a different sequence.

hits.description: Pixel Paint Sort is a captivating puzzle game that blends pixel coloring and tile sorting in one relaxing, satisfying experience. Rearrange colorful tiles, match them with the correct pegs, and gradually reveal beautiful pixel art. Watch the picture come to life with every move, turning a jumbled-up board into a stunning masterpiece!
hits.howToPlayText:
Tap a tile to select its connected group of the same color.
 Move the selected tiles onto matching free pegs.
 Use the tray to temporarily store tiles and plan your next moves.
 Complete every color, and reveal the full pixel picture.
 Finish the level of this sort puzzle by placing every tile on its matching peg.

hits.title: Capybara-HexaSort
hits.description: Capybara Hexa Sort is a relaxing color-sorting puzzle game with a cheerful capybara theme. Place stacks of colorful hexagonal tiles on the board and watch matching top colors merge automatically. Plan every move, complete increasingly challenging level goals, collect rewards, and enjoy a satisfying blend of strategy and cozy visuals.
hits.howToPlayText:
Place a hex tile stack from the bottom tray onto an empty cell on the board. Stacks with matching top colors that touch each other will automatically sort and merge. Keep combining colors to clear tiles and reach the level goal before the board runs out of free cells. Complete the goal to win; if there is no room for another stack, the level is lost.

Mobile: Tap or drag a stack, then release it over an empty board cell.

Desktop: Click and drag with the left mouse button, then release over an empty board cell.

Use the in-game buttons for boosters, pause/settings, sound, music, and haptics.

hits.title: Monster Tile Party
hits.description: Monster Tile Party is a bright, family-friendly triple-tile puzzle game. Pick tiles from a layered board, collect three matching monster tiles, and clear every level before your tray fills up. Cheerful original characters, satisfying match effects, helpful boosters, daily rewards, and a growing level map make every quick round feel like a tiny party.
hits.howToPlayText:
Select an uncovered tile to move it into the tray. When three identical tiles enter the tray, they are removed automatically. Clear all tiles from the board to win the level. If the tray fills before the board is cleared, the level ends. Use Undo, Shuffle, and Extra Slot boosters when you need help.

- Desktop: move the pointer and use the left mouse button to select tiles and UI buttons.
- Mobile: tap tiles and UI buttons with one finger.
- No keyboard controls are required.

hits.description: Coffee Merge House is a cozy merge game where you combine ingredients, prepare increasingly valuable treats, and serve customers their requested orders. Earn coins, upgrade your café, unlock new generators, and expand your collection of delicious creations. Plan your merges carefully, manage the limited board space, and keep your customers happy as your coffee house continues to grow!
hits.howToPlayText:
How to Play Coffee Merge House
The objective of Coffee Merge House is to prepare delicious products, complete customer orders, earn coins, and grow generating and merging items on the board.
Click a generator to create a new product. Each generated item occupies an empty space on the board, so make sure you manage your available slots carefully. If the board becomes crowded, look for matching products that can be combined. Discover more valuable drinks, snacks, and café treats. The further you progress through a merge chain, the more advanced products you will be able to prepare.
Each customer displays the product they would like to order and the number of coins they will pay for it. Once you have created the requested item, drag it from the board directly onto the customer. The order will be completed, you
Keep generating, merging, and serving customers to develop your Coffee Merge House into a thriving café!
Controls
- Left-click or tap a generator to create an item.
- Drag one matching item onto another to merge them.
- Drag a requested product onto a customer to complete their order.
- Click the upgrade button to purchase available improvements.

hits.title: Solitaire 8 Collection
hits.description:
Eight solitaire classics in one collection: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, TriPeaks, Pyramid, Golf, Yukon and Scorpion. No download, no sign-up — the table is dealt before the page finishes loading.

What makes it different: every deal is checked before you see it. Most solitaire games shuffle and hope. This one runs a real solver in the background and deals from verified hands, so the deal you get has a proven way through — and the table tells you when it's guaranteed. Lose anyway? Surrender and watch the winning line play itself out.

And it keeps the deepest record of your play in the genre: win rate with real confidence intervals, your first 50 games against your last 50, a six-month calendar of every session, best times, longest streaks, and your efficiency measured against the computer's own solution.

No ads in the middle of a game. Ever. Unlimited undo, hints that explain why, a daily challenge with streaks and a weekly one across all eight. Card backs and table themes unlocked by playing — never sold. Your progress follows you between devices.
hits.howToPlayText:
The goal — Each solitaire has its own, and the game explains it the first time you open one. In Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Yukon and Scorpion you build the four foundations from Ace to King. In TriPeaks and Golf you clear the table by chaining cards one rank up or down. In Pyramid you remove pairs that add up to thirteen.

Mouse — Click a card and the game sends it where it belongs. Or drag it exactly where you want it. Click the stock pile to deal.

Touch — Tap a card to play it, or drag to place it yourself. Tap the stock to deal.

Keyboard — The whole game is playable without a mouse:
Arrow keys move between cards and piles · Enter or Space picks up, drops or plays the focused card · Z undo · P hint · N new deal · M game menu · Esc closes any panel.

hits.title: FISH FACTORY
hits.description:
FISH FACTORY is a cozy 3D fishing and production tycoon set in a polished voxel world. Explore a large living island and unlock five distinct fishing areas. Complete a collection of 100 fish species: every catch depends on the location, time of day, rod and tackle.

Choose the exact casting point, hit the moving target and carry your catch to the receiving station. Build conveyors, upgrade workshops and open your own fresh-fish shop. Visitors arrive to buy fish, net manipulators gather catches, and a fishing parrot can occasionally bring an extra fish.

Day turns into night, lanterns light up, nocturnal creatures appear in the water, and voxel animals roam the island. Grow at your own pace and turn a small pier into a profitable fishing village.
hits.howToPlayText:
On desktop, move with WASD. Zoom the camera with the mouse wheel or the + and − buttons. Walk to the water, press SPACE, aim at an available spot and confirm the cast. While reeling, click when the moving bar enters the highlighted zone. Land several accurate hits to place the fish in your keepnet.

On mobile, move the fisher with the round joystick, tap the fishing button and choose the casting point with your finger. Use + and − to adjust the camera.

Carry the catch into the bright circle by the receiving station. Fish are automatically placed on an available conveyor, and coins are paid after processing. Use the shop to buy rods, tackle, clothing, workshops, new fishing areas, lanterns and other upgrades. Follow the tutorial to learn the full route from casting to your first rod upgrade. Ads are optional and only provide extra bonuses.

hits.title: Aquarium of Surprises
hits.description:
Aquarium of Surprises is a calm idle game about a small tank. Fish swim on their own and earn coins while you decide what to add next: 10 kinds of fish, 7 plants, 7 decorations and 11 upgrades, each with a clear effect.

Events arrive quietly — coin bubbles, a drifting chest, glass to clean, or one of 6 rare visitors that joins a collection of 16 creatures. Pearls unlock special decorations and 4 aquarium themes.

No timers, no pressure, no forced ads. All graphics are vector, the sound is synthesised in the browser, and the whole game is under 150 KB.
hits.howToPlayText:
Watch the tank: every fish earns coins by itself, there is nothing to click. The top bar shows your coins, income per second, pearls and aquarium level.

Open the Shop to spend coins. Tabs: Fish, Plants, Decor, Upgrades, Themes. Each extra fish of the same kind costs a little more; plants and decorations are bought once. Upgrades raise income, extend the offline reserve and make events more frequent — every card shows the current effect and the next level.

Catch events when they appear: tap coin bubbles, spots on the glass and the drifting chest. A rare visitor must be touched before it swims away to join your collection.

Tasks give three calm goals at a time and pay coins, sometimes a pearl.

Controls: mouse or touch, no keyboard needed. Tapping the water nudges nearby fish aside, Esc closes dialogs. Progress saves automatically and keeps building while you are away.

hits.title: Number Shooter: Ball Blast
hits.description:
Number Shooter is an endless arcade shooter built around one idea: the number on the ball IS your score.

Numbered balls slide in from the walls and bounce around while your cannon fires nonstop. Every hit chips
their number down, and when it reaches zero the ball bursts into two smaller ones — so a single big ball
cascades into a screen full of targets. You never clear a level; the waves just keep coming and getting harder.

Between shots you grab drops that raise your fire rate and damage mid-run, and the coins you collect buy
permanent upgrades, 15 ball themes and 10 cannons that carry over to your next run.
hits.howToPlayText:
Goal: survive as long as you can and score as high as you can. There is no finish line — waves keep coming
and the numbers keep growing. Your run ends the moment a ball touches your cannon.

Controls
- Hold the mouse button (or keep your finger on the screen) to play. Release to pause.
- Move the cannon: drag left and right, or use the Arrow keys (← →) or A / D.
- The cannon fires by itself, so aiming is all about where you stand.

Tips
- Score = the damage you deal. Chipping a big number down earns you every point of it, so you do not have to
  land the final hit to be rewarded.

Objective of the Game

Sort the entire deck into four foundation piles, arranging each suit in ascending order—from ace to king.

How to Play

Cards can be moved by dragging or with a single tap.
Cards are placed in each foundation pile strictly in ascending order within a single suit.
Only a king may be placed on an empty space on the playing field.
Cards on the playing field are arranged in descending order, with colors alternating (for example, a red card one rank lower is placed on a black card).
You can move either a single card or entire sequences, provided they are arranged according to the rules.
Click on the deck to draw a new card.
Once the deck is empty, you can refresh it using the refresh button.

Additional Information

Cards from the “homes” may be returned to the playing field.
Use the undo feature to adjust your strategy.
Bonus points are awarded if you first place a card on the playing field and then send it to a “home.”

Start with simple tutorial puzzles, then progress through 30 increasingly challenging levels featuring overlapping clues, consecutive groups, directional clues, and advanced deduction patterns.

Mouse and touch controls

hits.howToPlayText:
Your goal is to correctly mark every orange hexagon as either blue or black.

A number inside a dark clue cell shows how many adjacent cells are blue.
Use the clues together to identify the correct state of each orange cell.
Mark all required blue cells and eliminate the remaining cells as black.
Complete the puzzle when no orange cells remain.
Controls

Desktop

Left-click: Mark a cell blue
Right-click: Mark a cell black
Click the same cell again: Undo that mark
U or Ctrl + Z: Undo
R: Restart
H: Hint
Esc: Pause

Mobile

Tap: Mark a cell blue
Long-press: Mark a cell black

Some versions may also include separate Blue and Black selection buttons.

Clue Examples
0: None of the neighboring cells are blue.
6: All six neighboring cells are blue.
3: Exactly three neighboring cells are blue.

hits.title: Ragdoll Fighter
hits.description:
Ragdoll Fighter is a fast, funny 2D physics fighting game where every punch, swing, and stumble is driven by ragdoll physics. Drag your fighter around the arena, build up momentum, and slam into your enemies with fists or weapons until their health hits zero — with satisfying slow-motion on every big hit.

Battle through a campaign of hand-crafted levels, take on multiple foes at once, or test your survival skills in Endless Mode against never-ending waves. Earn coins from powerful hits and combos, then unlock a roster of wild characters — a robot, a ninja, a boxer, a spartan, a pirate, an alien, and more — each with its own attack, defense, and control stats. Collect daily rewards, chase 3-star level clears, and become the last ragdoll standing.

Progression & extras:

Unlock characters in the Character Select screen using coins earned in battle — each has different Attack / Defense / Complexity ratings.
Earn coins from weapon hits, combos, daily login rewards, and optional reward videos.
Daily rewards grow bigger the more days you play in a row.
Options: toggle music and sound, and set your preferred control side.

Features:

Hilarious, unpredictable ragdoll physics combat
Campaign levels with a 3-star rating system
Endless survival mode with escalating difficulty
8 unlockable fighters, each with unique stats and weapons
Intuitive one-finger drag controls — easy to learn, tricky to master
Satisfying slow-motion impacts and combo rewards
Plays great in portrait on desktop and mobile browsers

Win the fight:

Level mode: Defeat every opponent to clear the level. Finish fast and keep your health high to earn up to 3 stars. Clear levels to unlock the next ones.

Endless mode: Survive as long as you can — each kill restores a little health and enemies keep getting tougher. Your score is your kill count.

Don't give up: If you fall, you can watch a short video to revive and jump right back into the fight (once per run).
Manage your health: Keep an eye on the HP bar. When it empties, the round is over.
hits.howToPlayText:
Move & attack: Touch and drag anywhere on the screen to steer your ragdoll. Drag toward an enemy to fling your body and weapon into them — the faster and harder you swing, the more damage you deal.

Use weapons: Your fighter automatically favors the weapon nearest to your drag direction. Land weapon hits and headshots for the biggest damage (and extra coins).

Chain combos: Hit the same enemy repeatedly to rack up combos for bonus coins. Big hits briefly slow time so you can line up the next strike.

hits.title: Potion Kitchen
hits.description: Potion Kitchen is a cosy crafting puzzle about running a potion shop at the edge of the market. Guests arrive with orders — one needs a potion of warmth, another a good night's sleep, and some speak in riddles and expect you to work it out. Mix ingredients in the cauldron, brew, and serve before your guest gives up. The recipe book starts empty: all 19 recipes are unlocked by brewing alone, and every one of them can be reasoned out rather than guessed, because the ingredients of a potion share one element.
hits.howToPlayText:
Serve every guest before their patience runs out.

1. Press "Start shift" — the first guest walks up to the counter.
2. Read the order. A direct request names the potion, a riddle describes its effect; the hints below the order narrow it down.
3. Tap an ingredient on the shelf or drag it into the cauldron. It holds two ingredients, or three once upgraded.
4. Press "Brew" and see what came out. An exact match is "Perfect", but any real potion still sells.
5. Press "Serve": the guest pays in coins and reputation, and a new recipe goes straight into the book.
6. Between shifts, spend coins in the shop on kitchen upgrades.

Mouse, touch or keyboard — Space or Enter to brew and serve, C to empty the cauldron, H for a hint, B for the recipe book, P or Esc to pause, M for sound.

hits.title: Basket Sport Stars
hits.description:
Basket Sport Stars brings fast, playful basketball matches to colorful courts filled with unpredictable moments. Choose a character, challenge a computer-controlled rival, or share the keyboard with a friend in local 2-player mode. Move into position, time your jump, aim carefully, and score as many baskets as possible before the final buzzer.

Every match is short enough to start quickly but competitive enough to demand focus. A well-timed shot can put you ahead, while a successful attack may force your opponent to lose possession. With different characters, changing arenas, several game modes, and useful power-ups, no two matches feel exactly the same.

Choose Your Game Mode
Quick Match sends you straight into a 90-second basketball battle. The player with the most points when time runs out wins. It is the best mode for learning the basics or enjoying a fast match without a longer commitment.

Tournament Mode places you into a competitive bracket against several opponents. Win each round, adapt to different characters and courts, and continue advancing until you reach the final match.

Practice Mode gives you room to learn movement, shooting, and attack timing. Use it to test jump shots, understand the aiming guide, and become more comfortable with the controls before entering harder matches.

2 Player Mode lets two players compete locally on the same keyboard. Challenge a friend, fight for possession, and find out who can score more baskets before the buzzer.

Master the Shooting System
Jump to reach the ball, then hold the shooting control to aim toward the opposing basket. A dotted trajectory line shows where the ball is expected to travel. Watch the line closely and release at the right moment for a more accurate attempt.

The aiming indicator briefly turns green when the shot has a strong chance of reaching the hoop. This window does not stay open for long, so successful shooting depends on quick reactions and controlled timing rather than pressing the button as fast as possible.

Attack and Take Possession
Basketball is not only about shooting. When your opponent controls the ball, move close and use the attack button to weaken their grip. After enough successful hits, the rival drops the ball and gives you a chance to take possession.

Attacking without a plan can leave your basket unprotected. Try to pressure the opponent when they are preparing a shot or moving into a dangerous position, then return quickly before they recover.

Collect and Use Gift Boxes
A flying gift box may appear during a match. Jump to collect it and save the reward for the right opportunity. Activating the gift launches a rocket across the court that can stun the opposing player and interrupt their attack.

The rocket can also become a threat when your rival uses one. Watch its direction and jump over it to avoid being stunned. A well-timed gift can change the score, especially during the final seconds of a close match.

Key Features
- Fast arcade-style basketball matches
- Single-player and local 2-player gameplay
- Quick Match, Tournament, Practice, and 2 Player modes
- Competitive 90-second rounds
- Different characters and colorful basketball courts
- Timing-based aiming and shooting system
- Attacks that can force opponents to drop the ball
- Gift boxes with special rocket power-ups
- Simple keyboard controls for both players
- Short matches designed for repeated play

Tips for Beginners
- Start in Practice Mode to learn how long to hold the shooting button.
- Release the ball when the aiming guide gives you a clear trajectory.
- Stay between your opponent and the basket when defending.
- Do not attack constantly; wait until you are close enough to connect.
- Collect gift boxes whenever the court is safe.
- Keep watching the timer during close matches.

Advanced Tips
- Use short jumps to control possession instead of always attempting a shot.
- Attack just before the opponent releases the ball to disrupt their timing.
- Save a rocket gift for a dangerous attack or the final seconds of the match.
- Change your shooting position so the opponent cannot predict every attempt.
- After stealing the ball, create space before aiming at the basket.
- In tournaments, adjust your strategy to each opponent instead of repeating the same moves.

Common Mistakes
- Releasing every shot before the aiming line is properly aligned.
- Standing too close to the opponent while trying to aim.
- Ignoring defense after taking an early lead.
- Using gift rewards immediately without checking the rival's position.
- Chasing the ball and leaving the basket completely open.
- Forgetting that the match can be decided in the final few seconds.

Become the Court Star
Basket Sport Stars combines accessible controls with quick competitive matches, accurate shooting, defensive attacks, and unexpected power-ups. Practice your timing, choose the right moment to challenge your opponent, and work your way through the tournament. Whether you compete against the CPU or face a friend on the same keyboard, every match offers another chance to become the star of the court.

Attack: Down Arrow

courier who has to collect every data chip on the board, unlock the socket they open,
and reach the exit before the timer runs out.

22 hand-built levels, each one testing a different machine: sliding ice floors, force

global leaderboard remembers who runs the chip best. Play it flat in the classic
top-down view or flip to 3D at any time. A full level editor is built in, so you can

WATCH OUT
- Water and fire are fatal unless you are carrying the matching boots.
- Ice slides you until you hit a wall. Force floors push you along their arrows.
- Push a block into water to build a bridge over it.
- Coloured doors need the matching key. Bombs destroy whatever steps on them.
- Monsters walk fixed patrol routes - wait for the gap, then cross.

SCORING
- Each cleared level is worth its number x 500, plus 10 points for every second
  left on the clock. Beat your best time to raise your total on the leaderboard.

hits.title: The long way home
hits.description:
Your ship is gone. You are a very long way from Earth, with a suit, a tank of fuel, and the air in your lungs.

The Long Way Home is a game about thrust being precious and drift being free. Every burn spends fuel you may never replace, so the fastest route is rarely the straight one. Swing past a planet and let its gravity throw you onward for nothing, and keep the fuel for the moment you actually need it.

Between you and home: abandoned supply stations, each holding one decisive resupply. Sealed containers you can crack open if you have the patience. Debris fields that will shred you at speed and let you pass at a crawl.

VESTA, the assistance unit strapped to your chest, talks you through it. She is a machine and says so, and she will tell you when your heading is wrong.

Get to Earth before the oxygen runs out. Then do it again, carrying cargo.
hits.howToPlayText: Everything is also an on-screen button, so it plays with a mouse, a keyboard or a touchscreen. DRAG anywhere to look around and aim. ENGINE or SPACE burns the main thruster — short taps, fuel is finite. STOP or X flips you around and burns retrograde; it is the only way to slow down out here. DRIFT or Z lays you flat along your heading, which streamlines you and lets you sidestep rock. ION DRIVE or V is a weak electric thrust that runs on battery instead of fuel. SCAN or F lights up nearby supplies and charts debris fields onto your map. REPAIR or T patches the suit. TAB, or a tap on the small map, opens the planning map — pick a destination there and your scanner becomes a compass. The AIM ONLY / HOLD = THRUST switch changes whether dragging also fires the engine.

hits.title: Fortress Clash
hits.description:
Fixed the reported issue: progress was not restored after a reload.

Root cause: bridge.storage.get() returns the saved value already parsed as an object, while the game expected a JSON string and parsed it again, which threw and silently discarded the save.

Changes:
- storage.get() now accepts both shapes (object and string).
- The save is loaded BEFORE gameplay is shown: a loading screen is displayed and input is ignored until storage.get() resolves, so a fresh default save can no longer overwrite real progress during startup.
- Saves carry a revision counter, so after "finish a level, then buy an upgrade" the newest copy always wins instead of an older one at the same level.
- Any pending write is flushed on page hide / unload, so the last action before a reload is never lost.

Verified in the QA tool: state written before Reload game is fully restored after it.

Mouse / touch: tap a lane shield to spawn
Inventory buttons: use Shield, Bomb, or Freeze during a wave
Continue: after a win
Soft Retry (watch an ad for an easier wave) or Back: after a defeat

3D Chess - Arcane Edition brings the classic strategy game to life with stunning 3D visuals, hand-crafted copper and gold pieces, and an immersive fairytale atmosphere. Challenge spirits across three difficulty levels — from casual fun to a serious test of skill.
