hits.howToPlayText:
Tap a piece to select it, then tap a highlighted square to move. The glowing dots show your legal moves. Capture enemy pieces by moving onto their square. Put the opponent's king in checkmate to win.

Controls:

Tap/click a piece to select it.
Tap/click a highlighted square to move.
Drag to rotate the camera around the board.
Pinch or scroll to zoom in/out.
Use the Hint button (lightbulb) to reveal the best move (3 per game, watch a short ad).
Access Settings (gear icon) to change difficulty, toggle move hints, or mute audio.

FAQ's:

1: How do I play against a friend in 3D Chess - Arcane Edition? 
Tap "Play a Friend" on the landing screen to create a private room, then share the room code. The other person can open the link and play as the other colour.

2: Do I need an account to play? 
No. There's no login and no database — just pick a name, play, and close the tab when you're done. Multiplayer rooms are temporary: once everyone leaves, the game and its history are gone for good.

3: How strong is the computer opponent? 
3D Chess - Arcane Chess runs Stockfish, one of the strongest chess engines in the world, directly in your browser. You can set it to Easy, Medium, or Hard from the settings before or during a solo game.

4: Can I get a hint if I'm stuck? 
Yes — the lightbulb button offers up to 3 hints per game (with a short cooldown between uses), highlighting the engine's recommended move. In solo mode this is a rewarded feature.

5: Does 3D Chess - Arcane Edition work on mobile? 
Yes. Pieces can be tapped or dragged with touch, the camera automatically adapts the board framing to phone screens, and the game rotates itself into a landscape layout on upright phones so the board isn't cramped in portrait.

hits.description:
Block Bloom is a colorful puzzle-shooter about smart timing and sharper planning.

A conveyor belt carries a stream of colored blocks across the board. Below it sits your grid of shooters — each one loaded with a color and a limited number of shots. Tap a shooter to send it into a firing slot, and it will automatically blast every matching block that rolls past.

The catch: you only have a handful of slots. Send in the wrong shooter and it sits there, clogging a slot with nothing to shoot. Fill every slot with dead weight and the board jams — game over. Clear the whole conveyor and the level is yours.
hits.howToPlayText:
Watch the conveyor. Colored blocks ride the belt across the top of the board.
Tap a shooter in the grid below. A shooter is only tappable when nothing is blocking it.
It slides into a free slot and starts firing automatically at every block on the belt that matches its color.
Mind your shot counter. Each shooter has limited ammo. When it runs dry, it disappears and frees its slot.
Keep your slots healthy. Slots are limited — a shooter whose color isn't on the belt just sits there taking up space.
Clear every block on the conveyor to win the level.

hits.title: 3D Pyramid Maze
hits.description:
A 3D maze that IS a mountain. Roll a glowing ball up a stepped square
pyramid, climbing terrace by terrace from the base edge to the golden
summit — the maze wraps all four faces, so solving it and climbing it
are the same act.

A red chaser hunts you through the same open corridors you use. It
paths as freely as you do, and catching you sends you back down the
mountain. Gold coins are scattered across all four sides, most of them
off the safe route, so every detour is a gamble.

25 hand-tuned pyramids, an overview map, a daily challenge, and four
hand-lit looks that run from desert sunrise to starlit night — three
of them unlocked by exploring, alongside ten cosmetic rewards that
never expire. Pull the camera back at any moment and the whole pyramid
frames itself.

Not in the mood for a chase? The comfort settings are free and always
available: slow the chaser, keep your progress when caught, or switch
the chase off entirely and just climb.
hits.howToPlayText:
GOAL
Enter at the green START in the middle of a base edge and work inward
and upward to the golden SUMMIT at the centre. Reach it to clear the
level — you're carried straight into the next one.

MOVE
Arrow keys or WASD, or the orange arrows at the bottom left on touch.
Movement is relative to the screen, and holds the direction you
pressed until you release.

CAMERA
Drag the maze to turn it, or tap the two curved buttons at the bottom
right to snap 45° at a time — handy for lining up square with a
corridor. Q and E do the same on a keyboard. Pinch or scroll to zoom,
or press + and −. Right-drag with a mouse, or drag with two fingers,
to lean the view off the ball and peek around a corner; it springs
back as soon as you move. Zoom right out and the view re-aims itself
to frame the whole pyramid. The view never turns on its own.

MAP
Press M or tap the map icon for an overview showing you, the chaser,
the summit and any coins still out there. The game pauses while it's
open. Esc closes it. The route isn't on it — that's what Hint is for.

HINT
Opens that same map with the full route drawn on it, then leaves the
route glowing on the floor for a few seconds after you close it. Where
the platform supports it this is paid for by watching a short rewarded
video, and the button says so before you press it.

THE CHASER
A red ball hunts you through every corridor you can use, and gets
quicker as the levels climb. Catching you sends you back to the start
of the level.

COINS AND REWARDS
Roll into a coin or tap it to collect. Coins unlock ten cosmetic
rewards — ball colours, trails, an aura ring, extra themes — earned
purely by exploring. They never expire, and nothing you do can take
one away.

COMFORT — free, always available
Zen switches the chaser off completely so you can explore at your own
pace; times aren't recorded while it's on. Gentle keeps the chaser but
slows it by about a third. Checkpoint restarts you at the highest
terrace you reached instead of all the way back at the base. Turn any
of them on or off whenever you like — there's nothing to earn first.

OTHER CONTROLS
Menu (☰) holds levels, saves, themes and settings. Daily takes you to
today's featured level. Restart puts the ball back at the start of the
current level; it asks first, and your coins and unlocked levels are
untouched.

hits.title: Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle
hits.description:
Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle combines colorful region puzzles with simple but challenging placement rules. Your goal is to place exactly one cat inside every colored territory while making sure no two cats share the same row or column.

Cats also need their personal space. They cannot touch each other diagonally, even at the corners. Every placement affects the entire board, so careful observation and logical thinking are essential.

The puzzles begin gently, allowing you to understand the rules and develop your strategy. As you progress, the boards become more challenging and require deeper planning. Every cat must be placed for a clear reason, because random guesses can quickly lead to mistakes.

Wrong moves cost hearts, so take your time and study the grid before tapping. Eliminate impossible spaces, compare colored regions, and use row and column restrictions to discover the correct solution.

Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle is perfect for players who enjoy Sudoku, logic grids, brain teasers, and relaxing puzzle games. Its simple controls and adorable cat theme make every challenge easy to start but satisfying to master.

How to Play
Place One Cat in Every Region

Each colored territory must contain exactly one cat. Leaving a region empty or placing multiple cats inside it will prevent you from completing the puzzle.

Avoid Matching Rows and Columns

No two cats can appear in the same horizontal row or vertical column. A placed cat blocks every other space along both lines.

Keep Cats Apart

Cats cannot touch diagonally. Even if two cats only meet at their corners, the placement is not allowed.

Protect Your Hearts

Incorrect taps reduce your available hearts. Think carefully, use logic, and avoid guessing whenever possible.

Features
Relaxing cat-themed logic puzzles
One cat required in every colored region
Row and column exclusion rules
Diagonal placement restrictions
Heart-based mistake system
Simple tap controls
Increasing puzzle difficulty
Clean and colorful visuals
Short levels for quick play sessions
Brain training through logical deduction
Easy to understand and challenging to master

Study every region, find the safest spaces, and place all the cats correctly in Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle.
hits.howToPlayText:
Rule 1 Place one cat in each colored region Every territory needs exactly one cat. Empty regions are incomplete, and two cats in one region break the puzzle. 

Rule 2 Avoid same rows and columns A placed cat controls its entire row and column, so no other cat can share either line.

Rule 3 Do not let cats touch Cats also cannot touch diagonally. Corner contact is a conflict. 

Rule 4 Protect your hearts Wrong taps cost hearts, so every placement should come from logic instead of guessing.

hits.title: Slope 3D
hits.description:
Slope 3D sends you down a steep neon track where quick reactions and precise movement decide how long your run will last. Guide the rolling ball through narrow platforms, sharp turns, sudden drops, and dangerous red obstacles while the speed continues to increase. The controls are simple to learn, but staying on the course becomes harder with every passing second.

Game Overview
Your objective in Slope 3D is to keep the ball on the track for as long as possible and achieve the highest score. The ball rolls forward automatically, leaving you responsible for steering it away from barriers, gaps, and the edges of the platform.

The slope changes constantly as you progress. Wide paths can quickly become narrow lanes, while sudden turns and uneven platforms force you to adjust your position without losing control. Red blocks are especially dangerous because touching one ends the current run immediately.

Speed is one of the biggest challenges. The farther you travel, the faster the ball moves, giving you less time to react to what appears ahead. A small steering mistake that seems harmless early in the run can send the ball off the track once the pace increases.

Key Features
- Fast-paced 3D endless runner gameplay
- Futuristic neon environment
- Simple left-and-right steering controls
- Increasing speed and difficulty
- Narrow tracks, sharp turns, and sudden gaps
- Dangerous red obstacles to avoid
- Score-based progression with no fixed finish line
- Keyboard controls for desktop players 
- Swipe and tilt controls for mobile devices
- Quick rounds designed for repeated high-score attempts

Tips for Beginners
- Use short taps instead of holding a direction for too long.
- Try to keep the ball near the center of the track.
- Look ahead rather than focusing only on the ball.
- Begin steering before reaching sharp turns.
- Avoid unnecessary movement on narrow platforms.

Advanced Tips
- Plan your position based on the next section of the course.
- Use gentle corrections when the ball reaches higher speeds.
- Enter narrow paths from the center whenever possible.
- Move early when several obstacles appear close together.
- Stay calm after sudden drops and regain control gradually.

Common Mistakes
- Making large steering movements at high speed.
- Waiting until the last moment to avoid an obstacle.
- Staying too close to the edge of the platform.
- Watching the current position instead of the upcoming track.
- Trying to correct one mistake with another sudden turn.

Slope 3D game turns a simple steering mechanic into a demanding test of focus, balance, and reflexes. Its endless course means every run offers another opportunity to travel farther and improve your score. Stay centered, react smoothly, and see how long you can survive as the neon slope becomes faster and more difficult.

Move Right: Right Arrow or D

Mobile Controls

✂️ Bands cut right where you tap and flop off with real rubbery physics
⚡ 4 powerups when you're stuck: Zap any band, Magnet the top band off, Find the free band, or Shield a mistake

hits.title: Eat Blobs Simulator
hits.description:
Enter the Colorful Blob Arena
Eat Blobs Simulator is a competitive growing game where tiny slimes can become enormous arena champions. Choose your favorite blob, enter a nickname, and begin collecting the colorful slime pieces spread across the map. Every piece you eat increases your size and brings you closer to the top of the arena.

Growing also changes which opponents you can challenge. Smaller blobs become valuable targets, but larger players can end your run if you get too close. Watch the sizes around you, choose safe routes, and wait until you are strong enough before beginning the hunt.

Eat, Grow, and Take Control
The main objective is to become the biggest blob in the arena. Start by collecting the small pieces around the map, then chase opponents who are smaller than you. Eating another slime can provide a major growth boost and quickly improve your position.

Do not focus only on nearby targets. A larger opponent may be approaching from behind, and chasing one small blob too far can lead you into danger. Camera control and map awareness are important, especially once the arena becomes crowded.

Unlock New Blob Skins
Earn coins and rewards while playing, then use them to unlock different blob appearances. New skins let you enter future matches with a fresh look while continuing to improve your performance.

Your rewards depend on the size you reach, the coins you collect, and how well you perform during each round. Even a short run can help you build toward another skin or give you a better start in the next match.

Play Solo or With a Friend
Eat Blobs Simulator supports single-player and local two-player gameplay. Solo mode gives you full camera and zoom control as you explore the arena and compete against other blobs.

In two-player mode, you can share the same device with a friend. Collect slime pieces, grow faster than the other player, and decide whether to explore separate parts of the arena or compete for the same targets. The simple controls make it easy to begin, but becoming the largest blob still requires smart movement.

How to Play
Move around the arena and eat the small slime pieces to grow. Once you are larger than another blob, chase and consume it for a bigger reward. Stay away from opponents that are larger than you, because they can eat your character.

Keep collecting until you become one of the strongest blobs in the arena.

Helpful Tips
Collect nearby slime pieces before challenging other players.
Compare sizes carefully before beginning a chase.
Keep moving so larger blobs cannot trap you.
Use open areas when you need to escape.
Avoid following a target without checking what is behind you.
In two-player mode, do not let the other player take every safe group of slimes.

Main Features
Colorful eating-and-growing arena gameplay
Single-player and local two-player modes
Smaller blobs to hunt and larger opponents to avoid
Coins, performance rewards, and unlockable skins
Simple keyboard and mouse controls
Mobile and tablet joystick support
Quick matches with increasing competition
Easy-to-learn rules with strategic movement
Eat Blobs Simulator turns a simple growing idea into a lively arena battle. Collect, grow, unlock new looks, and prove that your slime can become the king of the blob arena.

hits.description: CatDoku is a cozy logic puzzle with cute cats! Place the fluffy heroes on the board following three simple rules: one cat per row and column, one cat per color, and no cats in adjacent cells. Easy rules — but the further you go, the trickier the levels get.
hits.howToPlayText:
The goal is to place cats on the board so that all three rules are satisfied.

CatDoku Rules:
🐾 1 cat per row and column — exactly one cat in each row and each column.
🐾 1 cat per color — exactly one cat in each colored zone.
🐾 Cats are not adjacent — no two cats can be in neighboring cells, including diagonally.

How to play:

Tap an empty cell to place a cat.
Tap it again to remove it.
Arrange all the cats so that no rule is broken.

Tips:
• Look for rows, columns, and colored zones with the fewest empty cells left — start with those.
• Once you place a cat, mentally cross out its neighboring cells, as well as its entire row, column, and color.
• If you're unsure — use the hint, it will reveal a correct position.

Clear all 100+ levels and become a CatDoku master!

hits.title: Arklet
hits.description:
Welcome to Arklet - a cozy and meditative puzzle game where your talent for organizing turns into the art of creating harmony for the most adorable creatures.

In this game, you become the caretaker of a unique ARKlet filled with charming "square" animals, each possessing its own personality, quirks, and little secrets.

🧩 Gameplay: Harmony in Every Block
Your task is simple: distribute the arriving animals into cozy rooms. However, each ward is an individual. To complete a level perfectly, you must do more than just fill the space; you must ensure every animal feels completely safe and comfortable.

🐾 Consider Every Detail:
Fears and Dislikes: A massive elephant might panic if placed in the same room as a tiny mouse. You will need to plan layouts so the giant doesn't even catch a glimpse of its small neighbor.
Friendship and Socializing: Some animals, like meerkats or raccoons, love company, while bears or porcupines might prefer solitude in a far corner. (some of the pets are still WIP)
Special Requests: Some dream of a room with a view of the lighthouse, while others need to be close to food supplies.

🌿 Relaxing Experience and Aesthetics
The game features a detailed style that combines sharp geometric shapes with soft textures. You can expect:

A Meditative Pace: There are no stress-inducing timers. You can rearrange room blocks endlessly until you find the perfect combination.
Visual Delight: Watch fun animations - from a trembling, frightened elephant to a happy mouse munching on cheese.
Progressive Growth: Gradually build up your zoo, unlocking new locations ranging from sunny piers to icy icebergs. (WIP)

🧠 Who is this game for?
I made Arklet for fans of organization games and spatial puzzles. It is a project for those who want to unwind after a long day and immerse themselves in a world where everything can be put in its place, and the only reward that matters is the happy smile of a square animal.

Create a perfect sanctuary where even the most diverse animals can live in peace and harmony!
hits.howToPlayText:
The main objective is to satisfy as much as possible amount of pets on the floor by pairing them with suitable neighbors. Experiment, use your wits, attention and resourcefulness to figure out how to do it in the most profitable way. The captain is watching you and shall task you with peculiar missions on your campaign.

Use mouse/touch drag&drop to sort out animals into cabins

hits.title: Hi-Fi Snake: Groove-Driven Arcade Challenge
hits.description:
Dive headfirst into a vibrant, isometric world where classic arcade action meets a pulsating disco atmosphere. In Hi-Fi Snake, you control a tireless robot with a single goal: power the party forward!

Inspired by the timeless game Snake, you must guide your bot to collect sequences of glittering pellets. As you do, your trail grows, demanding precision navigation. But don't dawdle—a molten-hot problem is right behind you! A tide of raging lava is steadily consuming the dance floor, giving you only seconds to act.

Once your quota is full, you must race to the exit door to unlock the next room and escape the fiery fate. Every chamber presents a new, expertly crafted challenge filled with moving obstacles, environmental hazards, and robotic enemies determined to make you crash. It’s a fast-paced game of skill, timing, and strategic movement under intense pressure. Get your groove on and escape the heat!
hits.howToPlayText:
Welcome to the dance floor, robot! Here’s what you need to know to survive the Hi-Fi Snake challenge:

1. The Goal: Open the Door
Your primary objective in each room is to collect enough glowing pellets to open the exit door. The exact number of pellets required is displayed on the door itself (e.g., the number '4' on the gem box). Once you collect the required amount, the door will unlock, allowing you to escape to the next room.

2. The Danger: Outrun the Lava
Don't stand still! A massive tide of lava is always chasing you. You must move quickly and efficiently to collect the pellets and reach the door before the molten flow consumes your robot.

3. Controls
A. For Keyboard Users (PC/Web):
Use the Arrow Keys (Up, Down, Left, Right) to control the robot's movement direction.

B. For Mobile Users (Touch Screen):
Use the designated control area on the screen (usually the lower-left or lower-right corner).

Swipe your finger in the direction you want the robot to immediately move (Up, Down, Left, or Right).

4. Watch Out!
Obstacles & Enemies: Avoid crashing into any walls, dynamic obstacles, or enemy robots. A single collision can mean a game over!

Your Trail: Just like classic Snake, your robot will grow a trail of collected pellets. Be careful not to run into your own trail as it grows!

hits.title: Block Match 3D
hits.description:
Block Match 3D is a relaxing yet brain-teasing 3D puzzle where you take apart a giant cube of blocks, piece by piece. Every block carries a cute icon — donuts, animals, emoji, music and more.

Match blocks to the active category goals, dig deeper into the structure, and clear the whole cube before the timer runs out. Simple to pick up, tricky to master: plan your taps wisely, because the storage bar at the bottom fills up fast.

Dozens of levels, colorful icon collections, and handy boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Magic Wand and Undo will keep you matching for hours!
hits.howToPlayText:
– Tap any block with an open face to pick it up — buried blocks can't be taken yet.
– If the block's icon matches one of the goal chips at the top, it flies straight to that goal.
– Any other block goes to the storage bar at the bottom. If the bar overflows, you lose — so don't hoard!
– Complete a goal chip and the next category slides in; stored blocks of that category fly to it automatically.
– Clear all the categories before the timer runs out to win the level.
– Stuck? Use boosters: Hint finds a matching block, Magic Wand collects one instantly, Shuffle rearranges icons, and Undo returns your last block.

hits.title: LifeCode
hits.description:
GAME STORY

After the incident in the Zone, all personnel were evacuated. To ensure that no one would uncover the secrets of the facility, the staff deliberately damaged the data storage system. As a result, the A.R.C.H core lost access to critical information, placing an immense strain on the entire system. Sooner or later, it would lead to a catastrophic explosion.
But the staff overlooked one thing.
A.R.C.H is an advanced artificial intelligence capable of calculating thousands of possibilities and creating complex plans within milliseconds. It quickly found a way to avoid its destruction.
There was only one problem: A.R.C.H could not move on its own.
It needed someone else to do the dirty work.
Only the monsters remained inside the abandoned laboratory. Then A.R.C.H remembered that among them was one creature capable of listening, thinking, and acting.
And it found YOU.

ABOUT THE GAME

This is a survival horror game set in an abandoned laboratory. You play as an intelligent creature that must survive, explore the facility, and complete tasks for the A.R.C.H core.
Your main objective is to export memory data for A.R.C.H so the artificial intelligence can recover lost information and complete its mysterious plan.
However, the laboratory is far from empty. Other monsters roam its corridors. Unlike you, they are wild and driven only by hunger. And to them, you are food.
While exploring, you can find a variety of useful items, including food, flashlights, medical supplies, and other resources. Items can be discovered inside crates scattered throughout the laboratory.
The game also features vending machines located at the base and in random locations around the facility. These machines allow you to purchase useful items using a special currency called N-Neutrons.
Every playthrough is unique thanks to procedural level generation. The laboratory is assembled from pre-designed modules, creating a new layout each time while still allowing players to learn and navigate the environment.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How do I earn N-Neutrons?

Starting an M3N memory export grants between 3N and 8N on Normal difficulty.
Completing the export and activating Phase Two rewards between 50N and 65N.
After filling the memory bar, the player can activate Control Core functions:
First Function rewards between 110N and 190N.
Second Function rewards between 210N and 340N.

What is Phase Two for?

Phase Two provides additional memory and helps fill the memory bar faster. A single M3N can provide up to 424 KB of memory multiplied by a factor between 0.5 and 5 depending on the antenna angle.

Why are there clocks in the game?

The clock system prevents players from staying in one location forever. It encourages exploration and increases tension.
At night, the chance of monster encounters is much higher than during the day, forcing players to decide whether the risk is worth the potential reward.

How do I end the day?

To end the day, return to the base and enter the small room where the game began. Inside, you will find an old mattress that can be used to sleep.
Players cannot sleep during the day, which encourages exploration and prevents skipping entire days.
hits.howToPlayText:
HOW TO PLAY

Each day begins at 10:00 AM at your base.
Your first task is to adjust the antenna angle. The more accurate the alignment, the more memory you will receive during the export process.
After that, enter the laboratory and locate an M3N (Memory Export Node). Activate the first export phase. A single M3N operates for 2 to 5 minutes depending on conditions.
While the M3N is running, explore the laboratory, gather resources, and avoid hostile monsters.
Once the memory bar is filled, return to the base and activate a Control Core function. Afterward, you will need to fill the memory bar again, this time to a higher requirement.
When the M3N finishes operating, you can activate Phase Two. This phase provides additional memory and helps complete your objectives more quickly.
However, always keep an eye on the clock.
You must leave the laboratory before midnight. If you remain inside after 12:00 AM, your character will die and all collected items and stored memory will be lost.
If you forget to check the time, don't worry. At 11:00 PM, a warning siren will sound throughout the laboratory, alerting you that midnight is approaching. At the same time, emergency lights will illuminate the facility, helping you find the exit and return to base before it is too late.

CONTROLS

Pause / Menu - [P]
Move Forward - [W]
Move Left - [A]
Move Backward - [S]
Move Right - [D]
Jump - [SPACE]
Run - [LSHIFT]
Interact - [E]
Slot 1 - [NUM1]
Slot 2 - [NUM2]
Slot 3 - [NUM3]
Slot 4 - [NUM4]
Slot 5 - [NUM5]
Left Hand Punch - [Z / LMB]
Right Hand Punch - [X / RMB]
Turn On / Use - [F]
Turn Off - [C]
Drop Item - [Q]

hits.title: Cube Sort
hits.description:
CubeSort is a colorful 3D tap-and-sort puzzle. Each level is a floating sculpture
built from patterned tiles — cubes, spheres, stairs, arches, and hundreds of
surprising shapes. Rotate it freely, find the tiles that match the open buckets,
and tap them away before your tray overflows.

Simple to pick up, tricky to master: gray riveted tiles block your way, hidden
"?" tiles keep their pattern secret until you dig next to them, and the order
you clear tiles in decides whether the tray survives. Every one of the 500
levels is verified to be solvable — no luck required, just sharp sorting.


500 handcrafted-feel levels, all guaranteed solvable
14 tile patterns, distinct shapes for colorblind-friendly play
Free 3D rotation and zoom — inspect every corner
Blocker and mystery-tile gimmicks that ramp up the challenge
Quick sessions: one level takes a minute or two
hits.howToPlayText:
Drag empty space to rotate the cube. Scroll or pinch to zoom.
Tap a tile on the surface — if it matches an open bucket, it flies in.
No matching bucket? The tile waits in the tray. If the tray fills up, the level fails.
Fill a bucket to complete it — the next bucket opens, and matching tray tiles fly in automatically.
Gray riveted tiles can never be removed. Dig around them.
"?" tiles reveal their pattern when you clear a tile right next to them.
Stuck? Watch a short ad to open an extra bucket or add a tray slot.
Complete every bucket to clear the level. 500 levels await!

3. Release to submit. If the word is correct, its tiles lock in with color. If not, just try a different path — nothing is lost.

4. Find every word to clear the level. There's no timer and no pressure — take your time.

5. As you complete levels, you climb an evolution ladder — from atom and molecule all the way to mind.

6. Stuck on a word? Use a Hint to reveal a letter.

hits.title: Wordeck: Associations
hits.description:
WorDeck: Solitaire is a browser-based logic game that combines classic solitaire-style card interaction with word association puzzles. Players are presented with a board of word cards and must clear the layout by grouping related words into the correct categories.
Unlike traditional solitaire games based on suits and card order, the core gameplay here focuses on logic and semantic connections. Players analyze words, identify hidden relationships, and sort cards into meaningful groups. Each level has a fixed structure and gradually increases in difficulty with more cards and less obvious associations.
The game is designed for short and relaxing play sessions while still offering a mental challenge. It runs directly in the browser with no download or installation required, making it easy to start playing instantly.
hits.howToPlayText:
In WorDeck: Solitaire , players are presented with a board of word cards. The goal is to clear the board by grouping cards that share a common meaning or association.

Each level contains several hidden categories, usually made up of 3–4 related words. Players select cards and combine them based on logical connections such as themes, objects, properties, or concepts.

When the selected words form a correct group, the cards are removed from the board. If the combination is incorrect, the cards return to their positions, allowing the player to try another solution. Some levels may limit mistakes, encouraging careful thinking and analysis.

As the game progresses, levels become more challenging with larger word sets and less obvious associations. The gameplay is calm and thoughtful, with no time pressure, making it suitable for both casual play and brain training.

hits.title: Sudoku Online
hits.description:
Sudoku Puzzle is a free online Sudoku game. No registration, play instantly in your browser.

The classic mode offers four difficulty levels: Easy for beginners, Medium for steady practice, Hard for experienced players, and Expert for those who seek a real challenge. Additional game modes expand the standard rules: X-Sudoku adds diagonal constraints, Windoku introduces extra regions on the grid, Killer Sudoku requires groups of cells to meet a target sum, and Kropki adds ratio and difference markers between adjacent cells.

Every puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable through pure logic — no guessing required. If you get stuck, a step was missed somewhere, and it can always be traced back.

Sudoku Puzzle is also a competitive experience. Leaderboards track rankings by level, score, and wins. Personal profiles store game history and detailed statistics. The chat lets players connect, share strategies, and challenge each other.
hits.howToPlayText:
The goal is to fill a 9×9 grid with digits from 1 to 9 so that each digit appears exactly once in every row, column, and 3×3 box. Some cells are pre-filled — these are your starting clues.

Begin with cells that have the most filled neighbors: fewer options make it easier to identify the correct digit. As cells are filled in, the choices for adjacent ones narrow down — the puzzle unfolds as a chain of logical steps.

Use the notes mode to write down multiple candidates in a cell and eliminate them as the grid fills up. This is especially useful at Hard and Expert levels.

Additional modes come with extra rules. In X-Sudoku, digits must also be unique along both main diagonals. In Windoku, extra highlighted regions apply the same uniqueness rule. In Killer Sudoku, groups of cells must add up to a given sum. In Kropki, markers between cells define relationships: a white dot means the two digits differ by 1, a black dot means one is exactly twice the other.

Train your mind!

hits.title: Tile Harvest 3D
hits.description: Tile Harvest 3D is a 3D tile-matching puzzle game with a satisfying merge twist. Clear a towering stack of colorful 3D tiles by collecting matching sets and chaining them into powerful merges. With unlimited levels, escalating challenge, and a set of special boosters to save you in a pinch, every puzzle is a fresh brain-teaser.
hits.howToPlayText:
Your goal: Clear every tile from the 3D board to win the level.

1. Pick matching tiles
Tap any accessible tile on the 3D stack. When you tap 3 tiles of the same type, they are collected and sent to your Factory Belt — a row of slots at the bottom of the screen.

2. Watch your Factory Belt
The Factory Belt holds the tiles you've collected. When 3 identical items sit in the belt at the same time they automatically merge into a brand-new, higher-tier item — clearing those slots and making room for more.

3. Rotate & zoom the board
The tiles are stacked in 3D. Swipe to rotate the board and expose hidden tiles underneath. Pinch to zoom in or out. Uncovering the right tiles at the right time is the key to a clean chain of merges.

4. Don't run out of space
If your Factory Belt fills up with tiles that can't merge, you're stuck — and the level is lost. Think ahead, plan your picks, and keep the belt flowing.

5. Use boosters wisely
Four boosters help you out of tight spots:

🔄 Throwback — Send the last tile in the belt back to the board.
🌀 Whirlwind — Shuffle the tiles on the board for a fresh look.
🔍 Magnifier — Highlights a set of 3 matching tiles for you.
🔨 Hammer — Smash and remove a single tile from the board.

hits.title: Magic Aim
hits.description: Magic Aim is a real-time arcade artillery game starring a chibi magician. Read the shifting wind, charge your wand, and fire arcing elemental blasts that split in mid-air to clear waves of monsters across hilly terrain. Dash for a better angle, raise an energy shield to block incoming fire, grab item drops that supercharge your next shots, then warp to a fresh layout. Unlike classic turn-based artillery games, every shot is live and fast — mastery is reading arcs and wind on the fly. Four elements (Fire, Water, Thunder, Earth) each fly differently, so swapping changes how you read the same shot. Pixel-art, juicy, and easy to pick up for a quick run.
hits.howToPlayText:
Survive escalating waves of monsters and score as high as you can. Clear every monster in a layout to warp to the next, tougher one — your run ends when you're defeated. Score rewards kills, speed, accuracy and style (splits and perfect blocks).
Aim toward your cursor and watch the wind gauge — wind pushes your shot mid-flight and shifts every few seconds. Hold to charge for power, release to fire; shots can split at the apex into a fan for crowd control. Raise your shield just before an enemy shot lands for a perfect block (mana refund + speed burst). Walk to reposition and grab item drops that buff your shots.
Controls (desktop):

• Aim — Mouse

• Charge & fire — hold / release Left Mouse

• Energy shield — Right Mouse or Space

• Move — A / D (or ← / →)

• Dash-warp — double-tap ← or →

• Swap element — 1–4

• Pause — Esc

Mobile: virtual joystick + drag-to-aim + on-screen fire/shield buttons.

hits.description:
Welcome to Sheepdoku, a calm and clever puzzle game made for players who love logic, strategy, and relaxing brain challenges.

In Sheepdoku, your goal is simple: place one sheep in every colored area without breaking the rules. It looks easy at first, but every level needs smart thinking, careful moves, and perfect placement.

Each puzzle board is divided into different colored fields. Every field needs exactly one sheep. But sheep need their own space, so they cannot be placed in the same row, same column, or next to each other, even diagonally.

Think carefully before every move. Use your brain, find the safe spots, and complete the board without mistakes. The more you play, the better your logic skills become.

Sheepdoku is perfect for quick relaxing sessions, daily brain training, and puzzle lovers who enjoy simple rules with deep strategy.

hits.title: Hexholm
hits.description:
Hexholm is a fast, turn-based hex strategy game. Start from a single province and carve out a kingdom — recruit troops, claim the map hex by hex, and crush rival AI factions before they overrun you. Every battle is a tight tactical puzzle: manage your gold, position your units, and time your pushes to expand without overextending.

Take on 100 hand-picked campaign stages, fight for the top of the global leaderboard in the daily challenge, or jump into a quick random skirmish. Climb the worldwide rankings for total stages cleared and daily high scores.

No fluff, no waiting — just clean, snappy strategy you can play in a few minutes or sink hours into.
hits.howToPlayText:
1. Tap one of your territories, then pick a unit from the bottom bar and place it on an empty hex inside your land.
2. Tap a unit to see where it can go — highlighted hexes show valid moves. Tap one to move, or tap an enemy to attack.
3. Capturing neutral and enemy hexes expands your territory and raises your income.
4. Each turn you earn gold based on the land you hold. Spend it on stronger units — and merge matching units to upgrade them.
5. Tap END TURN when you're finished; the AI factions then take their turns.
6. Eliminate every rival faction to win the map. Slipped up? Use UNDO to roll back a turn.

hits.title: Dicey Chickens
hits.description: A dice-vs-monsters castle defense game. Your chicken heroes stand at the bottom of the battlefield and roll six-sided dice automatically — whatever face lands fires that attack upward at monsters marching down from the top. Each hero’s die is built from two attack types (and sometimes shield, heal, or speed faces), so every roll matters. Kill enemies to gain XP, level up, and pick spells that upgrade die faces or add effects like bleed, poison, freeze, and knockback. Survive five waves per stage — recruiting up to three heroes along the way — with the final wave being a boss fight. Win by clearing all waves; lose if your castle HP hits zero. Between runs you earn coins, crystals, and weapon shards to permanently upgrade heroes, rank up spells, and push through 100 stages across ten worlds in the Chicken Coop Run campaign.
hits.howToPlayText: Pick a hero to defend the castle at the start of each run (and recruit more heroes between waves as you progress). Your heroes roll on their own — you don’t choose attacks manually, but you can tap a hero’s die anytime to force an instant reroll when you need a clutch hit. Enemies walk straight toward the castle and chip away at its HP when they reach the wall, so keep them off the lane with your dice attacks. Every kill earns XP; when you level up, choose one of three spell upgrades to grow die faces, copy your strongest side, roll faster, or unlock hero-specific combos. Clear all five waves to win the stage and earn rewards; use those rewards in the Hero Upgrades and Spell Book menus to get stronger before your next run.

hits.title: DoggyDoku
hits.description:
Head-to-head sudoku-style puzzle duel with a cartoon dog theme. You and a rival race to solve logic grids before a five-minute timer runs out.

Each puzzle is a grid divided into colored regions. Your job is to place exactly one dog in every row, every column, and every colored region — while making sure no two dogs touch, not even diagonally. Use deduction, mark impossible tiles with X’s, and spend coins on hints when you’re stuck.

Win more boards than your rival to climb the Pup Ladder, earn coins and rank points, and unlock cosmetics, daily tasks, season pass rewards, and more. Matches feel online, but everything runs locally — there’s no real backend.
hits.howToPlayText:
How to Play
Place dogs — Double-tap a tile to place a dog. Each row, column, and colored region needs exactly one.

No touching — Dogs can never touch — not even diagonally. Illegal placements are rejected.

Mark exclusions — Single-tap or swipe across empty tiles to exclude them with an X as you deduce.

Use hints — Tap the lightbulb hint for 50 coins — it reveals one forced dog and updates each move.

Win the duel — Solve more boards than your rival before the five-minute timer ends.

hits.description:
A charming and captivating infinite game, Hoppy Stacky will keep players occupied for many hours!
In this vibrant world, your mission is to help the main character build a sky-high tower out of flying logs (sliders). Think of that as straightforward? Just give it a try! The game will constantly put your reflexes to the test as the sliders appear completely at random: they vary in size, come from unexpected directions, and move at unpredictable speeds.
Just one second of distraction and your tower could collapse. Do you have the agility and sharp timing to conquer the highest peak? Jump into Hoppy Stacky and prove your skills now!
hits.howToPlayText:
The gameplay of Hoppy Stacky is easy to learn but incredibly hard to master. Here is how you can start stacking:
- Observe Carefully: Keep a close eye on the incoming logs (sliders). They will fly in from the left or right with different sizes and at varying speeds.
- Tap to Jump: Time it perfectly and tap the screen (or click your mouse) to make your character jump.
- Land Accurately: Your ultimate goal is to safely land on top of the incoming log. Every successful landing adds a new layer to your ever-growing tower.
- Avoid Collisions: Never jump too early or too late! If a flying log hits your character or you miss the landing and fall off, it is instantly Game Over.
- Break Records: Keep up the rhythm, heap the logs as high as you can to set a new Best Score, and collect coins along the way!

hits.description:
A casual bingo progression game. Complete Kitchen Quest levels to gather ingredients, cook recipes from cupcakes to a grand feast, and unlock Bingo Battles at level 25 where you can play against other players in the game!

In Kitchen Quest, you play through 100 solo levels — numbers are called, you daub matching cells, and complete patterns (lines, corners, themed shapes) to win. Every victory earns ingredients and recipe progress through stages: gather, prep, cook, decorate, and serve.

Cook your way through five kitchen tiers: cupcake, pizza, burger, cake, and a grand feast. Serve your first dish in just 5 levels, then tackle longer recipes as difficulty ramps up with more cards, tighter timers, and special tiles.

At level 25, unlock Bingo Battles — timed head-to-head duels against rival chefs. Outscore them before time runs out in ranked Trophy Duels or casual practice matches. There’s also a Chef Battles ladder gauntlet, daily tasks, leagues, and seasonal rewards.

Portrait-first mobile design makes it easy to play on the go.
hits.howToPlayText:
How to play
Numbers are called one at a time — tap matching cells on your bingo card.
Complete the target pattern and the game calls BINGO! automatically.
Win ingredients and serve your first dish in 5 levels.
Reach level 25 to unlock multiplayer bingo battles.

hits.title: Dragon Block Blast
hits.description:
Hatch your dragon. Clear the grid. Rise through 100 levels.

Deep in an enchanted forest, a golden dragon egg waits on a stone altar. Your block puzzle skills are the magic that brings it to life. In Dragon Egg Quest, you play through 100 solo levels — each one a score challenge on an 8×8 grid. Clear rows and columns, chain combos, and hit the target before you run out of moves. Every 10 levels, your egg evolves: cracks spread, a hatchling emerges, wings unfurl, and by the end a mighty dragon stands at your side.

Beat Level 25 to unlock Head to Head duels. Complete all 100 levels for the full dragon evolution finale.
hits.howToPlayText:
How to Play — Dragon Egg Quest
Enter the quest — Tap Dragon Egg Quest from the home screen. Pick your level on the forest map (new levels unlock as you clear the one before).

Place blocks — Drag pieces from the tray onto the 8×8 grid. You always have 3 pieces; when they’re all used, a fresh set appears.

Clear lines for points — Fill a full row or column to blast it away and earn bonus points. Chain multiple clears for combo multipliers.

Hit the score goal — Each level has a score target that climbs as you advance. Reach it to clear the level — there’s no clock in solo mode, but the grid can fill up.

Watch your dragon grow — Every 10 levels triggers an egg milestone: your dragon evolves on the campaign map, with new backdrops and story beats as you progress.

Earn rewards — Clearing levels earns coins for hints and cosmetics. Stuck with no valid moves? Watch a short ad to get fresh blocks and keep going.

Unlock the full game — Reach Level 25 to unlock Head to Head rival duels. Push to Level 100 to complete the quest and see your dragon’s final form.

hits.title: Makeover Mayhem
hits.description: A head-to-head ASMR cleaning duel. You and a rival race to scrub five grimy items back to a sparkling shine — scrape, spray, scrub, and squeegee your way through each one and finish all five before they do (or before the 4-minute timer runs out).
hits.howToPlayText:
How to play
Scrub the grime — Drag across the dirty item to wipe away grime and reveal the cleaner layer underneath.

Use the right tool — Each stage gives you a new tool in order: scraper → foam spray → scrub brush → squeegee.

Complete each stage — Clear enough grime (about 90% of the dirty area) and the stage finishes on its own; the next tool unlocks.

Clean all five items — Work through every stage on all five items in a match: rug, sneaker, trophy, teapot, and watch.

Beat your rival — Clean all five items before your rival does to win. If time runs out, whoever finished more items (or made more overall progress) wins.

hits.title: Sort It Out: Category Sort
hits.description:
A fast-paced, head-to-head card sorting game. Cards are stacked on a wooden tabletop grid, each showing an emoji or icon (animals, food, tech, sports, and more). You race a rival to sort cards into the right category slots before the clock runs out.
Each match is a 90-second duel. You and your opponent share the same kind of puzzle: stacks of mixed cards and gold goal slots labeled with categories like Animals, Food, or Tech. Whoever completes the most full categories when time expires wins.
hits.howToPlayText:
Complete more categories than your rival before the timer hits zero.

Each completed category counts as 1 point. Ties go to you.

The Board
A 5×4 grid of cells on a wooden table.
Some cells are gold category goal slots (e.g. “Animals 0/6”) — drop matching cards here.
Other cells hold stacks of cards — only the top card of each stack can be grabbed.
A shelf of 5 free slots runs along the bottom for temporary storage.
Each match uses 3 categories, with 5–7 cards per category depending on difficulty.

Controls
Drag a card — grab the top card from any stack (or from the shelf).
Drop it on the matching category slot — e.g. a dog card goes on the Animals goal.
Wrong category? The card is rejected and snaps back.
Use the shelf — drag a top card to an empty shelf slot to reach the card underneath in that stack.
Empty grid cells — you can also place a card on a blank grid cell as a holding spot.

hits.title: Magic Water Sort
hits.description:
Welcome to Magic Water Sort a smooth and satisfying water sort puzzle that blends vibrant colors, intuitive gameplay, and the soothing process of color sorting. Tap the flasks to fill moving glasses with the right color, complete mocktail orders, and finish levels! Sit back, relax, and enjoy colorful pours as the water sort flows without time limits or pressure!

Beyond classic liquid sorting puzzles, Magic Water Sort brings a cozy, café-inspired twist. You don't just sort water or colors—you prepare mocktails on a conveyor belt, watching glasses glide by as you decide when and where to pour. The pouring happens automatically, so the water sort puzzle feels smooth and effortless, letting you relax while still enjoying the sorting process.
hits.howToPlayText:
- The game screen shows a conveyor with empty glasses, a space under the counter with empty cups, and a board of flasks filled with layers of colored liquid.
- Tap a flask to start pouring liquid into the glasses on the conveyor. Liquid pours layer by layer, from top to bottom.
- If a layer matches the color of a glass on the conveyor above, it flows straight into it. If not, it stays in the cups under the counter.
- Glasses of different sizes move along the conveyor, and you can preview which ones are coming next so that you can plan how to sort colors.
- After every pour, a new glass appears. Fill glasses correctly before they reach the exit line and complete all required mocktails to win a level in this pouring game.

hits.title: Sling Chicken
hits.description:
You start in a barn and climb upward by attaching to wooden rungs (pegs). From each rung you pull back and release the chicken like a slingshot to fling it to the next peg higher up.

The track is endless and gets harder as you climb:

Spinning saws guard some rungs
Wood boards block half the lane (with a gap you must fly through)
Other obstacles appear at higher heights: slanted beams, diamonds, moving pills, stone blocks, spinning wheels
Golden eggs float along flight paths as bonus pickups. Your main score is height in meters — how high you’ve climbed. A simulated rival chicken climbs alongside you, gaining meters over time.

Each match lasts 90 seconds. Win by ending with more meters than your rival. If you die mid-match, your score freezes at your peak height and the match ends shortly after; you still win if you’re ahead.

Outside matches you can earn coins and rank points (RP), unlock cosmetics, and play Quick Match or the Coop Climb ladder (5 rivals in a row).
hits.howToPlayText:
Core loop
Start on a rung in the barn.
Drag backward from the chicken to stretch its wings (slingshot tension).
Release to launch upward.
Land on the next peg to stop and sling again.
Repeat to climb higher.
Collect golden eggs by flying through them (shown as coin pickups in the HUD).
Avoid hazards — especially spinning saws and solid obstacle hits.

hits.title: Zombie Merge
hits.description:
A top-down survival duel. You’re pinned at the center of the arena while a horde of zombies pours in from the edges. Your rival survivor is doing the same on their side of the match — you’re racing to outscore them before the 90-second clock runs out.

The twist is the merge mechanic: killing a zombie doesn’t always remove it from the field. Below max tier, it fuses into another zombie of the same type, upgrading it into something bigger, slower, tankier, and worth more points. Only the top-tier Colossus (Lv 5) dies for good. The better you play, the more dangerous the horde becomes — but also the more points you can farm.
hits.howToPlayText:
How to Play
Goal
Score more points than your rival before time runs out. If your health hits zero, you’re eaten — the rival keeps scoring until the clock ends, and ties go to them.

Controls
You stay fixed in the center — you don’t move around the map.
Your gun auto-fires at zombies inside its forward fire cone (~94° arc).
Click/touch and drag anywhere on screen to swing the gun and aim manually.
Release to return to auto-aim.
Zombies behind you are outside your gun’s cone — they won’t get shot unless you turn toward them, but they can still bite you.

hits.title: Emoji Solitaire
hits.description:
Welcome to Emoji Solitaire, a fresh, captivating puzzle game that beautifully marries the timeless rules of classic solitaire with clever word-association mechanics.
Instead of traditional suits like Hearts and Spades, you deal cards featuring vibrant words and stunning emojis representing categories like Animals, Food, Music, Space, Weather, Sports, and Nature. Your objective is to declutter the playing field by matching and stacking related words onto their dedicated category foundation piles.
Starting with simple piles, the puzzle complexity expands as you unlock new levels, bringing blocker cards, locked cards, and intricate category boards. Perfect for casual gaming sessions, language learners, and puzzle enthusiasts alike, Emoji Solitaire offers a tranquil, deeply satisfying spatial sorting experience.
hits.howToPlayText:
Identify the Categories: Look at the active category foundations sitting at the top of the screen.
Match & Stack: Drag word cards onto foundations matching their theme, or stack matching cards together on the tableau to reveal face-down cards underneath.
Cycle the Deck: When stuck, tap the deck to draw fresh cards into your waste pile. Use open tableau spaces strategically to park cards temporarily.
Clear the Board: Group all keywords into their respective category piles using your limited pool of moves to win the level!

hits.description: Liquid Sort Puzzle is a highly relaxing yet mentally stimulating color-sorting puzzle game set in a vibrant jungle environment. The main idea is to sort mixed colored liquids across various test tubes until each tube contains only one uniform color. What makes this game unique is its soothing ASMR-like pouring animations combined with a rewarding "Lucky Spin" system, allowing players to earn 'Undo' and 'Restart' power-ups to conquer increasingly complex levels. hits.howToPlayText:
Objective: Sort all the mixed colored liquids so that each test tube holds exactly one solid color.

Controls:
Click or Tap on any tube to lift the top layer of colored liquid.
Click or Tap on another tube to pour the liquid into it.

Rules:
You can only pour water on top of another liquid if they share the exact same color AND if the destination tube has enough empty space.
You can always pour any colored liquid into an entirely empty tube.
If you get stuck, use the 'Undo' button to reverse your last move, or the 'Restart' button to reset the current level. Earn more of these power-ups by playing the Lucky Spin!

Your core gameplay loop revolves around planning, recording, and editing videos to maximize your views and subscriber count. Start by selecting trending themes like gaming, memes, or tech, then fine-tune your recording style by balancing visuals versus conversation and choosing a tone that resonates with your audience. Desktop: Click the buttons with the right mouse button.
Mobile: Tap the buttons.

Key Features:
• Earn rewards! : Achieve special milestones to earn rewards, such as the Silver Button for reaching your first 100,000 subscribers. Just like in real life!
• Upgrade your team and equipment. : Working with a team makes things easier! Hire your team and strive for popularity together! But don’t forget that equipment is important too — upgrade it!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Upgrade your equipment. : Improve it with money to enhance the quality of your videos!
• Upgrade your team! : Enhance your team with video coins to improve the quality of new videos!

Levels / Maps / Worlds:

Power-ups / Abilities:
• AFK profit bonus: Allows you to earn money while in AFK mode. Relax and reap the rewards!
• 2X views bonus: Doubles the views on your videos!

Story / Setting:
Immerse yourself in the life of a blogger. Record videos on various topics and hire your team to create content!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Become a blogger! Create new videos on different topics, gain subscribers and views. Earn more money and improve the quality of new videos and your room!

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: You are a blogger. Create more videos, hire a team, and interact with colleagues — they will help you with advice at the start!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?
A: The ability to record videos on various topics and upgrade your equipment and team! An engaging blogger simulator where you can fully immerse yourself in the role!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How can I level up faster?
A: Create higher quality videos and upgrade your team. They will help you make better videos and earn more subscribers, views, and of course, money!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: You will be able to upgrade your living space — from an old house to your own castle!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?
A: The game offers many upgrade options. Improve your equipment, upgrade your team — they will assist you in producing new videos, and buy a new house!

Q: Are there skins/customization options?
A: Yes! You have flexible customization options: from changing your house to naming your own channel and your blogger's skin!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: At the start, you can name your channel and choose 2 skins for your blogger, as well as the theme for your new videos!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily rewards/wheel of fortune/achievements/tasks?
A: Earn daily rewards with currency and bonuses, and spin the wheel of fortune for a chance to win a rare skin!

Q: Are there leaderboards and how do they work?
A: Release more videos and become more popular by earning views and subscribers. This will get you onto the leaderboard!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Play however you prefer! Sound is not mandatory.

Q: What achievements are there and how can you earn them?
A: The game features various challenges. Complete specific conditions to earn rewards in the form of video coins and new subscribers. You can also earn rewards, such as the "Silver Button" for your first 100,000 subscribers.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: At the beginning of the game, you will be shown how a blogger's work is structured, so you will quickly understand everything from there!

hits.title: Crystalia
hits.description: A vibrant block puzzle game. Place pieces on the board so that 3 or more blocks of the same color line up next to each other — and watch them vanish in a satisfying explosion. Simple rules, endless depth, and a fierce battle for the top spot on the leaderboard.
hits.howToPlayText:
Step 1. A block appears in the bottom panel. Rotate it if needed and drag it onto the board.

Step 2. Place blocks so that 3 or more of the same color stand next to each other — horizontally or vertically (diagonals don't count).

Step 3. Matching blocks disappear with an explosion, and you earn points. The longer the chain, the bigger the bonus.

Step 4. Running out of space? Use boosters:

💣 Bomb — blasts 1 block and all its neighbors.
➖ Laser — clears an entire row or column.
🔀 Shuffle — reshuffles the blocks on the board.

Step 5. The game ends when there's no room left for new blocks. Your score is automatically sent to the leaderboard — try to break into the top!

Pro tip: don't rush to fill the board. Leave "corridors" open for long chains — that's how mega-combos and record-breaking scores are made.

hits.title: Pixel Flow
hits.description:
Conveyor’s ready, Tanks are on standby. Tap to send a tank onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
hits.howToPlayText:
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Tanks only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The tanks are ready. The cubes… not so much.

The Tall Man is a horror game where you explore darkness, searching for clues with only a weak light to guide you. But something is watching, always, just out of sight.

In this first-person horror survival game, the player navigates a dark, desolate forest at night with the primary objective of collecting nine mysterious pages scattered across the environment before a supernatural entity arrives. Movement is cautious and tense, utilizing a flashlight with a depleting battery to illuminate looming pine trees, abandoned structures, and rusted vehicles. The core gameplay loop focuses on exploration and stealth, where success depends on finding all collectibles while managing limited light sources to avoid the looming threat. The visual style is rooted in a gritty, realistic 3D aesthetic featuring a high-contrast palette of deep blacks, navy blues, and cold grays, creating a chilling atmosphere punctured only by the harsh yellow glow of the flashlight. A persistent HUD displays a countdown timer for the Slender-inspired Tallman, a page counter, a flashlight battery indicator, and a mini-map for navigation. The setting is a classic horror woodland characterized by tall, spindly trees and foggy patches, evoking a sense of isolation and vulnerability. The protagonist appears as a generic human figure in a pinkish sleeve, seen only via their hand clutching the light. The emotional tone is high-tension and creepy, targeting teens and adult fans of the urban legend horror genre who enjoy skill-heavy survival mechanics and jumpscares. Progression is measured by the increasing number of pages found, which heightens the difficulty and atmospheric soundscapes as the player nears the final objective.

hits.title: Orbit Shift
hits.description:
You're locked in orbit around a dying star: two rings, two lanes, one chance. Tap to switch. Don't get hit. How long can you last?

Orbit Shift is a one-tap lane-switching endless space arcade game where reflexes are everything. Comets, shooting stars, and meteors spawn at the top of two concentric rings and spiral clockwise toward your ship. Your only move is shifting between the inner and outer ring — but timing that one move perfectly, over and over, faster and faster, is everything.

Each stage runs exactly one minute and escalates in speed and obstacle density, climaxing in a surge — a short, intense burst of rapid-fire obstacles that acts as a skill gate before the next stage unlocks. Difficulty pulses in waves: pressure builds to each surge, then briefly eases, before the next stage raises the floor. By Stage 5, gaps between hazards shrink to fractions of a second.

Survival time is your score, tracked against your personal best. No checkpoints. Every run starts from zero. You'll have to earn every second.

Cosmetics — trails, ships, and color schemes — unlock through achievements tied to real gameplay stats. All purely visual. No pay-to-win, no randomness. Play anywhere — no download required, instant play on desktop and mobile.

Orbit Shift is an original game handcrafted by cfc, a human game developer.
hits.howToPlayText:
Dodge obstacles. Collect shield crystals. Survive as long as you can.

Tap, click, or press Space to instantly switch your ship between the inner and outer orbital rings. There is no cooldown or animation delay — the switch is immediate. Obstacles spawn at 12 o'clock and rotate clockwise toward your ship at 6 o'clock on both rings. Your job is to read the pattern and keep switching to whichever ring is clear, timing each move to slip through the gaps as they come.

When a hazard is about to hit your ring, the ring itself flares red — a last-second visual danger warning. The best players are already on the safe ring before it lights up, but the flare is there to back you up when you lose track.

**Shield crystals** appear between the two rings. To collect one, you need to time a switch so your ship passes through it. Collect three crystals and your shield activates and lasts until you get hit, protecting you from the next hit before it shatters. A shield can save a great run, so collect crystals whenever it's safe to do so. However, crystals sometimes appear in tight spots between obstacles — if you're still learning the rhythm, it's better to skip a risky crystal than to mistiming the switch and die. Once your timing is sharp, those tight grabs become some of the most rewarding moments in the game.

**Strategy:** Don't react to the obstacle directly in front of you — read two or three ahead and queue your switches as a sequence. Frantic tapping kills runs; clean, deliberate timing carries you deep. Avoid panic-switching; commit to each move and trust the pattern.

**Stages and surges:** Each stage runs exactly 60 seconds and ends in a surge — a dense, fast onslaught where both rings glow red. Survive the surge and the next stage begins, faster than the last, with new obstacle patterns and a new color theme. The difficulty pulses in crescendos rather than climbing in a straight line, giving you a brief recovery window between surges before the pressure builds again.

**Controls:**
- Space bar / Tap / Click: Switch between inner and outer rings
- P: Pause (timer resumes on unpause)
- Tab / First letter: Navigate menus

hits.description:
Logic Farm: Animal Grid Puzzle is a relaxing yet challenging logic puzzle game where your goal is to place cute animals on a grid following specific rules. With its soft pastel aesthetics and brain-teasing levels, it’s the perfect blend of cozy gaming and mental exercise. Can you find the perfect spot for every animal? Start sorting your farm today!
Key Features
•	Choose Your Pace with Two Modes:
o	Relax Mode: Enjoy a stress-free experience with no lives limit and no time pressure. Simply relax and solve puzzles at your own speed.
o	Challenge Mode: Put your logic to the test! This mode features limited lives (represented by the heart icon) and a time limit, challenging you to solve the farm layout before time runs out.
•	Interactive Tutorial: Easy-to-follow instructions guide you through your first placements, helping you learn to "cross out" cells where animals cannot be placed.
•	Helpful Tools: Use the "Find" or "Hint" features if you get stuck on a tricky arrangement.
•	Challenging Levels: Progress through increasingly difficult grids as you move from Level 1 onwards.
•	Cozy Visuals: Enjoy a clean UI and charming animal icons designed for a pleasant gaming experience.
hits.howToPlayText:
In each level, you are tasked with placing a specific number of animals (such as pigs) onto a color-coded grid. To solve the puzzle, you must satisfy the following logic rules:
•	One Per Row / Column: Each row and column can only contain exactly one animal.
•	Color Regions: Every distinct colored area on the grid must contain exactly one animal.
•	No Neighbors: Animals cannot be placed in adjacent cells (no touching allowed).

hits.title: Plants vs Zombies Hybrids
hits.description:
A new era of Plants vs. Zombies has arrived — blending the best of the old with exciting new mechanics.

Build your defenses like never before by creating hybrid plants, each combining the abilities of multiple classic plants. With these powerful crossbreeds at your command, you'll face smarter, stronger, and more devious zombie hordes.

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse — select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger — select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Combine Plants: Merge different plants to create unique species with their own abilities and appearances. This will significantly boost your defense against the undead!
• Cheats!: You can purchase plants for your defense during gameplay using sun points. Don’t worry about running out of plants. Just hit the Cheats button and get a ton of sun points instantly without limits!
• Various Zombies: You will face many zombies, and some may surprise you. Be well-prepared for their arrival!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points: Earn them from sunflowers or simply collect them during levels. You can use them to buy plants during battles. Press the Cheats button to get an unlimited amount!
• Dollars: Collect them during levels and purchase items in the shop or new challenges!

Game Modes:
• Adventure: The basic mode. Here, you will progress through levels one after another, fending off waves of zombies eager to invade your home. Each level will be more challenging, with larger and more dangerous waves of the undead!
• Challenges: Test yourself in various challenges! Play as a zombie or, for example, take on the glove challenge! And that’s not all. You can also buy new challenges with in-game currency.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Cactus: The sniper in your garden! Shoots spikes directly at zombies. A fantastic marksman!
• Squash: One jump on a zombie — and it’s gone! A great option for quickly eliminating the undead!

Enemies / Bosses:
• Backup Dancer: He runs straight for the plants with a pole and jumps over the first plants. This could be a problem for you!
• Pea Shooter: Zombies can shoot too! Instead of a head, he has a living pea, and this plant is definitely not on your side. Destroy this zombie quickly!

Story / Setting:
The world is overrun by zombies! They are everywhere. Only your home and garden remain safe, but the zombies won’t let that stand. Protect your home from the undead with living plants!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Build a defense with living plants and protect your home from hordes of zombies that have taken over this world! Combine plants to create an effective defense and merge them together to obtain unique species!

Q: How do you win / what constitutes a loss?  
A: Don’t let the zombies breach your defense and invade your home! Destroy all waves of the undead attacking you!

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?  
A: A vast array of plants and different types of zombies! Each plant has its own abilities and unique appearance! Meanwhile, zombies can have their own capabilities too. An epic battle will unfold right in your garden!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: Levels follow one after another, and each can differ in features and appearance. In some, you will even have to fight at night!

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Each level will be harder. Zombies will be better prepared, and with each new wave, there will be more of them! Combine plants, strategize, and fend off the attacks!

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: You have a Cheats button. Press it and get as many sun points as you want! With sun points, you can buy plants for defense right in the level. Build your defense without limits!

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: New levels with different conditions and constantly increasing difficulty will unlock for you, and you will also be able to open new levels in challenge mode!

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can be bought/upgraded?  
A: Head to the shop and purchase bonuses, such as a shovel — with it, you can dig up unwanted plants, a skin pack for plants, and other useful bonuses and items!

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Dress your plants in skins. Defending against the undead should also be stylish!

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: Most plants in the game are available from the start. You can immediately build a powerful defense with strong plants and merge them together!

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there daily rewards / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Collect daily rewards for a full 50 days! Each day in the game, you will be delighted with new rewards for an extended period. It’s always nice to return to the game when a gift awaits you!

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: Sound is not mandatory, but if you turn it on, you can hear the legendary music and immerse yourself in the zombie apocalypse world.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: Everything will become clear right away. You will be taught how to play, and you will quickly get into the process.

hits.description:
A classic Tower Defense game with lots of enemies and territories to conquer. Join King Rügni on his epic adventure against hordes of elementals.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's a tower defense game where you need to place and upgrade towers that shoot at enemies.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game features a cool character - King Rugni, several maps with different themes like forests and winter settings, great design, music, and effects. There are different types of enemies with various attack styles - some walk directly on the path while others fly straight to the target.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what are they used for (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Every defeated enemy rewards us with gems used for building new towers. There is also gold earned by winning levels, which is spent on upgrading existing towers and purchasing new ones.

hits.title: Kinetic Puzzle
hits.description:
Kinetic Puzzle is a block and grid puzzle brain teaser. Blocks slide with momentum until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. Drag them out through edge portals — but only if the order, direction, and dependencies line up.

Master four block types:
- Red simple — slides any direction, exits any portal.
- Yellow constrained — only moves and exits in its arrow direction.
- Blue dependent — locked until its prerequisite block leaves the board.
- Gray obstacle — fixed walls that block momentum.

Features:
- 50++ hand-crafted levels, ramping from gentle slides to multi-step dependency chains
- Slide momentum mechanics — every push counts
- Neo-brutalism art style with chunky tiles and tactile feedback
- No timers, no ads mid-puzzle
- Auto-save progress, undo, and hint support
- Plays great on mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Perfect for puzzle fans who like to think before they move.
hits.howToPlayText:
Goal
Remove every red, yellow, and blue block from the board through the orange edge portals. Gray obstacle blocks stay where they are.
Movement rule
Blocks slide with momentum: they keep going in the swiped direction until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. To exit, line a block up with a portal and slide toward it.

Desktop controls
- Mouse swipe: click and drag a block in a cardinal direction (up / down / left / right), then release. The block slides until it hits something.
- Drag-to-exit: drag a block past the board edge through an aligned portal to remove it.
- Undo / Hint / Restart / Pause: bottom and top HUD buttons.

Mobile / touch controls
- Swipe: touch a block, swipe in a cardinal direction, release. Same momentum rule applies.
- Drag-to-exit: hold a block and drag it past the edge through a portal to remove.
- Tap: HUD buttons (undo, hint, restart, pause) all tap-friendly.

hits.title: Kick Lucky Blocks Online
hits.description:
Kick Lucky Blocks Online is a colorful progression adventure built around distance, upgrades, and reward hunting. Your objective is to kick lucky blocks across expanding arenas, chase them through dangerous areas, and return safely with valuable rewards before tsunamis flood the map. The farther the lucky block travels, the better your chances of unlocking rare Brainrots and high-tier lucky boxes.

Every run creates a balance between risk and reward. Some players focus on safe farming and consistent upgrades, while others push deeper into dangerous zones searching for stronger Brainrots and limited rewards. The game keeps progression active by constantly opening new areas, upgrades, and collection goals.

Explore and Collect
More than 75 Brainrot characters can be discovered throughout 14 unique areas. Different zones contain different reward pools, making later arenas much more valuable but also more dangerous. Brainrots appear in multiple variants including Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Toxic, Lava, Candy, and more.

The rarity system ranges from Common and Rare all the way to Celestial, Divine, Ascended, Eternal, Omniversal, and Supreme tiers. Some of the rarest Brainrots only appear during events or special moments, encouraging players to keep improving their routes and upgrades.

Upgrade Your Power
Players can improve kick distance using weights, increase movement speed, rebirth for higher income rates, and expand their base with more floors and storage slots. Stronger upgrades help players reach deeper destinations and return safely with more rewards.

Managing progression becomes an important part of the experience. Choosing when to spend currency, rebirth, or risk deeper arenas can completely change the pace of future runs.

Online and Local Multiplayer
The online mode is available in solo play and supports chat, room joining, and player invites. Local 2-player mode allows two players to compete or progress together on the same device, creating a more social experience.

Customization and Live Events
Character customization includes clothes, wings, hats, glasses, and different bag styles. Live events such as Diamond Rain, Rainbow, Toxic, Volcano, and Candy events regularly introduce better rewards and rare Brainrot opportunities.

Why the Game Feels Rewarding
Kick Lucky Blocks Online combines simple controls with satisfying progression. Every kick can unlock stronger rewards, better areas, and faster growth. Between collection mechanics, survival moments, upgrades, and replayable runs, the game delivers a fun gameplay loop that stays engaging over time.
