hits.title: Basket Random
hits.description:
Basket Random is a chaotic arcade basketball game where every match turns into a funny test of timing, luck, and unpredictable physics. Instead of giving players a serious sports simulation, it focuses on quick rounds, simple controls, and hilarious ragdoll movement. You control your team with one key, jump toward the ball, block your opponent, and try to score before the other side reaches the winning point. The idea is easy to understand, but the random physics make every attempt feel different.

What makes Basket Random stand out is the way it changes after almost every score. One round may take place on a normal court, while the next may throw you into a completely different setup with unusual players, strange body proportions, or a ball that behaves in an unexpected way. Sometimes the characters have long arms, sometimes their movement feels heavier, and sometimes the ball bounces in a way that makes even a simple shot difficult to predict. This constant variety keeps the game fresh without making it complicated.

The controls are intentionally simple, which makes the game accessible for almost anyone. In single-player mode, you can play against the CPU and practice your timing. In 2-player mode, the game becomes even more entertaining because both players share the same device and compete in fast, messy basketball duels. Since both sides are dealing with the same strange physics, every point feels like a mix of skill, reaction, and comedy.

Basket Random is especially enjoyable for players who like short sports games with instant action. You do not need to learn complex moves, manage a team, or follow advanced basketball rules. The goal is clear: jump, reach the ball, defend your basket, and score. However, the challenge comes from reading the movement of your characters and adapting quickly when the game changes the court, the players, or the ball behavior.

The pixel-style visuals give the game a clean and playful look, while the ragdoll animation creates many unexpected moments. A missed jump can turn into a lucky block. A bad shot can bounce into the basket. A perfect attack can fail because your player lands in the wrong position. These small surprises are the reason Basket Random feels fun even after many rounds.

For fans of funny basketball games, local 2-player games, and physics-based sports challenges, Basket Random offers a simple but highly replayable experience. It is easy to start, fast to understand, and unpredictable enough to keep every match exciting. Whether you are playing alone or challenging a friend, each round brings a new chance to score a ridiculous basket, make a surprising comeback, or laugh at a completely unexpected play.

Jump, block, and shoot with one key. Time your moves well and score before your opponent.

hits.title: Soccer Random
hits.description:
Soccer Random is a funny physics-based soccer game where every match feels unpredictable from the first kick. Instead of following the style of a serious football simulation, it turns soccer into a fast, chaotic, and easy-to-play challenge built around one-button controls. Your goal is simple: jump, kick, defend, and try to score before your opponent reaches the winning number of goals. The rules are clear, but the movement is never fully predictable, which is what makes each round so entertaining.

The game uses ragdoll-style character movement, so players do not run, turn, or shoot in a traditional way. They bounce, fall, stretch, and swing toward the ball with awkward timing. A perfect-looking attack can suddenly miss, while a strange jump may turn into an unexpected goal. This mix of timing, reaction, and random physics gives Soccer Random its playful identity. It is easy to understand in seconds, but every match still creates surprising moments.

One of the strongest parts of Soccer Random is how the game changes between rounds. The field, players, weather-like conditions, ball behavior, and match rhythm can shift after a goal. You may play on a regular soccer field in one round, then face a slippery or unusual setup in the next. These random changes keep the experience fresh and stop the matches from feeling repetitive. Players must quickly adapt instead of relying on the same move every time.

Soccer Random can be played alone against the CPU, but it becomes even more enjoyable in local 2-player mode. Two players can share the same device and compete in short, messy football duels where both sides are dealing with the same unpredictable movement. Because the controls are simple, the match stays focused on timing, quick reactions, and funny mistakes rather than complicated button combinations.

The pixel art style gives the game a clean, retro look that fits well with its arcade feeling. The visuals are simple enough to keep the action easy to follow, while the strange animations make every goal, save, and missed kick more memorable. A small bounce, a late jump, or an accidental block can completely change the result of a round.

For players who enjoy quick soccer games, local 2-player challenges, and funny sports games with random physics, Soccer Random offers a light but highly replayable experience. It works well for short sessions because the matches start quickly, the goal is always clear, and every round can produce a new kind of chaos. Whether you are trying to beat the CPU or challenge a friend, Soccer Random keeps football simple, strange, and entertaining from one goal to the next.

hits.title: SnakeWar.io
hits.description:
Enter the battlefield in SnakeWarz.IO, a fast-paced multiplayer snake game where survival belongs to the smartest and fastest players. Your mission is simple: grow the longest snake in the arena by eating fruits, defeating rivals, and dominating the leaderboard.

Collect delicious fruits scattered across the map to increase your size and score. The bigger you become, the more dangerous you are. Outsmart enemy snakes, trap them into crashing into your body, and consume the massive fruit drops they leave behind after elimination
hits.howToPlayText:
Grow the longest snake in the arena by eating fruits scattered across the map. Defeat other players by forcing them to crash into your body. When enemies die, they drop huge amounts of fruits. Collect them quickly and keep growing.

Movement & Boost

PC: Move your mouse to control the snake.

Need speed?
PC: Hold Left Click

Boosting makes you faster but reduces your snake’s length. Use it carefully to escape danger or trap enemies.

Growth & Kills

Eat fruits for steady growth.
Eliminate rival snakes for massive rewards.

If another snake’s head touches your body, they are eliminated instantly and explode into fruits. Collect the dropped fruits before other players steal them.

Arena Strategy

Stay near the center for more fruits.
Trap smaller snakes by circling them.
Avoid giant snakes until you grow bigger.
Use boost wisely — too much boosting makes you smaller and vulnerable.
Watch the leaderboard and target distracted players.

Key Features

Multiplayer Arena Combat: Real-time battles. Compete against global players in nonstop sessions.
Customizable Skins: Pumpkin heads. Pirate themes. Pig designs. Tailor your snake's appearance before each match.
Speed Boost Mechanic: Burn length for temporary acceleration. High-risk, high-reward positioning tool.
Nostalgic Snake Gameplay: Classic snake logic meets modern IO-style competition. Top-down 2D perspective. Flat vector graphics. Runs lag-free on any device.
Leaderboard Progression: Infinite climb. Every kill and orb pushes you higher. No download required.

Controls

PC

* Mouse Movement: Move snake
* Left Click: Boost speed

 FAQ

How do I grow in SnakeWarz.IO?

Eat fruits around the arena and collect fruits dropped by defeated snakes.

How do I eliminate other players?

Force enemy snakes to crash into your body.

Does boosting reduce size?

Yes. Boosting consumes part of your snake’s length.

Can I customize my snake?

Yes. Different skins are available before matches.

Is SnakeWarz.IO multiplayer?

Yes. All matches are real-time online multiplayer battles.

hits.title: Geometry Vibes 3D
hits.description:
Geometry Vibes 3D takes everything you loved about the original Geometry Vibes and brings it into a vibrant, dynamic 3D world. With fully reimagined levels and stunning new visuals, this version elevates your reflexes and rhythm-based skills to new dimensions.

Geometry Vibes 3D introduces exciting additions to elevate your experience:

Collectible Stars: Each level in Classic Mode has 3 stars to collect, with a total of 90 stars across all levels and difficulties (30 per difficulty). Stars serve as a badge of skill and currency to unlock exclusive items!
Market: Spend your hard-earned stars to unlock a special arrow skin or choose from dazzling 3D skins and trails to customize your vibe.
Leaderboard for Endless Mode: Compete globally and see how you stack up against players worldwide.
Difficulty Modes: Classic Mode now offers Rookie, Pro, and Expert settings, catering to beginners and veterans alike.


How is Geometry Vibes 3D different from the original Geometry Vibes?
Geometry Vibes 3D reimagines the original with fully 3D levels, new features like collectible stars, difficulty modes (Rookie, Pro, Expert), a global Leaderboard, and a Market for skins and trails. The multiplayer is streamlined to 2-Player Mode for a cleaner experience.

Can I play Geometry Vibes 3D on my phone?
Absolutely! The game is optimized for mobile devices with smooth touch controls, ensuring a seamless experience on both iOS and Android.

How do I unlock the special arrow skin?
Collect stars in Classic Mode to unlock the exclusive arrow skin in the Market. You can earn up to 90 stars by completing all levels in Rookie, Pro, and Expert difficulties.

Is there an online multiplayer mode?
Geometry Vibes 3D features local 2-Player Mode for face-to-face competition. While there’s no online multiplayer, you can compete globally via the Endless Mode Leaderboard.

 Why is there only 2-Player Mode instead of 4-Player Mode like the original?
To maintain clear visuals and avoid clutter in the 3D environment, we focused on a polished 2-Player local multiplayer experience.

Player 1: W, Left Mouse Click, or Spacebar.
Player 2 (in 2 Player Mode): Up Arrow Key.
Mobile Devices: Tap anywhere on the screen to jump – touch controls are fully supported.

hits.howToPlayText:
The Goopies: Slime Puzzle
Puzzle game? Check. Slime physics? Check. The Goopies: Slime Puzzle is all about the path. Guide slimes to the exit using grid-based instructions. No direct control. Just smart placement and timing.

How to Play The Goopies: Slime Puzzle
Use four simple instructions:
- Air – lifts slimes upward 
- Glide – moves them sideways in the air 
- Freefall – slows falling slimes for safe landings 
- Block – turns a slime into a wall to redirect others 
Avoid deadly traps like fire, water, and electricity, and remember: falls of 3 blocks or more are fatal. Collect keys, guide at least 3 slimes to the exit, and complete increasingly challenging levels.

Who is The Goopies: Slime Puzzle for?
Perfect for puzzle fans. Great for quick brain breaks. Ideal for players who want satisfying progression without chaos. Casual gameplay. Strategic depth. Fun for all ages.
Developed by Exient and released in April 2026.

FAQ
Where can I play The Goopies: Slime Puzzle online?
Play The Goopies: Slime Puzzle for free on Playgama. Desktop. Mobile. Any device.
How many slimes need to survive to pass a level?
At least 3 slimes must reach the exit. Lose more than that and you restart.
What happens if a slime falls too far?
Falls of 3 blocks or more are fatal. Use Freefall instruction to slow descent. Keep them safe.
How do instructions work in The Goopies: Slime Puzzle?
Click to place an instruction on any grid tile. When a slime walks over it, the instruction activates immediately. Affects movement instantly.

hits.title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
hits.description:
Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online is a fast-paced reward adventure that mixes movement, progression, and collection mechanics. Instead of standing still and opening boxes in one place, players travel across multiple zones, search for better lucky boxes, collect Brainrots, and return safely to base with their rewards. The deeper you go, the better the chances, but the risks also increase.

The game creates a satisfying loop of exploring, upgrading, and improving each run. Some sessions are about safe farming and steady progress, while others are about pushing into harder areas for rare rewards. That balance helps the gameplay stay fresh over time.

What Makes the Game Different?
Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online adds movement and route planning to the lucky box formula. Reaching stronger zones takes speed, timing, and smart decisions. You are not only depending on luck. Better movement and better upgrades often lead to better rewards.

There are more than 75 collectible Brainrot characters spread across 14 rarity classes. Common rewards appear early, while higher tiers such as Celestial, Divine, Eternal, and Supreme take more effort to obtain. Some rare finds only appear during events or special spawn windows.

Gameplay Progression
Collected Brainrots can be sold for currency, which is then used to improve future runs. Players can upgrade movement speed, buy stronger lucky boxes, rebirth for better income rates, and expand their base with new floors and extra slots. Even small upgrades help create faster and more profitable runs later.

The game rewards steady improvement. Players who learn the map, optimize routes, and invest wisely usually progress faster than those who rely only on random rewards.

Online and Multiplayer Modes
The online mode is designed for solo players who still want an active social experience. You can chat with others, invite friends, and join rooms while continuing your own progress. Local 2-player mode lets two players use the same device, making it a fun option for shared sessions.

Customization and Events
Players can personalize their character with clothes, wings, and different bag styles. Special events also keep the game active, including Diamond Rain, Rainbow, Toxic, Volcano, and Candy themed events. These limited-time moments often create better chances for rare rewards.

Key Features
- Fast progression gameplay built around movement and rewards
- 14 areas with stronger rewards in later zones
- More than 75 collectible Brainrot characters
- 14 rarity classes from Common to Supreme
- Rare Celestial and timed Divine rewards
- Speed upgrades, rebirth system, and base expansion
- Online solo mode with chat, invites, and room joining
- Local 2-player mode on one device
- Character customization with clothes, wings, and bags
- Seasonal and rotating live events


Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online turns a simple lucky box concept into a more active and rewarding experience. With collection goals, movement-based progression, rare rewards, and social features, it offers a gameplay loop that feels easy to start and satisfying to improve over time.

Your goal is simple, but the situation is not: earn money while you wait, move up the line, and reach the mysterious toilet at the end. This is not just a “stand still” queue. This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn. Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What are some engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game has pleasant sound, but it is not necessary for progression.

A: There are many additional games within the VIP zone.

hits.title: Geometry Vibes X-Arrow
hits.description:
Geometry Vibes X Arrow is the newest evolution of the Geometry Vibes series, offering the most refined, competitive and customizable arrow experience so far. The goal is simple but demanding: guide your arrow through dangerous geometric paths, survive increasingly difficult patterns and reach the portal at the end of each route without touching anything. Every tap changes your altitude, every obstacle tests your timing and every mode challenges your mastery in different ways.

With five full game modes, multiplayer support, deep customization and endless replayability, Geometry Vibes X Arrow is designed for players who enjoy precise control, fast reactions and competitive challenges. Whether you are playing solo or competing against three friends on the same device, the game always feels fresh and pushes players toward improvement run after run.

What is the goal in Geometry Vibes X Arrow?
The main objective is to reach the portal without hitting any obstacle. Every game mode builds on this core idea with different variations and challenges.

How does Classic Mode differ from Spam Mode?
Classic Mode features handcrafted levels with fixed structures and increasing difficulty. Spam Mode is a survival challenge where the walls slowly close in. Players compare their longest survival times and try to extend their record on every attempt.

Is there local multiplayer?
Yes. You can play with 2 3 or 4 players on the same device. Each player uses separate keys. The race based competitive gameplay makes these modes fast and chaotic.

What can I do in Endless Mode?
Endless Mode is all about distance. The arrow accelerates and the level stretches infinitely. Your goal is to travel as far as possible before crashing. It is ideal for players who enjoy reaction based gameplay.

How difficult is Challenge Mode?
Challenge Mode contains five stages designed specifically for advanced players. These levels require strong timing, compact movements and consistent precision. Even small mistakes can end the run quickly.

What customization options are available?
You can unlock and equip arrow skins, trails and color combinations. With twenty four skins, sixteen trails and twenty four total color options, players can create many unique visual styles.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: Geometry Dash is a game where you need to progress through levels while avoiding obstacles.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game offers a variety of modes and challenges, being difficult and engaging.

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Coins, which can be spent on customization.

Q: What are the engaging elements of content (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The game itself is extremely popular and hooks players with its difficulty and challenges.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can change the player's shape and colors, with many skins available.


Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to incentivize players to return?
A: Yes, there are challenges.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?
A: You can play without sound, but the music is designed and set up to make the player vibe to the max during the gaming session.


Multiplayer

Q: Can you play with friends?
A: Yes, but only offline on the same computer.

hits.title: Sky Balls 3D
hits.description:
Sky Balls 3D is an exhilarating two-player casual sports game where you test your reactions and reflexes by guiding a ball on a narrow track thousands of meters in the sky, sometimes with guardrails... and sometimes not. You aim to keep the ball on track and avoid obstacles, traps, and gaps. While high in the sky, you not only have to avoid falling, but the real challenge is to do so while collecting coins and keys to unlock new ball skins and sky-boxes. Enjoy simple controls, stunning 3D graphics, and a choice of 1-player or 2-player modes across hundreds of challenging levels.

How to Play Sky Balls 3D
Let's say that Sky Balls 3D seems easier than it looks, and in the first few rounds, it's actually possible to coast through to the end without finding that perfect balance to avoid getting cast off the edge of the path. But once the obstacles start appearing, you will be forced to play tactically, so don't get too used to coasting.

There are multiple obstacles to look out for, like no guardrails, narrowing roads, curves, and excessive incline speed, not to mention road barriers, which you need to avoid or slightly navigate around.

Collect coins
Collect coins along the way for game upgrades, which include new sceneries, landscapes, and views.

Two players are better than one.
If you thought playing the game on your own was exhilarating, have a go at the 2-player gameplay with a friend. The game gets even more exciting as you try to focus on the speed and stability of your rolling ball while desperately trying not to look at how your opponent is doing. The game is fast-paced, and one moment where you lack focus may just throw you off, literally, off the board.

hits.title: Red-Blue Forge
hits.description:
Red-Blue Forge is a fast reaction arcade game where you rotate core orbs to match incoming embers and survive as long as possible. Start in classic 2-core mode (Red/Blue), then unlock 4-core mode (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow) for higher intensity and a x3 score multiplier. The game features smooth touch/mouse controls, quick sessions, and a “Ready” start gate so each run begins on your command.

Between runs, collected materials feed a persistent Forge Tree progression system. Temper upgrades to improve control, stability, scoring bonuses, and long-run mastery. Every match rewards precision and timing, while long-term progression gives players clear goals and replay value. Ideal for mobile and desktop, Red-Blue Forge combines skill-based gameplay, readable visuals, and satisfying build progression in short, addictive runs.
hits.howToPlayText: Tap/click left or right to rotate your core and match the color of incoming embers before they hit the center. Earn materials from runs, then spend them in the Forge Tree to unlock upgrades and, later, 4-core mode for all four colors and x3 score.

hits.title: Game of Warrior
hits.description:
Game of Warriors is a Strategy TD (Tower Defense) game with a unique style in its genre. Set in a magical world you will have to upgrade your defenses and mighty soldiers to survive and siege enemy territories to conquer them.

The rival alliance of the evil kingdoms has pushed what remains of the human civilization to a corner of the world, isolated and forgotten, plunged into misery and trying to survive harshly.

Ready the horses, hire your warriors and prepare the spears for battle, the war horn will sound again and our titans will destroy the enemy walls and towers.

The age of dark empires have come to an end, it's time to recover what rightfully belongs to us, it's time for revolt, war and revenge!

Features:

- Tower Defense (TD) and Strategy game style.
- 1500+ defensive waves.
- 100+ territories to conquer.
- 30+ soldiers to upgrade.
- 1000+ building upgrades.
- 4 different races to conquer (Goblins, Skeletons, Worgens and Orcs).

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: It's a strategic Tower Defense game. You need to upgrade your soldiers, fortress, and attack other territories, turning them into your colonies.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game that can hook players?

A: It's a strategic Tower Defense game with over 30 soldiers to upgrade, over 1000 building upgrades, 4 different races to defeat (goblins, skeletons, worgens, and orcs), and a unique upgrade tree.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there bosses, and how are they different?

A: Yes, every 10 waves you face a well-organized army of bosses that are more challenging than regular units.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: Yes, the game has currencies: gold and diamonds. You can use them to upgrade towers, warriors, attack lands, improve weapons, and more.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Earn coins by defeating enemies and collecting coins from colonies we have conquered. Use these coins to level up your warriors and structures.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what is the impact? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases where you can buy diamonds. These diamonds can be used to purchase numerous upgrades. Donations speed up game progress.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game well, but it is not necessary for gameplay.

hits.title: GT Cars Mega Ramps
hits.description:
GT Cars Mega Ramps is an exciting driving car game that puts you behind the wheel of fully customizable super-sport cars, featuring heart-stopping mega ramps, vibrant giant bosses, and intense head-to-head races. Experience a one-of-a-kind adventure as you launch yourself off towering ramps, execute daring stunts, and outmaneuver colossal bosses in electrifying showdowns. With stylized cars and thrilling gameplay, you’ll race to conquer the ultimate title of driver extraordinaire.

How to Play GT Cars Mega Ramps
GT Cars Mega Ramps offers three exhilarating game modes: Face to Face, Mega Ramps, and Color Lands. Choose between single-player and two-player options, allowing for competitive racing fun with customizable exotic super-sport cars that you can tweak to your liking. Adjust the color panel, window tint, wheel designs, and light colors to make your vehicle truly unique.

In Face to Face mode, you and your opponent race side by side, but don’t let the simplicity fool you. This isn’t just a regular race; if one car crashes, the debris can take you down at full speed, resulting in an instant game over. Stay alert and swerve wisely, or you risk tumbling off the cliff's edge!

Color Lands presents a vibrant challenge as you navigate through roads resembling colorful Lego blocks. Obstacles lurk at every turn, and if you’re not careful, slowing down could send you spiraling into an abyss.

Mega Ramps is the ultimate test of your driving skills, packed with high-speed thrills and perilous obstacles. Dodge enormous rolling balls threatening to crush you and navigate walls made of crates and geometric shapes flying at you from all directions. It’s a wild ride that requires quick reflexes and sharp focus—so buckle up and prepare for an unforgettable experience!

Pick a mode. Roll to the finish line without hitting the water. Collect coins along the track to unlock new balls, tail tracks, and sky packages. Race solo or go head-to-head against a second player on the same keyboard. Dozens of levels. One goal: cross that line first.

Controlling Your Ball
Single player uses W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys — your pick. Two-player mode splits the keyboard: Player 1 gets W, A, S, D, Player 2 gets the Arrow Keys. Controls snap tight. Physics do the rest. Edge too close? Into the water you go. These are Physics Games in the truest sense — momentum matters, every turn carries weight.

Coins, Unlocks, Progression
Every coin on the track counts. Grab enough and the unlock shop opens up — new ball skins, tail tracks, and sky packages waiting behind coin gates. No shortcuts here. Grind the levels, hit the coins, build your collection. Addictive rhythm. If the low-poly 3D style and coin-collecting loop pull you in, Golf Orbit runs a similar rewarding loop — skill pays off in currency every run.

Pro Tips for Staying Dry
Slow down on sharp corners — speed kills on elevated tracks. Hug the inside of turns. Don't chase coins near the edges early on; survive first, collect second. In 2-player mode, bump your opponent on wide sections — legal, chaotic, effective. Physics-curious players who love testing boundaries might also enjoy Playground Man! Ragdoll Show! for that same unpredictable engine energy. And if pure sandbox destruction scratches that itch, Melon Sandbox delivers zero rules and maximum chaos.

Key Features
Dual modes: Solo race or split-screen 2-player on one keyboard — instant couch competition.
Low-poly 3D visuals: Clean, lag-free look. Runs smooth on desktop and mobile browsers alike.
Coin unlocks: New balls, tail tracks, sky packages — all earned in-run, no paywalls.
Dozens of levels: Elevated tracks over water, realistic nature backdrops, escalating difficulty.
Unity engine: Real physics on every roll. Momentum, gravity, edge pressure — all calculated live.
Cross-platform: desktop browser, iOS, Android. No downloads. Click and play.

hits.title: Pixel Color Flow
hits.description:
Pixel Color Flow is a fun, satisfying color matching puzzle game where you clear a board of pixel cubes by sending cute pigs onto a conveyor. 
Each pig drops balls onto only the cubes of the same color, so your main challenge is choosing the right order and managing the queue to clean the board efficiently.

Every pig has an ammo count (shown as a number above its head). When it runs out, the pig leaves. If ammo is still left, the pig can move into one of 5 waiting slots, ready to be sent again when you tap. The conveyor also has a capacity limit, so smart timing matters don’t overflow it.
hits.howToPlayText:
Check the pixel board and spot which colors need clearing first.
Tap a pig to send it onto the conveyor.
The pig will shoot/drop balls automatically onto matching color cubes only.
Watch the ammo number above the pig—each shot uses ammo.
When ammo becomes 0, the pig leaves the run.
If it still has ammo, it can move into one of 5 waiting slots.
Tap again to send pigs from the waiting slots back onto the conveyor.
Manage the conveyor capacity (if it’s full, you must wait).
Keep repeating until you clear all cubes and complete the level.

hits.title: PVZ Fusion Cheats
hits.description:
Check out the new version of Plants vs Zombies – everything is new here, but the classics are still there!

Now you can not only fight off zombies with the help of your green friends, but also make cool hybrid plants. These are plants that combine the powers of two or even more ordinary plants.

With these hybrids, you'll get a bunch of new chips to deal with zombies that have become even cooler, smarter, and more cunning!

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Selection: Combine plants to create unique species with their own abilities and appearances.  
• Challenges: Test your skills in various challenges that will provide new experiences and challenge your tactics.  
• Cheats: Cheats let you go wild: take as many sun points as you want and plant as many plants as you can.  
• Skins: You can purchase skins for your plants themed around popular memes.

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points: The in-game currency that allows you to buy plants and place them in your garden. Sometimes they may fall from the sky, or sunflowers may give them to you. You can also obtain them by pressing the cheats button.  
• Dollars: In-game currency that can be spent on bonuses (e.g., cooldown-free gloves) or to buy new challenges. You can earn dollars by completing levels, from daily rewards, or by purchasing them with Gam.  
• Gam: Premium currency used to buy dollars or skins.

Game Modes:
• Adventure: A more classic mode with basic challenges. Completing a level in this mode unlocks a new one with tougher opponents and possibly a different appearance.  
• Challenges: A mode that offers new experiences. Each challenge can surprise you. For example, in one challenge, you can play as a zombie.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Nut: Holds back zombies in front of you, buying time to fend off the attack.  
• It's fine Nut: A skin inspired by the "It's fine" meme.

Story / Setting:
The setting is a zombie apocalypse where hordes of zombies are trying to break into your home.

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: The game is about defending your garden from hordes of zombies. Build defenses with various plants, devise unique tactics, and protect your garden from waves of monsters.

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: Do not let the zombies break into your home. You need to prepare to fend off all waves and achieve victory.

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?  
A: You can start combining plants right from the first minutes of the game, creating unique combinations. Each one can produce a special plant with its own abilities and distinctive traits.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: You will find many levels: from quite familiar to levels with special challenges. Completing a level unlocks a new one, and so on.

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: As you progress through the game, new levels with tougher opponents become available.

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Yes, you can adjust the difficulty in the game based on your readiness.

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: The game features free progression. Thanks to the cheat feature, you can give yourself as much currency as you want. With it, you can buy plants to defend your garden, so there are no barriers to how many plants you want to purchase.

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: You can buy bonuses and skins in the game. For example, a time acceleration x3 or a skin for a plant.

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Yes, you can purchase various skins for your plants in the game.

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: Most plants in the game are available from the start, allowing for great opportunities for unique combinations from the first levels.

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: You can play without sound. The game is intuitive, so sound is not essential. However, with sound, you will immerse yourself better in the world.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: Yes, there is a brief tutorial at the beginning that provides basic knowledge. It does not overwhelm with information. After that, you immediately start playing a level, testing your knowledge in practice and discovering new possibilities.

hits.title: Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro!
hits.description:
Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro! — a fun snowy adventure where you play solo or with a friend, leveling up your tree to make it the coolest in the world! Collect rare toys, play mini-games, and show everyone your tree is the top 🎄❄️

❄️ What’s waiting for you:
• Play solo or co-op on one device 🤝
• Toy collection — from common to ultra-rare, decorate and upgrade your tree 💎
• Crafting — combine items to make legendary decorations 🔧✨
• Mini-games — earn coins, boosts, and rewards 🎮
• Snow battles — throw snowballs and have fun ☃️💥
• Huge tree — level it up and make it even cooler 🎄🔥
• Leaderboard — the more epic your tree and collection, the higher you climb 🏆
• Daily bonuses — gifts and freebies every day 🎁

Collect toys, craft the best decorations, and turn your tree into a legendary snowy world icon ❄️👑
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about, and what do you do?
A: It is a 2D game where you grow and decorate your own Christmas tree by playing various mini-games. You earn ""gifts"" as currency, and the larger your tree grows, the more rewards you receive.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: Not exactly, but the premise is that you need to save Christmas and help Santa.

Q: What is the game's unique hook? What will draw players in?
A: It features Minecraft references, a wide variety of mini-games and rewards, high-quality graphics, and a local co-op mode to play with a friend on one screen. There is also a wheel of fortune, character skins, and a crafting system for Christmas ornaments.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: Minecraft-inspired references and themes.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? How can players level up faster?
A: Play mini-games to earn ""Bucks,"" then use them to upgrade and grow your Christmas tree.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main gameplay?
A: Yes, there are many mini-games, including catching falling Bucks while dodging bombs, delivering gifts and coal to houses, throwing snowballs at targets, and defending sweets from zombies.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: There is an in-game currency called ""Bucks"" used to water the tree, upgrade ornaments for earning boosts, and level up mini-games. There is also a ""Gifts"" currency used to purchase more Christmas tree decorations.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and does it affect progression?
A: Yes, you can purchase various ""Bucks"" packs as well as character skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are available?
A: Yes, your rank is determined by how much and how quickly you earn from your Christmas tree.

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar retention mechanics?
A: Yes, there is a reward system that grants prizes for every 5 minutes of playtime.

Q: Is it better to play with sound on, or can the game be completed without it?
A: It is not required, but playing with sound adds significantly to the festive atmosphere.
hits.howToPlayText:
Play together on one device — each controls their own character while leveling up the tree and causing snowy chaos! ❄️🎄

🎮 Player 1 Controls:
• A / S / D — move
• W — jump
• Q — action
The rest you’ll figure out on the fly 😉

🎮 Player 2 Controls:
• ← / ↓ / → — move
• ↑ — jump
• Enter — action
Everything else is pretty intuitive 😎

Work as a team, throw snowballs, play mini-games, and make your tree the coolest ever! ☃️🔥

Sprunki: Collect All Characters! — a dynamic platformer where dangerous levels, skillful jumps, and the hunt for rare heroes await you! Complete challenging stages, collect items, and unlock more and more characters from the world of Sprunki. Can you become number one in the rankings? 🔥

🏃‍♂️ What awaits you:
• Exciting platformer gameplay — run, jump, and survive on dangerous levels ⚡
• Moving platforms and traps — test your reaction and skills 😈
• Ropes, gaps, and obstacles — every level brings a new challenge 🎭
• Character collection — unlock unique heroes from the Sprunki world ✨
• Tough moments — only the most skilled will reach the end 💪
• Player rankings — compete with others and become the best 🏆
• Fun boosters — move faster, jump higher, and play even cooler 🚀

Collect all characters, overcome every challenge, and prove that you are the true hero of the Sprunki world! 👑
[Core Gameplay & Story\]
Q: What is the game about and what do you do?
A: It is a 2D platformer where you jump across various platforms to find and collect all the Sprunkis for your collection. You must navigate obstacles and plan your moves to reach specific platforms and collect special items. Each item belongs to a specific Sprunki; you need to collect 10 items of the same type to find and unlock that Sprunki for your collection.

Q: What is the game's standout feature and why will it appeal to players?
A: The game features high-quality polish, beautiful graphics, and a wide variety of features that keep the gameplay feeling fresh and diverse.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: The Sprunkis themselves are the main draw.

\[Economy & Customization\]
Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game? Does spending money speed up progress?
A: Yes, you can purchase an ad-free experience as well as unlimited boosts, such as the magnet, double jump, and increased movement speed.

\[Retention & Engagement\]
Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are available?
A: Yes, there are leaderboards. Your score and ranking are determined by how many Sprunki unlock items you have collected.

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to keep players coming back?
A: There are rewards granted for every 5 minutes of play that refresh when you restart the game. these consist of boosts like the magnet, double jump, and movement speed.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for better immersion, or will playing without it make the game difficult?
A: It is not required, but the sound design is high quality and enhances the experience.

• Q — Interact

📱 Mobile Controls:

hits.title: Papa Cherry Saga
hits.description:
Welcome to the world of sweets! Papa Cherry Saga is a colourful match-3 puzzle where you collect cookies, marshmallows, chocolate, and other treats.

Swap pieces to make a row of 3 or more of the same kind. Match 4 in a line to create a Striped Cookie. Match 4 in a T or L shape to make a Bomb. Match 5 in a row to get a Rainbow Bomb that clears all pieces of one color.

Combine power-ups together for devastating effects. Charge up the Chef by activating power-ups on the field, and he will reward you with a bonus.

Hundreds of levels with varied goals: collect specific sweets, break obstacles, guide gingerbread cookies to the bottom. Use boosters like the Glove, Rolling Pin, Lollipop, and Undo to beat the toughest challenges.
hits.howToPlayText:
Drag a piece toward an adjacent one to swap them. If the swap creates a match of 3 or more identical pieces in a row or column, they are collected and new ones drop in.

Match 4 in a line to create a Striped Cookie that clears an entire row or column. Match 4 in a T or L shape to make a Bomb that explodes in a 3x3 area. Match 5 in a row to get a Rainbow Bomb that clears all pieces of one color. Combine power-ups together for even stronger effects.

Activate power-ups on the field to charge the Chef — once full, he sends a bonus power-up to the board.

Use the boosters at the bottom of the screen — they do not cost a move. The Glove removes any single piece. The Rolling Pin clears one row and one column. The Lollipop removes all pieces of a chosen color. Undo rewinds the last move.

"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?
A: It is an RPG where you fight through hordes of enemies to complete levels, unlock new skills, areas, and weapons.

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: There isn't a traditional narrative, but the objective is clear: unlock new territories and defeat bosses.

Q: What makes this game unique? Why would players be interested?
A: There are very few games like this, especially with a stylish cyberpunk archer theme. It features built-in mini-games, great graphics, varied missions, and deep character customization and progression.

Q: What are the most engaging elements of the game?
A: The internal mini-games, a wide variety of weapons, clear objectives, and simple, intuitive gameplay mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses and how do they differ?
A: Yes, but the bosses are relatively easy. They act as guardians stationed at the entrances to new cities.

Q: How does the progression system work? How can you level up faster?
A: You level up by defeating enemies. You can also choose bonuses and find upgrades in crates.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Money is used to unlock new territories, upgrade your character, and purchase new clothing.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game?
A: You can spend money on clothing and unlocking new firearms.

Q: Is there customization? Can you change your hero's appearance, use a map editor, or tune vehicles?
A: Yes, you can purchase various outfits and weapons for your character.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to keep players coming back?
A: Yes, logging in every day provides bonuses such as gear or currency.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for immersion, or is it possible to play without it?
A: The music is a great addition to the atmosphere, but it is not required to progress through the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What kind of achievements are there and how are they earned?
A: You can earn achievements for daily logins."

hits.title: Cyberpunk Block Puzzle
hits.description:
Cyberpunk Block Puzzle is a stylish logic game set on a neon circuit board. Slide glowing blocks across the grid to
  deliver them to matching colored connectors. Each block moves only along its axis — you'll need to think several moves
   ahead.

  70+ levels with increasing difficulty: walls, ice blocks, and locks on grids from 5×5 to 8×9. Earn chips, climb the
  hacker ranks from Noob to Hack Guru, and take on a fresh daily challenge every day.

  A smart hint system keeps you moving, while neon glow effects and juicy animations reward every move. Easy to start —
  hard to put down.
hits.howToPlayText:
Slide your way through the neon grid! Your goal is to move all glowing blocks into their matching colored connectors on the edges of the board. Plan each move carefully — blocks only slide along one axis and can block each other's path. Clear the entire board to complete the level.

  Desktop Controls:
  - Mouse Click & Drag: Grab a block and slide it along its axis.
  - Release: Drop the block into position.

  Mobile Controls:
  - Touch & Drag: Tap a block and swipe to slide it horizontally or vertically.
  - Release: Lift your finger to drop the block into place.

  Tips:
  - Think ahead — moving one block may open or block the path for another.
  - Stuck? Wait a few seconds and the built-in hint system will highlight your next move.
  - Earn chips by completing levels and climb the hacker ranks from Noob to Hack Guru.
  - Come back daily for a unique new puzzle challenge.

hits.description: Pirates Tiles Challenge is a delightful tile-matching puzzle game with a vibrant pirate adventure theme. The core gameplay revolves around scanning a grid of pirate icons (flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, etc.) to find identical pairs and connect them using at most 3 straight lines without the path being blocked by other tiles — a classic “Mahjong Solitaire-style” matching rule that demands spatial awareness and quick thinking. Become a Pirate Legend!

In this delightful tile-matching puzzle game, you’ll scan the grid of pirate icons — flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, pistols, compasses and more — to find identical pairs and connect them with  at most 3 straight lines without the path being blocked. Match all tiles to clear the board, earn up to 3 stars, and conquer hundreds of progressively challenging levels in a vibrant pirate adventure atmosphere!

Desktop Controls:
Mouse: Click the first tile, then click the matching tile to connect them (valid path with ≤3 lines will automatically link).  
Hint Button: Click the lightbulb icon for help.  
Pause: Click the pause button.

Mobile Controls:
Tap: Tap the first tile, then tap the identical tile to match them (the game checks for a valid path with maximum 3 lines).  
Hint Button: Tap the lightbulb icon.  
Pause: Tap the pause button.

hits.title: Plants vs Zombies Fusion Mode
hits.description:
Welcome to the updated world of Plants vs. Zombies, where innovation is intertwined with tradition!

In this game, you have the opportunity not only to defend your home from zombies with the help of an army of plants, but also to create unique hybrid plants that combine the abilities of two or more original plants.

These hybrids give you unlimited tactical options to fight new waves of zombies that have become smarter, stronger, and more cunning!

Controls:
Desktop: Mouse: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.  
Mobile: Finger: select plants, click buttons, place plants, use bonuses, collect items.

Key Features:
• Crossbreed Plants!: Combine plants to create unique specimens! They will surprise you with their appearance and abilities, and can pose a serious threat to zombies!  
• Meme Skins.: Dress your plants in skins. Some are inspired by popular memes!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Sun Points.: Earn them through sunflowers and purchase plants in-game to strengthen your defense!  
• Dollars.: Earn them by completing levels! You can use them to buy bonuses, challenges, and special plants in the shop!  
• Premium Currency.: Purchase special skins for your favorite plants!

Game Modes:
• Adventure: Defend your home by fending off waves, level by level, and defeat bosses by planting an unbreakable defense with your plants!  
• Challenges: Special levels with unique trials. Play as zombies or fend off monster attacks using only plants from gifts — you never know which plant you’ll get! There are challenges for every taste.

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Cabbage Pult: A plant that launches a cabbage head straight at zombies. The enemy won't know what hit them when it lands on their head!  
• Torch Wood: Helps turn projectiles launched by other plants into fiery ones! Roast those monsters!

Enemies / Bosses:
• Zombie Door.: Look out. This zombie had the clever idea to take a door and use it as a shield! I wonder what he'll do when your plants break it.  
• Super Driver Zombie.: Beware! This zombie is charging straight at you. Destroy him quickly before he crushes your plants! Deal as much damage as you can, and fast!

Story / Setting:
The zombie apocalypse has begun. The world is crawling with monsters eager for brains! Protect your home by planting living plants!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: The zombie apocalypse has arrived! Zombies are taking over this world. Your plants can stop them! Plant your backyard defense to keep them from reaching your home!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: Don’t let the zombies into the house! Plant lines of defense with different plants to stop them and destroy all waves of monsters!

Q: What hooks you in the first few minutes?  
A: The pleasant music immerses you in this world. And if you find yourself short on plants, you can create unique species by combining them! They will differ not only in appearance but also in abilities!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: Levels follow one after another, keeping boredom at bay. Each new level will introduce you to new plants and enemies!

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Each subsequent level is harder than the last. You’ll need to strategize your defense and crossbreed plants to withstand the zombie onslaught!

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: Plant more sunflowers! They give you sun points, which you can use to buy plants for your defense. Don’t hold back. Zombies won’t spare any effort to break through to you!

Q: What unlocks as you progress?  
A: New plants, along with new combinations, which will give you unique species with their own abilities.

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: Purchase bonuses that will help you in the game. For example, speed up the game by 3 times if you want a faster pace. Special plants are also available in the shop.

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: Unlock skins for your plants! Many of them are themed around popular memes. Even zombies won’t be indifferent to them!

Q: What is available from the start?  
A: The Peashooter and Sunflower. The most basic plants, but indispensable in battle. Sunflowers will provide you with sun points to buy new plants, while the Peashooter is your loyal and brave guardian. It shoots peas and stops zombies trying to get into the house.

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there daily rewards / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Earn daily rewards for logging in! It’s always nice to return, as a surprise awaits you!

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: Want to play in silence? No one will stop you from doing that.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: The first levels of the game will introduce you to all the mechanics and plants, so you can quickly understand how to build your defense effectively. You’ll grasp everything within the first levels!
hits.howToPlayText:
Place hybrids and other plants on the field to defend against waves of zombies. Considering their cost and recharge.
Zombies are getting stronger, so adapt, combine plants, and develop your strategy.

hits.title: Copy the Drawing
hits.description:
An exciting drawing game with hundreds of levels! Look at the example and recreate the drawing on the canvas — the more accurate, the higher your score.

The game features 300 levels across 18 categories: from simple shapes to animals, transport, space, fantasy, and Japanese culture. Every day brings a new drawing of the day — build your streak and compete with yourself!

Three brush sizes, undo last stroke, hints, and a medal system — all designed to make drawing fun and enjoyable. Gold, silver, or bronze — which medal will your drawing earn?
hits.howToPlayText:
1. Choose a category and level
2. Look at the example at the top of the screen
3. Draw the same picture on the canvas below
4. Use three brush sizes for precise lines
5. Tap "Undo" to remove the last stroke, or "Clear" to start over
6. When you're happy with the result, tap "Check"

hits.title: Arrows Out!
hits.description:
Arrow Escape is a puzzle game that delivers fast-paced, strategic challenges for players who enjoy logic-driven gameplay and intense escape scenarios. Each level is a tricky arrow maze puzzle where you must carefully study the arrow paths and decide which arrow to tap first in order to clear the board. One correct move can open the way forward, while a single mistake can trigger a chain reaction that costs you a heart.

As you progress, the game evolves into a full arrow maze escape experience featuring twisting paths, looping routes, and increasingly complex layouts. Some stages feel like isolated arrow-filled arenas where every direction represents either danger or opportunity, turning each decision into a tense test of planning and precision.

The core mechanic revolves around tapping arrows out in the correct order. When arrows collide, you lose a heart, and with only three hearts available, every move matters. Make three mistakes and the attempt ends immediately, pushing you to think carefully before each tap. To complete a level, you must clear all arrows before time runs out, creating a high-pressure challenge that tests both focus and reaction speed.

Gameplay blends intuitive tap and swipe controls with advanced puzzle mechanics, encouraging players to adapt their strategy as new movement patterns and hazards appear. Certain levels demand quick thinking and precise timing, rewarding players who can stay calm under pressure.

More than a simple arrow puzzle, Arrow Escape is a layered challenge of strategy, speed, and skill. Whether you’re navigating a dense arrow maze, solving a tight exit puzzle, or racing against the clock in a last-second escape, every level pushes your problem-solving abilities to the limit.

hits.title: Purrfect Match
hits.description:
Welcome to a cozy casual match-3 game with cats, created for relaxation and pleasant emotions.

In this match-3 puzzle, you connect identical cats by drawing a continuous line across the board using your finger or mouse. You can create combinations of three or more tiles horizontally, vertically, or in an L shape. Diagonal connections are not allowed, so each move requires attention and planning.

The game has no rush — you play at a comfortable pace, enjoying the cute visual style and warm, relaxing atmosphere. Each level offers a new objective and gradually increases in difficulty while maintaining a balanced and enjoyable experience.

Bright 2D graphics, soft colors, and adorable cats make the game perfect for unwinding. The vertical layout is ideal for mobile devices and one-handed play. The game is suitable for all ages and will especially appeal to fans of cats and relaxing puzzle games.
hits.howToPlayText:
To make a move, draw a line through three or more identical cats by swiping your finger or mouse across the board. Connections can be made horizontally, vertically, or in an L shape. Diagonal lines are not counted.

When the line is completed, the selected cats disappear from the board, making space for new tiles. The longer the combination, the more effective the result and the faster you progress toward the level goal.

Each level has a specific objective — for example, reaching a target score or clearing certain cats. The number of moves may be limited, so it’s important to plan your connection path in advance.

Controls are intuitive and perfectly adapted for a vertical screen. The game does not require fast reactions, making it ideal for calm, stress-free play anytime.

hits.description:
A HYBRID ARCADE GAME OF PINBALL & BASKETBALL

-Flip the flippers and try to hit the ball into the basket.  
-Play against the CPU or another player on the same device.  
-Perfect your technique in the Academy - 100 increasingly challenging "assists" for you to try to score from.
hits.howToPlayText:
You control one set of flippers - either red or blue.  Flipping uses just one button and flips all five of your flippers.  See if you have what it takes to beat the computer.  The default settings are "AMATEUR" speed against the computer on "EASY" difficulty with "AIM ASSIST" enabled (this gives you a little help with shot accuracy).  Once you feel comfortable, try the other difficulties, "PROFFESSIONAL" speed, then switch "AIM ASSIST" off!

If that's not enough, try the "FLIPPEE ACADEMY" - 100 levels (50 each at "AMATEUR" & "PROFESSIONAL" speeds) where the ball is launched and you must try to score - but each level only allows for a certain number of touches - and you must score before the ball hits your opponent's flippers.

Navigate menus using:
- Mouse
- Touch
- Keyboard (arrow keys and space to action)
- Controller - direction pad and any of the main four buttons

Use the game mode button to the left of the scoreboard to select between 7 game modes:

- Longest Streak - see how many games in a row you can win against the computer:
  - Easy
  - Medium
  - Hard
  - Progressive (difficulty increases with every game)
- Career - difficulty increases with every game, but losing doesn't reset progress
- Player v Player - play against another human on the same device
- Academy - 100 "assists" for you to try to score from 

To flip:

Single player:
- Mouse - click the screen
- Touch - tap the screen
- Keyboard - LEFT CTRL
- Controller - any of the four main buttons

Player vs Player:
- Mouse - click the top left or top right of the screen to control either the left or right flippers
- Touch - tap the top left or top right of the screen
- Keyboard - LEFT CTRL (left flipper) & RIGHT ARROW (right flippers)
- Controller - any of the four main buttons (supports 2 controllers for player v player)

To pause:

- Mouse - click the scoreboard
- Touch - tap the scoreboard
- Keyboard - Press "P"
- Controller - "Start" button

To win:

SCORE MORE THAN YOUR OPPONENT!

Change the game speed from "AMATEUR" to "PROFESSIONAL" and disable "AIM ASSIST" (if you're up for a challeng!) in the SETTINGS menu.
A quick start guide is shown when the game is first run and full instructions can be found in the built-in help guide.

hits.howToPlayText:
HOW TO PLAY MERGE PUZZLE - 2048 BLOCKS

BASIC GAMEPLAY:

1. TAP TO SELECT
Tap any numbered tile on the board. All connected tiles with the same number will be highlighted. Tiles connect horizontally, vertically, and diagonally.

2. MERGE TILES
Tap again to merge all highlighted tiles into one. The merged tile appears at your tap location with a higher value. The more tiles you connect, the higher the resulting number!

3. SCORE POINTS
Each merge earns points based on the tiles merged. Create bigger combinations for massive scores. Chain reactions happen automatically when new merge opportunities appear after tiles fall.

4. REACH THE GOAL
In level mode, reach the target tile value (shown at the top) before running out of moves. In endless mode, keep merging and try to achieve the highest score possible.


MERGE FORMULA:

The game uses a special merge formula that rewards connecting more tiles:
- 2 tiles: Value doubles (2+2 = 4)
- 3-4 tiles: Value quadruples (2+2+2 = 8)
- 5-6 tiles: Value multiplies by 8 (2+2+2+2+2 = 16)
- 7+ tiles: Even bigger multipliers!

Tip: Always look for the largest groups of matching tiles for maximum points!


GAME MODES:

Level Mode
- Complete 40 levels across 4 collections
- Each level has a target tile and limited moves
- Progress unlocks new challenges

Endless Mode
- No move limit - play until the board fills up
- Try to reach the highest tile possible
- Compete on global leaderboards

Daily Challenge
- New puzzle every day for all players
- Same puzzle worldwide - compare your skills
- Special daily leaderboard


POWER-UPS:

UNDO (50 coins)
Made a mistake? Undo your last move and try a different strategy.

HAMMER (50 coins)
Remove any single tile from the board. Great for clearing blockers or setting up big merges.

SHUFFLE (50 coins)
Rearrange all tiles randomly. Use when no good moves are available.


TIPS FOR HIGH SCORES:

1. Plan Ahead
Look at the entire board before making a move. Find the largest possible group of matching tiles.

2. Work from the Bottom
Focus on merging tiles at the bottom of the board. This creates space for new tiles to fall and potentially form chains.

3. Create Chain Reactions
Position tiles so that after one merge, falling tiles create new matching groups automatically.

4. Save Power-Ups
Don't use power-ups too early. Save them for difficult situations in later levels.

5. Connect Diagonals
Remember tiles connect diagonally too! Look for diagonal chains that other players might miss.

6. Build Big Numbers
Higher value tiles are harder to match but worth more points. Try to build toward the corners where they won't block other merges.

hits.title: 4 Clues 1 Word
hits.description:
Think you’re a master of language? Put your lateral thinking to the test with 4 Clues 1 Word, the word puzzle game that goes beyond the surface. Most games ask you to find a simple object; we ask you to find the hidden connection between worlds.

Whether it’s the Stock in a financial market, a pot of Stock on a stove, or the Stock in a warehouse—your job is to find the one word that rules them all. Featuring stunning, high-definition photography and curated levels ranging from "Casual" to "Mind-Bending," 4 Clues 1 Word is designed for the curious, the clever, and the linguistically brave.

It’s not just a game; it’s a workout for your synapses. Can you see the pattern?
hits.howToPlayText:
Observe the Imagery: Each level presents you with three or four distinct images. Look closely—one might be a physical object, another an abstract concept, and the third an action.

Find the Common Thread: Identify the single word that applies to all images. Remember: we love polysemy (words with multiple meanings). A "Draft" could be a cold breeze or a rough sketch of a masterpiece.

Type Your Answer: Use the provided letter tiles to spell out the word.sss

Use Your Intuition (and Hints): Stuck on a particularly "Hard" level?

Expose a Letter: Reveal a single correct letter in the word.

Remove Tiles: Get rid of letters that aren't part of the solution.

Climb the Ranks: Progress through hundreds of levels. The further you go, the more abstract the connections become.

Pro Tip: If you're stuck, try saying the names of the objects out loud. Sometimes the ear catches what the eye misses!

hits.description:
Mahjong Lines is an engaging logic puzzle game in the mahjong connect genre, where you need to find and connect pairs of matching tiles using simple and intuitive rules.

Enjoy classic mahjong gameplay in a comfortable format: all tiles are placed on a single level, and your goal is to clear the board by connecting identical tiles. A valid path between tiles can be drawn freely, but it must consist of no more than three straight lines (up to two turns).

The game is perfect for both short relaxing sessions and thoughtful, strategic play.
Mahjong Lines combines a calm atmosphere, clear rules, and gradual difficulty progression, making it enjoyable for both beginners and experienced players.

Game features:

🀄A large number of unique levels

🀄Classic Mahjong tiles

🀄Simple and easy-to-learn rules

🀄Hints and shuffle options

🀄Full-screen gameplay
hits.howToPlayText:
The rules of Mahjong Lines are simple and intuitive:

🀄Tap on two identical tiles.

🀄Tiles can be removed if a path of no more than three straight lines can be built between them.

🀄The connecting line may pass only through empty cells.

🀄The connected pair disappears from the board.

🀄To complete a level, you need to remove all tiles.

🀄Use hints if you can’t find available moves and clear the board step by step, carefully planning each connection.

hits.title: Shape Ascent - Roguelite
hits.description: Shape Ascent is a strategic puzzle game inspired by 2048, where you merge geometric shapes on a 5×5 grid to reach the legendary Ascent Crown. Starting with simple Triangles and Squares, you'll combine matching shapes by swiping in four directions — merging them into Pentagons, Hexagons, Stars, Crystals, Essences, and ultimately the Ascent Crown (8128). What makes Shape Ascent unique is its roguelike card system: every few moves, you're offered a choice of Power Cards with Common, Rare, and Epic abilities — from Score Boosts and Merge Bonuses to Emergency Saves and Auto-Cleanse effects that permanently alter your run. Manage your Undo charges, use the Remove Tile tool wisely, and plan every swipe to avoid filling the board. With 13 shape tiers, stackable card effects, milestone celebrations, and a save system that lets you continue where you left off, Shape Ascent blends classic merge puzzle satisfaction with strategic depth and replayability. Available in 6 languages.
hits.howToPlayText:
Merge Shapes to Reach the Crown!
In Shape Ascent, your goal is to merge identical shapes on a 5×5 grid to create higher-tier shapes and chase the ultimate prize — the Ascent Crown (8128). Two matching shapes combine into the next tier when they collide. Plan your moves carefully: when the board fills up with no possible merges, it's game over!

Every few moves, you'll be offered a choice of Power Cards with unique abilities. Choose wisely — cards like Score Boost, Star Boost, Spawn Block, and Emergency Save can change the course of your run. Use the Undo button to reverse a mistake, or the Remove Tile tool (unlocked at Triple Star) to clear an unwanted piece from the board.

hits.title: Nuts Puzzle: Sort By Color
hits.description:
Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color is a classic puzzle game where you sort various colored nuts onto screws until they are all the same color.

As you progress through the levels, the puzzles get trickier, requiring you to plan your moves carefully and think several steps ahead. With each successful sort, you'll feel a satisfying sense of accomplishment. Get ready to test your strategy and problem-solving skills as you work your way through increasingly complex and colorful challenges!
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players need to do?
A: It is a puzzle game where players sort color-coded nuts onto matching bolts.

Q: What is the unique selling point of the game? What makes it engaging for players?
A: The beautiful, vibrant visuals and a progression system where players not only sort nuts but also fix their garden by gradually ""repairing"" the flowers.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The beautiful, vibrant visuals and a progression system where players not only sort nuts but also fix their garden by gradually ""repairing"" the flowers.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What are the currencies and what are they spent on (standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: There are Coins, which can be spent on in-game power-ups, such as an extra bolt for sorting nuts. There is also a separate currency, Nuts, which can be spent on ""repairing"" the garden.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or anything similar that encourages players to return?
A: There is a money piggy bank, and Coins are collected while the player is away from the game. Additionally, there is a Chest that can be opened upon reaching certain in-game levels, which can drop rewards like game bonuses and in-game currency.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties in completing levels?
A: It is not necessary.
hits.howToPlayText:
Organize the nuts

To play Nuts Puzzle: Sort by Color, start by tapping on the nut you want to move, then select the screw where you want to place it. You can only place a nut on another screw if it’s either empty or if the top nut on that screw matches the color of the nut you’re moving. This simple rule sets the stage for the puzzle-solving challenge, as you’ll need to strategically plan your moves to ensure each screw ends up with nuts of a single color.
As you progress, the game introduces more nuts and a wider range of colors, making the puzzles increasingly complex. New challenges, such as hard mode levels, add an extra layer of difficulty by hiding the color of nuts until you move a piece from above them. These added twists will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills as you work through each level, striving to complete the puzzle with fewer moves and greater efficiency.

Use helpers

It’s at this point that you may need to use the undo, reset, and extra screw options, which are available on every level. However, you can only win extra screws from chests and from the winner's wheel. Clicking the screw icon adds an extra screw to free up more space. The undo button has a finite number of uses, but these are restored on each level. You can use the reset button to start the level over from scratch if you have no choice.

hits.title: Far Orion: New worlds
hits.description:
The year is 2121. Technology has advanced far beyond the bounds of our wildest fantasies, but great progress demands great sacrifice... 
Explore other worlds in the search for treasure and limitless power! 
Command a team of brave heroes and lead your world to victory!  
Game features: 
- several dozen unique heroes and battle cards 
- dozens of missions on every world 
- no irritating ads 
- PvP arena 
- tower mode 
- clans and clan wars
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an action strategy game where you complete levels (missions) and fight enemies.

Q: Does the game have a storyline?
A: Yes, there is a story. It's a sci-fi setting in the year 2121 with advanced technology, but something went wrong, and the heroes want to save the world.

Q: What is the game's unique selling point? What can hook players?
A: There are many different heroes with an upgrade system, a large number of missions, a PvP arena, a leaderboard, and clan wars. You can also upgrade attack cards.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: A huge variety of heroes, many different and interesting abilities for these heroes, an engaging story, clear objectives, and simple in-game mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses and how do they differ?
A: There are bosses throughout the storyline, and they differ in design, attack types, and HP amount.

Q: How exactly does progression work? What should you do to level up faster?
A: To level up faster, you need to play well to earn enough in-game currency. The game is easy to play.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main story? For example, 'match-three' puzzles within the strategy game.
A: No.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What are the currencies and what are they spent on (standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on upgrading heroes, upgrading cards, and buying hero cards to unlock them.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and what does it affect? Does spending money speed up game progress?
A: Yes, microtransactions will speed up game progress, as you can buy in-game currency with real money and spend that currency on upgrades and cards.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize a hero's appearance, location editor, vehicle tuning, etc.?
A: You can only upgrade the heroes' levels and abilities, which also changes their appearance.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you get on them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: There are various leaderboards depending on the different game modes, as well as a clan leaderboard. You need to play and gain levels.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages the player to return?
A: Yes, logging into the game every day provides various bonuses: cards, chests, and in-game currency.

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties?
A: The music is good and complements the game, but it is not essential for completing the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Achievements are awarded for daily logins, reaching a certain level in a specific mode, and completing certain objectives, such as collecting 6 heroes in total. Rewards include chests, in-game currency, and cards.

 How do I earn gold?
- by completing missions and daily quests, and fighting in the tower and the aren

hits.description:
Shadowstick Ninja is a physics puzzle game with a dark, minimalist style. In this game, precision is more important than speed.

You play as a silent shadow ninja with only a few arrows. In each level, enemy ninjas hide behind obstacles and structures, waiting for you to take them out. Your goal is to eliminate every enemy. 

The way you do it is up to you!

Pull back, aim, and release to shoot arrows with the right trajectory. Pick from different arrow types and solve each level your own way:

- Regular arrows for clean, direct hits
- Bomb arrows to cause explosive area damage and break through obstacles
- Balloon arrows that attach to enemies and lift them into the air, exposing them for easier shots

There isn’t just one right answer. You can play smart and efficient, or try out new ideas and experiment as much as you want.

Lift an enemy into the air with balloons. Use lots of bombs just to see what happens. Try odd angles, mix up different moves, or come up with wild solutions.

Every arrow counts. If you run out of ammo, you’ll need to rethink your strategy and give it another shot.

Plan your moves, try bold ideas, and enjoy every physics-based takedown.

Survivors arrive one by one. Your job is to inspect their bodies, scan for symptoms and decide their fate:
send to camp, quarantine, or eliminate.

"Core: A high-stakes social deduction and resource management game set during a global zombie epidemic, where players must identify and neutralize infected individuals to secure the survival of the human race in an underground bunker.
Loop: Progression is driven by successful identification and correct processing of incoming individuals. Flawless daily performance (correctly determining the infected from the healthy) is rewarded with in-game currency, fostering a cycle of precision and reward.
Start: A comprehensive tutorial module ensures immediate accessibility and full comprehension of the core mechanics. The high-stakes premise—total responsibility for humanity's future—provides a powerful, immediate retention hook.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a stylized, cartoon art direction.
Key Feature: A genre-defining blend of deduction mechanics, demanding constant vigilance from players to prevent a single missed symptom from compromising the entire bunker and ending humanity."

Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Go play golf! Hit the ball as far as possible and try to get it into the holes.

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Get the ball into the holes or the green zones, then take another shot. Aim more accurately to avoid missing, or you'll have to start over!

hits.howToPlayText:
The key to Golf Orbit is to aim and hit the golf ball as far as possible. This one-button game has relatively easy gameplay, but getting that perfect shot can be challenging. Tap and hold your left mouse button to set the power and release to hit the ball. As the ball soars, it bounces off various objects, gaining extra distance but, if you hit a perfect shot, the ball can destroy the obstacles it faces, including trees and buildings.

As in regular golf, if your ball ends in water or in sand bunkers

Your distance will be recorded with each shot, keeping you accountable for your progress. The goal is to achieve the longest distance possible with each swing.

Collect coins during the flight to upgrade your equipment and improve your shots. The goal is to achieve the longest distance possible with each swing. Points can be accumulated in various ways. The longer the distance you shoot, the more points you get. You can also unlock points with a surprise spin.

If you score a birdie (hole in 2 shots) or an eagle (hole in one), you'll amass way more points and will be able to improve the features of your future shots.

There are three elements to a perfect shot: strength, speed, and bounce. You can give each one of these a boost with reward points.

hits.description:

To activate the compass and reveal the secrets of the temples, the hero must find unique crystals, symbolizing the five elements, scattered around the world.

HOW TO PLAY JIGSOLTAIRE

OBJECTIVE:
Rebuild the scrambled image by swapping tiles until all pieces are in their correct positions.

BASIC CONTROLS:
- Drag a tile and drop it onto another tile to swap their positions
- Continue swapping until the complete image is revealed
- The puzzle is solved when all tiles are in the correct order

GAME MODES:

1. Play Level
   - Progress through levels in your current collection
   - Each level increases in difficulty
   - Earn coins and points for completion

2. Daily Puzzle
   - New puzzle available every day
   - Complete for bonus coins (+50)
   - Track your daily streak


DIFFICULTY LEVELS:
- Easy: 3x3 grid (9 pieces)
- Medium: 4x4 grid (16 pieces)
- Hard: 5x5 grid (25 pieces)
- Expert: 6x6 grid (36 pieces)
- Master: 7x7 grid (49 pieces)
- Insane: 8x8 grid (64 pieces)
- Legendary: 9x9 grid (81 pieces)

TIPS FOR SUCCESS:
1. Start with corner and edge pieces
2. Look for distinctive colors or patterns
3. Use the Hint button if you get stuck
4. Take your time - there's no time pressure
5. Complete easier puzzles first to earn hints

FEATURES:
- Hints: Tap the hint button to highlight a correct swap
- Gallery: View all your completed puzzles
- Quests: Complete challenges for bonus rewards
- Collections: Unlock new puzzle packs
- Leaderboard: Compare scores with other players

Enjoy the game!
