Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: If you struggle between a desire for destruction and a craving for comfort, this game is for you. Unravel knitted shapes layer by layer, filling spools of specific colors. A pleasant casual puzzle for stress relief.  

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?  
A: From the very first moments, the desire to solve the puzzle at once captivates, along with pleasant graphics and simple gameplay. A contemplative game where it's easy to get lost for a long time.

hits.description:
Run fast and collect Brainrots! 🏃
Run from the tsunamis when they appear! 🌊
Survive and collect as many Brainrots as possible! ⚡
Upgrade your Brainrots! 💸
Upgrade your base! 🏗️

Controls:
Desktop — WASD: move, left and right mouse buttons — control the camera, E — interact, Space — jump.  
Mobile — virtual stick — move, jump button — jump, tap for action on buttons.

Key Features:
• Steal brainrots!: For diamonds, you can steal brainrots from other players!  
• Buy VIP shelters: Purchase VIP shelters to hide from the incoming wave faster!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Coins.: Upgrade your character's speed and your base with coins!  
• Diamonds.: A valuable currency that you can use to buy character skins, special brainrots, or even steal brainrots from other players! You can watch an ad right now to get your first diamonds.

Enemies / Bosses:
• Blue waves.: They move slower. You have more time to run further!  
• Green waves.: You better hurry, they are faster and won't wait long for you to grab your brainrot.  
• Red waves.: Run as fast as you can!!! It rushes faster than all, and you have little time!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Try to steal the most valuable brainrots before the wave catches you. You need to hurry!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: If you manage to grab a more expensive brainrot and go further — consider it a victory! Become richer than other players and you can make it onto the leaderboard of the wealthiest players!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?  
A: Different waves and the chance to run further! Each wave moves at a different speed, so you need to choose the best time to start. The further you go, the more expensive the brainrots, but the cost of mistakes increases. Those who are willing to take risks can gain much more!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: There is one large level in the game. You need to go further while dodging waves. The further you go, the more frequent the waves and the harder it is to return.

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: The further you go, the more frequent the waves and the harder it is to return. The cost of mistakes increases, but the rewards will not leave you indifferent.

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: Steal the most expensive brainrots! They will bring you more coins, and you can upgrade your speed and run further!

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: Earn more money — you can upgrade your base and place more brainrots. More brainrots mean more money!

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?  
A: Upgrade your speed and run further for more valuable brainrots! Buy VIP. You will need VIP shelters to avoid waves. Upgrade your base and place more brainrots. And if you don't want to run for a brainrot, steal it from other players for diamonds!

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: You can buy skins for your character. Running further and getting richer is better with style!

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there leaderboards and how do they work?  
A: Yes! Earn more gold and make it onto the list of the wealthiest players! You can also make it onto the list of the highest income.

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: You can play without sound. The game is clear from the first minutes, you can play in a way that is comfortable for you.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: From the first minutes, you will immediately understand what you need to do. Convenient markers will help you not get lost.

hits.howToPlayText:
I. English:
1, Basic controls & gameplay
To play, you use either your mouse (on desktop) or finger/touch input (on touchscreen) to draw symbols on the screen. 
Each ghost shows one or more symbols above its head; you must draw that symbol (or sequence of symbols) correctly to cast a spell and defeat that ghost. 
Symbols vary — simple lines, shapes like “V” or “ʌ,” maybe a lightning bolt, etc
2. What you need to do & how it plays out.
Ghosts approach; as soon as you see a symbol above them, draw the shape quickly to “zap” them with a spell before they hit Momo. 
As levels progress, ghosts come faster and in greater numbers — the challenge is both speed and accuracy. 
At the end of each stage (or at least the final one), there’s a boss ghost — often requiring drawing a long chain or repeated spells to beat it. 
3. Goal & Scoring
Your goal: survive through all five levels, defeat all ghosts (and bosses), and save the ocean.

II. Russian:
1. Основные элементы управления и игровой процесс
В игре вы рисуете символы на экране мышью (на компьютере) или пальцем/сенсорным вводом (на сенсорном экране).

Над головой каждого призрака отображается один или несколько символов; вам необходимо правильно нарисовать этот символ (или последовательность символов), чтобы наложить заклинание и победить призрака.

Символы могут быть разными — простые линии, фигуры, например, «V» или «ʌ», возможно, молния и т. д.
2. Что нужно делать и как это происходит.
Призраки приближаются; как только вы увидите над ними символ, быстро нарисуйте его, чтобы «убить» их заклинанием, прежде чем они поразят Момо.

По мере прохождения уровней призраки появляются всё быстрее и их становится всё больше — сложность заключается как в скорости, так и в точности.

В конце каждого уровня (или, по крайней мере, последнего) вас ждёт призрак-босс, для победы над которым часто требуется нарисовать длинную цепочку или использовать несколько заклинаний. 
3. Цель и подсчёт очков
Ваша цель: выжить на всех пяти уровнях, победить всех призраков (и боссов) и спасти океан.

hits.title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
hits.description:
ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang is a casual food game where you are the star of a mukbang stream. You get to enjoy delicious dishes, interact with your audience, and grow your popularity with every bite, all on camera! Each meal takes you closer to becoming even more popular, so keep eating, keep engaging, and watch your virtual foodie journey unfold.
How to Play ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
Relaxing, fun, and super engaging, ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang lets you enjoy cooking, eating, and styling in a way that’s not only entertaining but also rewarding. Keep streaming, earning, and upgrading to become the most popular mukbang star! Become a livestream star with your channel, serving up drinks, dishes, and endless ASMR satisfaction. There are a few livestreams that you’ll participate in to get as many likes and hearts as possible from your fans.
Curate Your Stream
Start with a drink, pick your glass from thin-rimmed, stemmed, and rounded, and then add ice cubes in shapes from classic squares to cute bears. Garnish with fruits like lime, kiwi, or raspberry (some unlock as you earn rewards). Choose your syrup, give it a shake, add a straw, and get ready to sip your way into livestream fame. But beware — a boring drink could mean negative feedback!
Dig In on Camera
Once the drinks are done, move on to food. Eat tempura, sundaes, ramen, chicken, lobster, and even mix them in one stream for bigger rewards. The more fun and satisfying the experience, the more your audience grows. Once your food is ready, it’s time to go live! Eat, chat, and interact with your viewers as you enjoy the food. Your realistic ASMR sounds will make the experience feel so satisfying that your viewers won’t want to miss a moment. Engage with fans and watch your audience grow!
Go to the Supermarket
Start by shopping for ingredients, then move on to cooking mouth-watering dishes! From spicy noodles to delicious seafood and even sweet treats, the possibilities are endless. Prepare a meal that will make your audience hungry for more! For some of your livestreams, you get to shop for snacks and treats like sushi, dumplings, candy, and ice cream, but don’t get brain freeze! Pay with your card, stock up, and get ready to stream again.
Cook, Stream, and Engage
Shop for ingredients, cook delicious meals, then go live. Eat, chat, and interact while your realistic ASMR sounds keep viewers hooked. Successful streams bring in money. Spend it on stylish outfits for your character, or unlock even more mouth-watering food to keep your audience entertained.
If you’re a livestream fan, this game can get quite addictive. The more successful your streams, the more money you make. Use your earnings to upgrade your girl’s outfits, giving her a stylish and trendy appearance. You can also buy even more delicious food to satisfy your growing audience and keep the mukbang going!


Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, move the mouse to rotate.
Mobile: Tap on buttons, swipe your finger to rotate.

Key Features:
• Plenty of Food: Discover a wide variety of dishes to suit every taste! Try them all and showcase them to your audience!
• Interactive: Visit restaurants for delicious treats or head to the supermarket to pick out your favorite dishes. Scan items at the checkout and pay with your card! And that's not all. You can even prepare some delicacies yourself! Skewer fruits and berries and coat them in caramel glaze. A perfect dessert for your mukbang!
• Decorate Your Home: Choose furniture, flooring, walls, and other details for your home! Mukbangs need to be filmed in a cozy setting!

Game Modes:
• Dining: Head to a café and select delicacies for your mukbang!
• Minimart: Go shopping at the supermarket! Pick something tasty and showcase it on your stream!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: You play as a mukbang streamer! Eat delicacies live on stream, gain new subscribers and likes, enjoy new tasty treats, and build your popularity with your audience!

Q: What grabs attention in the first minutes?
A: A plethora of delicious options! You’ll find a variety of tasty dishes here, from sweets and drinks to hot fish or meat dishes. Takoyaki, onigiri, caramel-coated berries, and much more—there will definitely be plenty to eat on your stream and show to your viewers!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game flows seamlessly. Days pass one after another, and with each new day, your subscribers will grow, and you'll earn more money!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: Unlock new foods and modes. Surprise your viewers with new dishes, and of course, try them out yourself!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?
A: Purchase new food at the store, but you can also visit restaurants to choose treats there! You can even make drinks and some desserts yourself!

Q: Are there skins/customization options?
A: Your viewers will love to see you in new outfits. Choose a costume from the skin shop and stream your mukbang in style! You can also change not just your character's skin but also the table or walls in your room! Diversify your background!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Right from the start, you will make drinks for your first mukbang! Pour a cocktail of your choice, add selected ingredients, mix well, and see what you’ve created!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily tasks / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?
A: Yes! Spin the wheel of fortune and win prizes! You won’t be disappointed. You’re sure to get something worthwhile!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play as you like. But with sound, you’ll immerse yourself better in the cozy atmosphere of the game!

Q: What achievements are there and how can you earn them?
A: Stream and post updates, collect clips from your mukbangs, and cherish the wonderful moments!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: The game is intuitive from the first seconds. It will guide you through all the mechanics and show you how to play without unnecessary text.

hits.description:
Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is a fast-paced, casual action game where you let out your frustration on a few dummies in all sorts of scenarios. You will need quick reflexes and punches to unleash the blows it will take to knock your opponent out. Stay sharp, keep punching, and enjoy every moment of cathartic stress relief.
How to Play Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy
Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy is simple on the surface and fairly easy to play, but that is exactly what makes it so addictive. You control a floating arm wearing a boxing glove, and your only mission is to punch every dummy you see, along with other objects. Move the glove, line up your swings, and knock the targets out of the scene. Once they are all knocked out, you can move to the next level.
Each level presents a new setup of dummies. Sometimes there is a single dummy sitting quietly on a bench. hits.description: Sky Golf is a physics-based puzzle game where your objective is to guide a golf ball from a starting point to the hole. You must keep the ball steady, avoid traps, and safely reach the boat at the end of each level. The gameplay feels physics-based, so small moves matter one wrong swipe and the ball can fall into the water.
hits.howToPlayText:
Swipe left / right → move the ball left or right.
Drag forward → roll the ball forward (you can go faster or slower depending on how you drag).
When traps come, slow down and align the ball straight before crossing.
Keep balancing until you reach the end.
Reach the boat to finish the level.

hits.title: Electron dash
hits.description:
Attract. Repel. Survive.

Master the invisible forces of physics in this high speed magnetic arcade game. You do not just run, you glide, slam, and swing using the power of magnetism.

Use the polarity slider to instantly switch your charge between Red and Blue. Repel off walls to launch yourself across the map, or attract toward magnetic pillars to drift around tight corners.

Key Features:
Unique Control System: Master the polarity slider to push and pull your way to victory.

Physics Based Movement: Feel the momentum as you squish into walls and rocket through open spaces.
hits.howToPlayText:
Feel the Pull!
Navigate complex mazes using nothing but the power of attraction and repulsion. Adjust your magnetic charge to fly through the air, dodge traps, and collect coins.

How to Control:
The Slider: This is your steering wheel found at the bottom of the screen.
Slide Left: Activates Negative Charge (Blue).
Slide Right: Activates Positive Charge (Red).
Let Go: Returns to Neutral (Momentum only).

Rules of Physics:
Opposites Attract: Positive pulls you toward Negative.
Likes Repel: Positive pushes you away from Positive. Use this to launch yourself!

Your Mission:

1. Collect all Coins.
2. Reach the Finish Zone safely.
3. Do it before the Timer runs out!

hits.title: Shape Jam
hits.description:
Get ready to jam with shapes in this playful physics puzzle game!
In Shape Jam, your goal is simple: collect 3 matching shapes to clear the board. 
But every move counts  the pick zone is limited, the shapes tumble with physics, and the order you choose decides your success.
hits.howToPlayText:
Clear the board by collecting 3 matching shapes. When you make a set of 3 same shapes, they get cleared.
Tap a shape to pick it. The picked shape goes into your pick/holding slots at the top (the small empty circles).
Make a triple: If you collect 3 of the same shape in your slots, they clear automatically.
Don’t fill the slots: Your pick area/slots are limited, so the order you pick shapes matters.

Whether you're looking for fantasy jigsaw puzzles for free, a smooth slide puzzle game for the Christmas countdown, or engaging Christmas games, this jigsolitaire game has it all.

hits.title: Doodle Halloween Momo Cat : Academy
hits.description:
I, English:

Magic Cat Academy is a fun and adorable adventure game where you play as Momo the magic cat, a brave little student with big powers! One spooky night, silly ghosts sneak into her school and steal the magic book. Now it’s up to Momo to save the day!

To help Momo, players draw simple shapes on the screen to cast magic spells and pop the ghosts away. Each level takes you to a new part of the school, like the classroom, cafeteria, and even the rooftop. The ghosts get quicker and trickier, but with fast hands and sharp eyes, you can beat them all!

With cute characters, colorful animations, and easy touch controls, Magic Cat Academy is a safe, exciting, and kid-friendly game that’s perfect for players of all ages.

Help the lovely Momo Magic Cat cast out mischievous spirits by swiping in the shape of the symbols above the ghosts’ heads. And you’d better pounce fast—the ghost that stole the Arcane Magic spellbook is getting away! The school and all arcane magic are depended on your actions.

PURR-ify Ghost and Ghouls with your Arcane Magic. Swipe your magic wand to cast magic and save the Halloween.

II, Russian:

Magic Cat Academy — это весёлая и очаровательная приключенческая игра, в которой вы играете за Момо, волшебную кошечку, отважную маленькую ученицу с огромными способностями! Однажды жуткой ночью глупые призраки пробираются в её школу и крадут волшебную книгу. Теперь Момо предстоит спасти положение!

Чтобы помочь Момо, игроки рисуют на экране простые фигуры, чтобы колдовать и прогонять призраков. Каждый уровень переносит вас в новую часть школы, например, в класс, столовую и даже на крышу. Призраки становятся всё быстрее и хитрее, но с быстрыми руками и острым зрением вы сможете победить их всех!

С милыми персонажами, красочной анимацией и простым сенсорным управлением Magic Cat Academy — безопасная, увлекательная и дружелюбная для детей игра, идеально подходящая для игроков всех возрастов.

Помогите очаровательной волшебной кошечке Момо изгнать злых духов, проводя по символам над головами призраков. И поторопитесь — призрак, укравший книгу заклинаний «Тайная магия», убегает! Школа и вся тайная магия зависят от ваших действий.

Замурлыкайте призраков и упырей своей тайной магией. Взмахните волшебной палочкой, чтобы наложить магию и спасти Хэллоуин.
hits.howToPlayText:
I. English:
1, Basic controls & gameplay
To play, you use either your mouse (on desktop) or finger/touch input (on touchscreen) to draw symbols on the screen. 
Each ghost shows one or more symbols above its head; you must draw that symbol (or sequence of symbols) correctly to cast a spell and defeat that ghost. 
Symbols vary — simple lines, shapes like “V” or “ʌ,” maybe a lightning bolt, etc
2. What you need to do & how it plays out.
Ghosts approach; as soon as you see a symbol above them, draw the shape quickly to “zap” them with a spell before they hit Momo. 
As levels progress, ghosts come faster and in greater numbers — the challenge is both speed and accuracy. 
At the end of each stage (or at least the final one), there’s a boss ghost — often requiring drawing a long chain or repeated spells to beat it. 
3. Goal & Scoring
Your goal: survive through all five levels, defeat all ghosts (and bosses), and reclaim the spellbook.

II. Russian:
1. Основные элементы управления и игровой процесс
В игре вы рисуете символы на экране мышью (на компьютере) или пальцем/сенсорным вводом (на сенсорном экране).

Над головой каждого призрака отображается один или несколько символов; вам необходимо правильно нарисовать этот символ (или последовательность символов), чтобы наложить заклинание и победить призрака.

Символы могут быть разными — простые линии, фигуры, например, «V» или «ʌ», возможно, молния и т. д.
2. Что нужно делать и как это происходит.
Призраки приближаются; как только вы увидите над ними символ, быстро нарисуйте его, чтобы «убить» их заклинанием, прежде чем они поразят Момо.

По мере прохождения уровней призраки появляются всё быстрее и их становится всё больше — сложность заключается как в скорости, так и в точности.

В конце каждого уровня (или, по крайней мере, последнего) вас ждёт призрак-босс, для победы над которым часто требуется нарисовать длинную цепочку или использовать несколько заклинаний. 3. Цель и подсчёт очков
Ваша цель: выжить на всех пяти уровнях, победить всех призраков (и боссов) и вернуть книгу заклинаний.

hits.title: Art'N Ball
hits.description:
Art'N Ball is a mix between classic tennis and 3D platform game. The player will travel different locations within the Art’N Ball rolling-out world, skillfully returning his Earth-ball to have it pass walls, art exhibits, photo and puzzle challenges to finally set it free from its enclosed gallery pathway into infinite Space. 

He will experience different levels of complexity as the Earth-ball takes him from countryside or mountainous territories to the inner bowels of the underground, the depths of the seas, past frantic cityscapes towards arty lush landscapes and onto a surprise finish journey in orbit…
hits.howToPlayText:
Play Ball With Art!

The player has to ceaselessly return the ball with his racket in a gallery hallway, which takes twists and turns and narrows or widens as the player changes ambiance, until he meets a Level boss at the end of 3 Acts in order to exit the gallery. He constantly needs to keep an eye on the Earth-ball trajectory to anticipate its return and take it with the most appropriate angle to overcome obstacles and artfully squeeze his way out.
He can maximize his gameplay by catching bonuses, completing image puzzles, taking in-game world screenshots, or lighting exhibits to uncover their art contents, while getting a comfortable view of the outside scenery through large bay windows and enjoying a cosy or rhythmic music atmosphere.
He may also refine his strategy by prioritizing moving the ball forward to finish a level versus finishing puzzles or taking screenshots to earn extra lives and better score and level ranking.
He has to beware of maluses which will slow down his progression, but the good news is that these can actually turn to his advantage, e.g getting a chance to retrieve an extra life (in completing the missing blocks of a puzzle or hitting a final screenshot) or simply getting an easy way out with a downsized racket.

Desktop controls:

Menus:
mouse + click left to access menus/icons

In game:
mouse move: racket control up-down-left-right
click left: launch ball & move forward
P: pause/unpause game

Mobile controls:

Menus:
tap to access menus/icons

In game:
touch & move racket: racket control up-down-left-right
touch move icon: launch ball & move forward


Average time to complete a level using the "Save game" option is about 20 to 30min for beginners. 
"Save game" option allows the user to save the game at every Act end (3 Acts per level, 8 levels) and at every beginning of level ("Load game" to continue to play).
The player will be able to replay all levels which were previously completed (and saved) thanks to the 'Choose game level" menu.

A Training Room is accessible from the main menu. It explains the game principles/mechanics (but only partly to let the player discover by himself), shows an automatic demo and allows the player to test the game before entering Level 1.

hits.title: Obby: Climb and Slide
hits.description:
🏔️ Ready to conquer the tallest slides? In this game, you can! 🎢

Climb higher and higher up the ladders, then rush down the thrilling slides! 💨 The farther you slide, the more coins you collect! 💰

And with cute pets by your side, you’ll earn even more — they’ll help you gather coins! 🐱🐢🐰

What awaits you:
• Long ladders and exciting slides for speedy rides 🪜➡️🎢
• Funny pet companions 🐦
• Bright levels and new heights ⛰️
• Fun gameplay and colorful graphics 🎨

Climb up, slide down, and become the ultimate slide champion! 🎮✨


Controls:
Desktop: WASD / Arrow keys - move around the map, Space - jump, click - confirm actions.  
Mobile: virtual joystick - move around the map, tap - confirm actions.

Tips & Tricks:
• Auto climb: allows you to release control of the character for a while.  
• Cup: Don't forget to separately go for the cup and collect it; without this action, climbing will only earn you coins for descending.

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Pets: allow you to earn more coins, depending on the multiplier.  
• Boats: affect the speed of ascent and the number of coins earned during descent.

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• 5 worlds  
• Each world features a slope, a boat shop, and three pet sales stations. The more expensive the unlock for a new world, the more challenging the ascent to the top will be, but the rewards will be greater (more coins, and at the top, you can earn not just 1 cup, but 5, 10, and so on).

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Reach the top of the slope, collect the cup, and enjoy sliding down to repeat the feat. Earn coins, acquire new gear, and enjoy the process.

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?  
A: Simple, understandable gameplay, an easy task, and soothing graphics draw you in from the very first moments of the game.

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: As you progress, new difficulty levels, pet collections, and watercraft become available.

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: Each new tower becomes harder to overcome and requires the character to be more upgraded.

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: You can start with short ascents to upgrade your boat, allowing you to ascend the entire height of the slope more quickly later on.

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?  
A: You can purchase pets (three power levels depending on price) and boats (which affect the character's ascent speed on the ladder).

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?  
A: The onboarding guides the player through all available options on the basic path.

hits.title: PolyBounce Tycoon
hits.description:
PolyBounce Tycoon is an idle + arcade style ball bounce game with physics! Spawn balls, bounce them around, earn virtual cash, and unlock new arenas.

Features:

Arena Shapes: Play inside circles, squares, triangles, hexagons, and more. Each level changes the arena.

Balls: Spawn manually or let the auto spawner (auto clicker style) do the work.

Virtual Earnings: Every bounce gives you in-game cash with popup text and sound effects. The amount grows dynamically ($1.5k, $2.5m, etc.).

Upgrades:

Spawn new balls.

Increase virtual cash earned per bounce.

Speed up the auto spawner.

Upgrade balls with new sprites and levels.

Next Level: Unlock new arena shapes, reset upgrades, and multiply your in-game profits.

Idle mechanics, bounce physics, and tycoon upgrades combined. Build your ball idle empire in PolyBounce Tycoon!

(Note: All cash in this game is virtual currency and has no real-world value.)
hits.howToPlayText:
* Tap anywhere on the screen to temporarily boost the ball speed for free.

* At the bottom, you’ll see 3 upgrade buttons:

  1. **Add Ball** – Spawns an extra ball to increase your total earnings.
  2. **Incremental Payout** – Increases the money you earn each time a ball bounces off the wall.
  3. **Passive Income** – Raises the passive income you earn every second, even when idle.

* In the **Shop**, you can unlock new ball skins by watching ads.

🏆 Achievements - Master the art of the flip

Perfect For:

✅ Quick gaming sessions (flip during coffee breaks!)
✅ Long gaming sessions (you won't be able to stop!)
✅ Casual players who love merge games
✅ Strategy fans who enjoy optimizing
✅ Anyone who's ever flipped a coin and felt that RUSH

Can you unlock all 20+ tiers? Can you become the ultimate Flippin' Coins champion? There's only one way to find out...
hits.howToPlayText:
TAP/CLICK = FLIP 🪙

Tap any coin on the board to flip it
75% chance to WIN and earn money! 💰
25% chance to MISS (but don't worry - try again!)
Higher tier coins = MORE money per successful flip

Example:

Tier 1 coin wins = +$1
Tier 5 coin wins = +$5
Tier 10 coin wins = +$10

DRAG = MERGE 🔄

Drag one coin onto another of the SAME tier
They combine into the next tier!
Creates a more valuable coin

Tier 2 + Tier 2 = Tier 4 ✨
Tier 5 + Tier 5 = Tier 6 ✨

hits.description:
EdgeFire 2 is a large—scale and multifaceted game universe offering a deep reinterpretation of the classic formulas of the genre.

EdgeFire 2 offers its players a unique and balanced fusion of nostalgic "old school" and bold new ideas, where genuine tactical depth and the need for team synergy are seamlessly combined with an exciting, dynamic and visually spectacular action game.

This combination creates an ideal, carefully calibrated space for infinitely diverse competitive battles, where each match becomes a new story.

hits.howToPlayText:
🍪 COOKIE TYCOON - HOW TO PLAY 🎮
📖 COMPLETE GAMEPLAY GUIDE

🎯 GETTING STARTED
Your First Steps
Welcome to Cookie Tycoon! You start with nothing but a dream and a giant cookie button. Your goal? Build a cookie empire from scratch and become a millionaire!
Step 1: Click the Cookie! 🍪
Tap the giant cookie button in the center of your screen. Each click produces fresh cookies. This is your primary way to earn in the early game!
Step 2: Understand the Currency System 💰

Cookies = Your raw production resource
Money = Your purchasing power (10 Cookies = 1 Dollar)
Convert cookies to money strategically to buy upgrades and automation!


⚙️ CORE GAME MECHANICS
🖱️ CLICKING & UPGRADES
Manual Production:

Click the cookie button repeatedly to earn cookies
Each click gives you a base amount of cookies
Your click power increases as you upgrade!

Upgrade Your Clicking:
Navigate to the Upgrades Menu to:

Increase cookies per click
Unlock multipliers
Boost overall production efficiency

💡 Pro Tip: Invest heavily in click upgrades early - they compound over time!

🤖 AUTOMATION SYSTEM
Stop clicking manually! Purchase auto ovens that produce cookies automatically:
1. Simple Auto Oven (First Purchase)

Your entry-level automation
Produces cookies passively every second
Can be upgraded to increase production speed
Strategy: Buy this as soon as possible!

2. Auto Oven Program (Mid-Game)

Regional production system
Significantly faster than Simple Auto Oven
Multiple upgrade levels available
Strategy: Stack multiple units for exponential growth!

3. Advanced Auto Oven Program (End-Game)

Top-tier automation fleet
Massive passive income generation
Each level dramatically increases output
Strategy: This is your path to becoming a millionaire!

Upgrading Auto Ovens:

Each oven has multiple levels (Level 1, 2, 3, etc.)
Higher levels = more cookies per second
Costs increase with each level
Balance purchases between new ovens and upgrading existing ones


🏪 SHOP SYSTEM
Build your cookie empire with 4 different shops!
How Shops Work:

Each shop has a rotating progress bar on top
The bar fills up over time (duration varies by shop level)
When the bar completes, money is added to your account
The bar immediately resets and starts filling again
Shops earn money even when the game is closed! 📴

The 4 Shops:
🏪 Shop 1 - Starter Bakery

Your first shop
Moderate earning rate
Low cost to unlock and upgrade
Best for: Early game foundation

🏪 Shop 2 - Cookie House

Mid-level establishment
Better earnings than Shop 1
Requires significant investment
Best for: Accelerating mid-game progress

🏪 Shop 3 - Advanced Dessert Shop

High-tier production facility
Excellent passive income
Expensive but worth it
Best for: Late-game scaling

🏪 Shop 4 - Ultra-Modern Cookie Complex

Ultimate money-making machine
Massive passive earnings
Very expensive to unlock and upgrade
Best for: Becoming a true tycoon!

Shop Upgrade Strategy:

Each shop can be upgraded multiple times
Higher levels = faster bar filling = more money
Balance unlocking new shops vs. upgrading existing ones
Tip: Sometimes upgrading Shop 1 three times is better than unlocking Shop 2 once!


📈 INVESTMENT SYSTEM - HIGH RISK, HIGH REWARD! 🔥
Ready to gamble? The investment system lets you multiply your money... or lose it!
How It Works:
1. Real Candlestick Charts

You'll see a live chart with green and red candles
Green candles = price going UP 📈
Red candles = price going DOWN 📉
Each investment round lasts 15 seconds

2. Place Your Bet

Decide how much money to invest
Choose BUY (if you think price will rise) or SELL (if you think price will fall)
Wait 15 seconds for the result

3. Win or Lose

✅ Correct prediction: Your investment DOUBLES! 💰💰
❌ Wrong prediction: You LOSE your investment! 💸

Investment Strategies:
Conservative Approach:

Only invest 10-20% of your total money
Study the chart patterns before betting
Wait for clear trends (3+ green or red candles)

Aggressive Approach:

Invest large amounts for massive gains
Higher risk = higher reward
Best when you have substantial backup funds

Pattern Recognition:

Look for consecutive green/red candles
Consider recent trends
Remember: markets can reverse suddenly!

💡 Warning: Never invest money you need for essential upgrades! Only gamble with surplus funds.

📊 PROGRESSION SYSTEM
Early Game (0-1,000 Cookies)
Focus: Manual clicking + first upgrades

Click the cookie button constantly
Buy your first click upgrades
Purchase Simple Auto Oven as soon as possible
Convert cookies to money strategically
Goal: Unlock Shop 1

Mid Game (1,000-100,000 Cookies)
Focus: Automation + multiple shops

Upgrade your auto ovens
Purchase Auto Oven Program
Unlock and upgrade Shop 2
Start experimenting with small investments
Goal: Build passive income foundation

Late Game (100,000+ Cookies)
Focus: Empire expansion + investments

Max out Advanced Auto Oven Program
Unlock Shop 3 and Shop 4
Make strategic investments
Optimize shop upgrades
Goal: Achieve millionaire status!

End Game (Millionaire!)
Focus: Maximization

Max level all shops
Max level all auto ovens
Master the investment system
Watch your cityline expand across the screen!
Goal: True cookie tycoon!


🏆 ACHIEVEMENTS SYSTEM
Track your progress through various milestones:

Total cookies produced
Total money earned
Shops unlocked
Maximum investment win
Days played
And many more!

Check your stats in the Achievements panel to see how far you've come!

💡 ADVANCED STRATEGIES
The Balanced Approach

50% investment in automation (auto ovens)
30% investment in shops
20% investment in click upgrades
Result: Steady, reliable growth

The Clicker Strategy

Heavy investment in click upgrades early
Manual clicking focus
Slower automation adoption
Result: Active gameplay, faster early growth

The Passive Strategy

Rush automation purchases
Minimal clicking after early game
Heavy shop investment
Result: Offline earnings, slower start but powerful late game

The Gambler Strategy

Minimum viable automation
Maximum investment system usage
High risk, high reward
Result: Either rapid wealth or bankruptcy!


🎓 TUTORIAL SYSTEM
Interactive Learning:

Built-in tutorial explains each system
Can be opened/closed anytime
Each feature explained separately
No forced tutorials - learn at your own pace!

Tutorial Sections:

Cookie Clicking Basics
Upgrade System
Auto Oven Automation
Shop Management
Investment System
Achievement Tracking


📴 OFFLINE EARNINGS
Keep earning while away!

Auto ovens continue producing
Shops keep filling their bars
When you return, collect all offline earnings
Maximum offline time: unlimited!

Offline Optimization:

Prioritize auto ovens before long breaks
Upgrade shops for maximum offline money
Don't rely on clicking (you won't be there!)


🌍 LANGUAGE & ACCESSIBILITY
Play in your native language! Choose from:
🇬🇧 English | 🇷🇺 Russian | 🇫🇷 French | 🇹🇷 Turkish | 🇪🇸 Spanish | 🇩🇪 German | 🇮🇹 Italian | 🇵🇹 Portuguese | 🇦🇿 Azerbaijani | 🇳🇱 Dutch | 🇵🇱 Polish | 🇺🇦 Ukrainian | 🇻🇳 Vietnamese | 🇺🇿 Uzbek | 🇮🇩 Indonesian | 🇰🇿 Kazakh

🎮 FINAL TIPS FOR SUCCESS
✅ Never stop upgrading - There's always something to improve
✅ Balance is key - Don't neglect any system
✅ Patience pays off - Idle games reward consistent play
✅ Use investments wisely - Only gamble surplus money
✅ Check achievements - They guide your progression
✅ Play offline-friendly - Set up automation before breaks
✅ Experiment - Find the strategy that suits your playstyle!

hits.title: Gym Simulator Online, Escape
hits.description:
Imagine a Gym Simulator Online where you wake up locked inside a massive escape fortress — a place where only the STRONGEST survive. No boring workouts — only insane muscle gains, real-time body growth, and epic online battles for the title of ultimate champion!

Your goal in this escape gym simulator is simple: become so huge that you literally smash through the castle walls and defeat every boss in your way. Bench press, lift kettlebells, crush dumbbells — and watch your character instantly bulk up and grow right before your eyes.

What awaits you: • Explosive visual growth — you literally GET BIGGER after every training session. • Online competitions — prove to your friends you’re a machine, not a human. • Ranking system — rise from rookie to mythical titan. • Tons of skins, hairstyles, and wings — become unstoppable. • Pets from eggs — collect powerful boosters and train X10 faster.

This is a game where progress is not just numbers — you SEE it. Every tap makes you stronger. You don’t grind… you DOMINATE.

Ready to be the one who breaks through the castle walls and enters the legends? Start your transformation right now!

Controls:
Desktop: WASD / arrows, space - jump, click to select option;  
Mobile: virtual joystick, virtual jump button, tap to select option  

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Power Points: Earned through training. Can be spent on skins. The amount of power points affects the damage dealt with each hit when battling bosses.  
• Trophies: Earned through boss fights. Can be spent on pets. Required to advance to the next level.  

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: You find yourself trapped in a world where the most important thing is to enhance your strength through various training. Defeat all the bosses to gain the opportunity to move to the next level.  

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?  
A: Simple controls, clear achievements, and the ability to buy different pets. The tutorial is presented in a gentle mentoring style, and there are no strict requirements on how to develop your character: build your own strategy by combining different types of training.  

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: New difficulty levels, training loads, and pets unlock as you progress, allowing for faster advancement.  

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: Choose combinations of training and pay close attention to the Wheel of Fortune, which allows you to quickly earn a large number of trophies or power points.  

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/improve?  
A: You can buy:  
- pets: regular or more exclusive  
- skins for character customization  
- VIP status, granting access to more skins and faster progress accumulation.  

Q: Are there skins/customization options?  
A: You can change your character's clothing and hairstyle, as well as add wings.  

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there daily tasks/wheel of fortune/achievements/tasks?  
A: The Wheel of Fortune: provides the opportunity to quickly earn a lot of power points or trophies.  

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?  
A: Onboarding introduces the player to the types of training, guides them through the scenario of their first victories, and helps them quickly get oriented in the game.

hits.description:
The game where size matters! Your mission is to change the size of the wheels, transitioning from small to large and vice versa, to overcome a variety of obstacles and progress through levels. hits.howToPlayText:
Your goal is to reach the finish line. To do this, use the slider in the game to change the size of the wheels.

Small wheels allow you to accelerate. Large wheels allow you to drive into high obstacles, but because of them the car becomes slow. Also, the larger the wheels, the more the car turns into the standard position if it is not standing on all wheels at the moment.

If you get stuck, try to drastically change the size of the wheels, so the car can bounce.

In some levels, it is important to gain speed in order to hit an obstacle.

If you realize that the car is stuck, stopped and does not move even when you change the size of the wheels, then use the restart button of the level and try to pass it again.

Pump up the acceleration level so that at the end of the level the car can jump as far as possible and earn as many coins as possible.

Control on all platforms using the game interface.

hits.title: Twisty Planet
hits.description: Twisty Planet is a minimalist arcade-style game in which your goal is to survive as long as possible on a rotating planet, dodging obstacles while collecting items to boost your score.
hits.howToPlayText:
You tap the screen (or press) to cause the planet (or the surface) to twist or rotate. This changes where obstacles appear relative to your hero.
As the planet twists, obstacles rotate into your path. You must time your taps so that you don’t collide with these obstacles. If you hit one, the game likely ends (you lose).
Alongside avoiding dangers, you can collect “foods” (or collectible items) as you go. These add to your score.
The main objective is to survive as long as possible while collecting items to increase your score. The longer you live and the more items you gather, the higher your score.
While not explicitly detailed in the App Store text, most games of this style gradually increase the speed, frequency, or complexity of obstacle placement as you play longer, making it harder to avoid collisions.

hits.howToPlayText:

● Match 4 pieces to create the Rocket. The Rocket blows up the whole line!
● Match 4 pieces to form a square to create the Spinner. The Spinner destroys one of the targets!
● Make a T-shaped match of 5 pieces to create the Bomb. The Bomb makes a massive explosion on the board!

● Match any 2 power-ups to get a variety of powerful effects that will make it easier to complete the level.

hits.title: Block Puzzle Magic
hits.description: Block Puzzle Magic is a simple yet addictive puzzle game that challenges players to arrange blocks on a grid to clear full rows and columns. It blends relaxing gameplay with a bit of strategy: you can play in a few seconds to refresh your mind, but thinking ahead helps you last longer.
hits.howToPlayText:
You’re given a fixed grid (often 10×10) into which you must place (drag) blocks of various shapes.
You drag block pieces from a preview area and drop them onto the grid. You have to find space where the block fits.
When you completely fill an entire horizontal row or vertical column with blocks, that entire row/column clears out (is removed), and you score points.
You cannot rotate the block pieces — they must be used in the shape presented.
Because the blocks come in various shapes, you need to plan placements intelligently so you don’t block yourself from placing future pieces. The game ends when there is no more space to place any of the current block pieces.
When none of the available block pieces can fit anywhere on the grid, the game ends. Your final score depends on how many rows/columns (and combos) you cleared

hits.title: Millionaire Factory
hits.description:
Millionaire Factory 🔩🏭 is a fun and addictive 🎉 clicker game where players collect Metal to grow their fortune. By tapping the giant Metal button 👆, players gather Metals, convert them into Money 💰, and invest in upgrades to build their own factory empire.

The game offers a growth journey that starts with a small piece of Metal 🔩 and expands into a massive factory and investment fortune 📈📉.
hits.howToPlayText:
Metal Production 🔩:
At the heart of the game lies a massive Metal (Gear) button. Each tap 👆 earns you Metal, which serves as your primary source of income.

Metals → Money 💵:
You can convert collected Metals into Money 💸 to keep your economy running. For example:
➡️ 1 Metal = 0.1 Money
➡️ 10 Metals = 1 Money

Income and Robot Program Upgrades 🤖🏭:
With the money you earn 💵, you can:

Purchase upgrades that increase the amount of Metal gained per tap 💪.

Invest in automation systems such as the Basic Auto Robot 3️🔨, Regional Robot Program ⚒️, and National Automatic Robot Fleet.
These systems generate passive income every 5 seconds.

Factories 🏭:
At the start of the game, you begin with a single factory, which you can upgrade 🔧. You can also purchase up to three additional factories 🏭, each of which can be further developed.
Every factory has a progress bar 📊 representing its Metal production. Once the bar fills, the factory automatically sells the produced Metal, adds the profit 💵 to your balance, and the cycle restarts.

Fast Investments⚡:
📊 In the investment section, carefully observe the **candlestick movements** left by the dynamic system.
⏱️ Within about **15 seconds**, predict whether the price will go **up or down.**
💰 Then, open a **trade** in the direction you believe it will move, using your chosen amount.
🎯 If your prediction is correct, you’ll earn **double** the amount you invested! 💎🚀


Achievements 🏅:
There are 6 unique achievements 🌟 to unlock throughout the game, based on the total Metals collected 🔩, upgrades purchased 🔝, and wealth accumulated 💰.

hits.title: Stack Master
hits.description:
Stack master is a minimalistic, endless stacking game where your goal is to build the tower as high as possible by perfectly aligning moving blocks.
The graphics are simple and clean, focusing on smooth gameplay without distractions.
You compete globally for the highest score (tower height) on leaderboards.
hits.howToPlayText:
When you start, a block (or “slice”) begins sliding horizontally across the screen at some height.
You tap the screen (or tap a control) to drop the moving block onto the block beneath it.
The better the alignment with the block below, the more of the block remains. If part of the block overhangs, the overhanging part is cut off.
If you drop with a slight misalignment, the excess portion is cut away and removed, making your next block smaller.
If your misalignment is very poor (i.e. almost no overlap), you might lose the block entirely, ending the game.
Each successful drop continues the tower upward. The goal is to stack as many as possible, reaching the highest possible height (score).
As the tower gets higher, it becomes more challenging. The blocks may move faster or require more precision. (This is common in stacking games of this type.)

You wake up in a locked, unfamiliar house. The windows are sealed, the doors are bolted, and it doesn’t take long to realize you’re not here by choice — you’ve been kidnapped. The only way forward is to explore, uncover clues, and piece together who lives here… and why they’ve trapped you.

Every object can hide a secret: a sofa may conceal something beneath its cushions, a flowerpot may hold a key, or a book on the shelf may reveal disturbing truths about the strange girl who owns this place. Interacting with the environment unlocks new paths, changes the protagonist’s perception, and pushes the story into darker territory.

As in every classic point-and-click adventure, you’ll collect items and use them in clever ways to solve puzzles, repair devices, and access new rooms. A simple glass of water, a sharp knife, or a roll of tape could be the difference between staying trapped forever and finding your way to freedom.

The narrative unfolds gradually, shifting from calm exploration to mounting dread. What begins as a harmless search of a living room turns into a chilling discovery of obsessions, sinister secrets, and unsettling mannequins that seem far too lifelike.

Your ultimate goal is clear: escape the house before it’s too late. But as you progress, you’ll uncover more about the girl’s twisted hobbies — and the terrifying fate that might await you if you fail.

Will you outsmart her and unlock the final door to freedom, or become just another part of her dark collection?
hits.howToPlayText: Explore the house by tapping on objects, collect useful items, combine them to solve puzzles, and uncover secrets that lead you closer to escaping.

hits.title: Go Up
hits.description:
Welcome to Go Up, the exciting free mobile game that challenges you to protect the balloon as it rises higher and higher into the sky. Get ready to put your skills to the ultimate test with this amazing balloon game that'll keep you on your toes and your eyes glued to the screen.

Picture this. You have a tiny balloon you need to protect. You need to push away all the pointy and heavy things that get in the way of your balloon going up. But it's not that easy. The sky is full of all kinds of strange things like blocks, beams, and triangles. If your balloon even touches one of these, it's all over. Exciting, right?

But it gets even better! The higher your balloon goes, the harder the game gets. The obstacles become trickier and more difficult to avoid. You can push everything out of the way, but watch out! If you send blocks flying everywhere, you will find it difficult to protect the balloon.
hits.howToPlayText:
You have a “shield” or barrier (often a circular protective plane) that you can move around the balloon to push objects aside.
You swipe or drag on the screen to reposition your shield around the balloon. (While the store page doesn’t explicitly describe the swipe controls, that’s the common mechanic for this kind of game.)
You must time your moves carefully pushing obstacles too late or too aggressively can send them flying in directions that block the balloon again.
The higher you get (the further in the level), the more frequent and more complex obstacles appear.

hits.howToPlayText:

In Bow Brawls, survive endless waves of enemies using skill and precision. Use the joystick (mobile) or WASD (PC) to move. Aim by pulling the on-screen joystick in the opposite direction of your target—release to shoot arrows like a real bow.

Enemies attack from all directions, including melee fighters and ranged shooters. Every few waves, a boss appears with unique skills like dashing, jumping over you, or launching projectiles—stay alert and adapt!

Defeat bosses to earn gems, which unlock new bows and armors with different abilities. Reach higher scores to unlock new arenas and face tougher challenges.

Your score is based on enemy kills, with each type rewarding different points. Climb the leaderboards by defeating as many enemies as possible. Manage your health bar carefully—you only get one life per run.

Master your aim, survive waves, defeat bosses, and rise as the ultimate archer!

hits.description: TENKYU BALL is a 3D casual ball-rolling puzzle game where you must guide a ball through tilting stages to reach the goal. The environment is minimalistic, and the challenge comes from balancing control vs risk. As you tilt the stage more, the ball moves faster, but there’s danger: if you tilt too much, the ball may fall off and you'll fail the level.
hits.howToPlayText:
Tilt the stage / swipe finger:
You swipe (or drag) on your screen to tilt the surface on which the ball rests.
The tilt direction determines where the ball rolls.
Control carefully:
If you tilt too much, the ball gains speed and can fall off the edge.
Tilt only as much as needed to navigate turns, avoid gaps, and make tricky maneuvers.
Reach the goal:
Each stage has a goal point or exit you must reach. Successfully get the ball there without falling off.
Failure and retry:
If the ball falls, the level ends (you lose) and you’ll need to restart that stage.

It’s stylised and simple in controls.
There are many levels that get progressively more challenging.
hits.howToPlayText:

Connect with other stacks of the same color: Once you select a stack, you try to link it to other stacks of the same color to form a longer chain.

hits.title: Number Sums
hits.description:
Number Sums is a challenging number puzzle to train your mental math. The goal is to make the sum of numbers in each row, column, and colored region be equal to the clues on the side of the board and inside the colored regions. Practice your math skills and logic with Number Sums!

Each row, column, and region has its own solution, but the goal of this math game with numbers is to make them all work at the same time. You have to circle the correct numbers and erase the numbers you don't need. Remember, the sums of the numbers in rows, columns and colored regions should be equal to the numbers on the sides of the board and inside each region. Each level of this numbers game has only one solution, try to find it to solve educational math puzzles!

Mental arithmetic is an invaluable math skill for your everyday life. Inside Number Sums you'll find math puzzles of various difficulty. The mechanics of these math riddles sounds simple but requires a lot of thinking. Playing sum number games and solving math problems can improve your arithmetic skills. If you are interested in number puzzles or math games for adults, and in training your addition skills, play this engaging number game for hours of fun!
hits.howToPlayText:
- Circle the correct numbers that add up to the values on the sides of the rows, columns and regions.
- Use the toggle to switch between circling and erasing modes. It will help you to mark the correct numbers and the extra numbers that you don't need.
- Each level of these math puzzles has only one possible solution, so make sure that the rows, columns and colored regions work together at the same time.
- Train your math skills with this free number puzzle with various levels of difficulty. Open different types of board from 3x3 to 10x10.

hits.howToPlayText:
Chess Online Multiplayer follows the classic rules of chess. The goal of the game is to checkmate your opponent’s king, putting it in a position where it is under threat of capture and has no legal moves to escape.

**Getting Started**

1. **Choose the game type:**
* play online against other players;
* challenge the computer;
* play together on the same screen with a friend.

2. **If you’re playing against the computer:**
* select the opponent’s difficulty level (from Beginner to World Champion);
* choose whether to use a handicap and interactive hints.

3. **If you’re playing with a friend:**
* decide on the time control mode (Unlimited, Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Classic).
* choose your bet

**Basic Rules and Gameplay**

* Players take turns making moves.
* Pawns move forward and capture diagonally.
* Knights move in an «L» shape.
* Other pieces have their own unique moves.

To succeed, develop a strategy: protect your pieces, control the center of the board, and anticipate your opponent’s moves.

The game ends when one player checkmates the opponent’s king (winning the game) or when a draw is achieved under certain conditions.

**Draw Conditions**
A draw is a result where neither player wins, and the game ends in a tie. It can occur under the following circumstances:
* **stalemate:** when a player has no legal moves but is not in check;
* **three-fold repetition of the position:** when the same position occurs three times;
* **50 moves without a capture or pawn move;**
* **insufficient material to checkmate;**
* mutual agreement between players.

**Special Chess Moves**

**Castling**
Castling is a special move involving the king and a rook. It can be performed only if:
* neither the king nor the rook has moved yet;
* there are no other pieces between the king and the rook;
* the king is not in check;
* the king does not pass through or stop on squares that are under attack.

This move helps to protect the king and connect the rooks for better defense.

**En Passant (Taking on Pass)**
En passant is a special pawn capture. If your opponent moves a pawn two squares forward and lands next to your pawn, you can capture it on your next move as if it had moved only one square. Your pawn will take its place, but this capture must be done immediately.

**Additional Features**

* **Made a mistake?** Use the move undo function to reconsider your strategy.
* After each match, a detailed analysis highlights mistakes and suggests better moves.
* You can replay specific moments to strengthen your understanding of the game.
* Save your rating and choose different time modes (Bullet, Blitz, Rapid).
* Customize the board and pieces to your liking.
* Review the move history and express your emotions by communicating with your opponent using playful cartoon emojis.

hits.title: English Checkers Online Multiplayer
hits.howToPlayText:
**How to Play English Checkers**

English Checkers is a strategic board game where players aim to capture their opponent’s checkers or block them completely. Here’s how to get started and understand the basic rules:

**Game Objective**
The goal is to either capture all of your opponent’s checkers or completely block them so they can’t make any legal moves.

**Types of Checkers**
- **Simple checker:** moves diagonally forward one square and can only capture forward.
- **King:** can move diagonally both forward and backward on any free square and can capture in both directions. When a simple checker reaches the last row, it becomes a king and gains these additional abilities.

**Basic Movement and Capture Rules**
1. **Movement:**
- simple checkers move diagonally forward one square at a time;
- kings can move diagonally in any direction on any free square.

2. **Capture:**
- if your checker is next to your opponent’s checker and there’s an empty square behind it, you must jump over the opponent’s checker and land in the empty square, capturing the opponent’s piece;
- captures are mandatory — if you have the option to capture, you must do so;
- if a capture leads to another possible capture, you must continue capturing as part of the same turn until no more captures are possible;
- when a simple checker reaches the last row during a capture, it becomes a king but cannot make further moves in the same turn.

3. **Choosing Capture Options:**
- if there are multiple capture options available, you can choose which one to make;
- the «Turkish strike» rule means that a checker that has been beaten but not yet removed from the board can block the path of a king or another checker.

**Winning the Game**
You win the game by:
- capturing all of your opponent’s checkers;
- blocking your opponent so that they have no legal moves left.

**Getting Started in English Checkers Online Multiplayer**
1. **Choose your game mode:** play against the computer, compete online with real players, or play with a friend on the same screen.
2. **Select your difficulty level or opponent:** if playing against the computer, choose from 10 difficulty levels; if playing online, find a real opponent.
3. **Choose your side:** select whether you want to play as black or white.
4. **Start playing:** follow the rules of movement and capture to outmanoeuvre your opponent and achieve victory.

Enjoy the game and sharpen your strategic skills with English Checkers Online Multiplayer!

hits.description:
Connect Lines is a puzzle game in which the goal is to rotate line-segments so that together they form a continuous connected path or network i.e. all the lines must join up into one single connected structure.
It is simple in appearance but grows challenging, because you must figure out the correct orientation of each piece so that the network is complete without any breaks.
As the puzzle advances, the arrangement / layout becomes more complex. The number of line-pieces increases, the shapes become more varied, and finding the correct connection scheme becomes harder. You may need to think ahead about how rotating one piece will affect connections with several adjacent pieces. (This is standard for these kinds of puzzles.)

You can click on a line piece to rotate it. Each click usually rotates the piece by 90° (or possibly another fixed amount) to change its orientation.

hits.title: Bubble Tower
hits.description:
Bubble Tower 3D is a relaxing 3D bubble-pop / color-match puzzle game.
You rotate a tower (or cylinder) loaded with colored bubbles around its vertical axis.
Your goal is to shoot bubbles, matching colors to connect groups of the same color. When matched, those bubbles pop/drop off the tower.
There are many levels; difficulty increases as you go. More bubble colors, trickier arrangements, limited shots, etc.
Also there are diamonds or special gems you can collect in certain levels. These may unlock “shiny shapes” or cosmetic things.
The graphics are clean, simple, and meant for relaxing casual play. It mixes mental challenge (where to shoot, color matching) with a soothing visual.
hits.howToPlayText:
A tower appears with a cluster of bubbles of various colors. There’s a shooter that holds the next bubble to fire.
You can rotate the tower around (usually by dragging left/right or using onscreen controls) to bring bubbles of matching color in position.
Tap or drag to aim, then let go (or tap a location) to shoot the bubble toward the tower. Match it with other bubbles of the same color.
When you connect 3 or more bubbles of the same color, those bubbles pop/drop off. Bubbles that are hanging (i.e. no longer connected to the base or other bubbles) also fall off.
Some levels include diamonds or special gems placed in certain parts of the bubble structure. You need to target those, maybe by matching bubbles around them or popping surrounding bubbles to let them fall.
You win a level if all bubbles (or the required ones) are cleared. If you run out of shots (or fail to clear the required bubbles), you lose and must retry.

hits.description: Celebrate Easter weekend in style this year with the sweet new puzzle game, Unravel Eggs Puzzle! hits.title: Rotate Cups
hits.description:
This is a rotation physics puzzle game where you control the angle of cups to try to get the balls to roll into specific cups.
Rotate cups clockwise or counterclockwise as needed to turn the clear cups into ramps guiding the ball down the level.
Place at least one ball in each of the blue cups.
In this game you have to get all the balls into the blue cups lower down the screen.
Larger blue cups can hold more than one ball in them.
If there are multiple smaller blue cups you must get a ball into each of them.
Levels are not timed & you can both rotate as many times as you like & pause as many times as you like.

You can skip intermediary cups. On most levels you typically want to use all the cups on the way down, but if you are struggling to do so you can bump a ball off the outside of a cup or skip a cup entirely & it won’t harm you in the least provided your balls eventually get into the blue cups.
Some levels have a long reach you have to make the ball roll. On those levels sometimes a somewhat rapid cup spin toward the destination is enough, but in some cases you have to do that rapid spin as the starting point & then slightly spin back quickly right as the ball is leaving to give the ball a bit more lift.
hits.howToPlayText:
Desktop:
Use your mouse left click button to select on the screen & drag your mouse to rotate the cups.
Drag left or down to spin clockwise.
Drag right or up to spin counterclockwise.

Touchscreen devices:
Tap the screen with a finger & drag your finger across the screen to rotate cups clockwise or counterclockwise.

Fire Power:
This bonus gives your ball a flaming speed boost.
It’s useful for long straight shots or when you want to quickly cross a large gap.
Best used when you need maximum distance in a single strike.

Wing / Glide Power:

Ideal for precision shots where you want distance but also don’t want to overshoot too wildly.

Spring / Bounce Power:

It helps your ball bounce forward with extra force, perfect for overcoming obstacles or making tricky jumps.
Best for courses with barriers, ramps, or platforms where normal shots can’t reach.

hits.title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
hits.description:
Welcome to Fruitsland – a unique amusement park where fun awaits at every turn! Colorful carousels, exciting rides, and entertainers dressed as fruits – apples, bananas, watermelons, and oranges – fill the park. Children’s laughter fills the air, as school groups with teachers and families with kids flock to enjoy the day. Everything seems perfect, but not all is as it seems... One careless step, and you fall through an old hatch, landing in a spooky, long-abandoned part of the park hidden underground.

Before you lies a chilling, forgotten underground park where strange scientific experiments were once conducted. Only remnants of these experiments remain now, with crumbling rides and deserted game rooms that carry no joy. An eerie silence surrounds you, broken only by the sounds of old machinery and the shuffling of mysterious creatures. The first location is themed around apples – at first, it seems harmless, but soon you realize you’re trapped. As you study the remnants of the scientists’ journals, you uncover their plans to bring fruit to life, fruit that would entertain visitors around the clock. The sinister plan of the park’s owner aimed to turn fruits into real entertainers, capable of anything to amuse guests.

Your mission now is to escape from this underground horror. Every step brings new puzzles, challenging tasks, and deadly monsters that lurk around every corner, the results of failed experiments. Surviving here won’t be easy: these animated fruits have come to life, and now they’re hunting you. Every corner is a new survival test filled with horror, fear, and adrenaline. Choose your path wisely, solve puzzles to find your way out, and avoid deadly traps and monsters that only look like harmless fruits.

The first monster you will encounter is a blind apple, a nightmare resembling a zombie. It aimlessly roams the empty sections of the park, filling everyone who sees it with dread.

The second section is dedicated to the banana. This is the second colorful monster brought to life by horrifying experiments. Seeing it makes you feel as if something is invading your mind.

The third section of the underground park is dedicated to the Pomegranate — a sinister fruit with two large eyes. These roaming eyes not only track unwelcome guests but also attack them. They emerge from their sockets and move independently, chasing their target across the area.

Can you escape from this park and see the sunlight again? Will you find a way to break free from the gloomy underground? This horror game is for those ready for survival, monster hunts, immersion in fear, and adrenaline! Complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat monsters, and find freedom while uncovering the mysteries of Fruitsland.

Download this game to dive into the fruit garden… if you dare!

hits.title: Drone Dash - Time Challenges!
hits.description:
**How to Play**

Welcome to **Drone Dash - Time Challenges** – a fast-paced arcade puzzler where quick thinking and precision bouncing are the keys to victory! You’ll control a zippy little drone that *dashes* between walls and platforms like a high-tech pinball. But this isn’t your typical platformer – no jumping, no gravity drops. Your drone glides and ricochets from surface to surface, smoothly darting through tight spaces full of traps and twists.

Your mission? **Collect as many bullets as you can before time runs out!** The more you grab, the more stars you’ll earn (up to 3 per level). Once you collect the minimum required, a glowing crystal spawns back at your starting point – reach it to complete the level. But watch out! Hit a trap or run out of time, and it's back to the start.

Levels are short, intense, and packed with surprises. New traps and tricky tiles will keep you on your toes as you dash your way to perfection. Fast reflexes and smart movement make all the difference!

**Controls:**
🖱️ On PC: Just click to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice!
📱 On Mobile: Just tap to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice!

Ready to test your reflexes and grab those stars? Dive into the dash and beat the clock!

hits.title: Durak
hits.description:
Durak is essentially a shedding card game where each player will try to get rid of the cards in their hand first. Durak is quite an enjoyable game that has over the years made a general impact on millions. It is a game that requires critical thinking, which is why it is more popular among people who consider themselves tech-savvy.

The objective of Durak is to play all your cards. The loser in Durak will be the last player with cards in their hand. So, to ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can.

Durak is the most popular Russian card game. Durak means fool and it refers to the person who loses the game.

A Durak card game is one of the easiest and most fun card games. Players do not need much to get started. You will only need: a poker deck reduced to 36 cards from Ace to 6.

However, this game is quite interesting because there will usually be multiple winners. To ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can.


Durak might not be a game you are overly familiar with. But in Russia, Durak is by far the most popular card game! It has got a fascinating history and will be sure to make a unique choice if you are looking for something a little different.

Another interesting thing about this game is that it is played with a smaller deck.

Durak is fun and, rather, a unique card game. If you enjoy more strategic card games and are looking for something a little different, why not give Durak a try?
hits.howToPlayText:
Durak is played by 2 to 4 players. Total cards used are 36 cards - Only 6 7 8 9 10 J Q K A of all suits are used.

The deck is shuffled, and each player is dealt with 6 cards. The bottom card of the stock is turned and placed face up on the table. The rest of the pack is then placed on half over the turn-up and at right angles to it, so that it remains visible. The trump suit is drawn as the last card.

The first person to play is the one who holds the lowest trump suit in his hand. The game proceeds in a clockwise direction. The player who started to play acts as an attacker and the player sitting next to him in a clockwise direction acts as a defender.

The player who has the lowest trump card will be the first attacker. If the attack succeeds, the defender loses their turn, and the attack passes to the player on the defender's left. If the attack fails, the defender becomes the next attacker. The attacker opens their turn by playing a card face up on the table as an attacking card. Defender responds to the attack with a defending card. A trump card of any rank beats all cards in the other three suits

To win Durak, you need to play all your cards quickly. Once you have played your cards, you are out of the game and will need to wait for the rest of the players. The last player with cards in their hand loses.

hits.title: StickerBall
hits.description:
Stickerball is a fast-paced game where you collect stickers using a ball with unique abilities! Your goal is to collect 180 colorful stickers across 9 levels by completing challenges and activating triggers that change the game’s rules. Each turn, 10 stickers fly onto the field from a purchased pack, but any uncollected ones disappear—act quickly and precisely!

The game shines with 14 dynamic triggers: freeze stickers, double rewards with "x2," turn the ball into a magnet or ghost, activate "disco" mode, or control a dual ball! The more stickers you collect in one turn, the higher your combo and the more coins you earn. Holo-stickers, with their unique designs, grant double the currency!

Play across 12 vibrant, randomly changing fields. Buy sticker packs, upgrade your collection, and strategize by activating triggers at the perfect moment to maximize rewards.
hits.howToPlayText:
How to play:
1. Aiming:
Move your cursor to aim-the arrow on the ball shows the strike direction.

2. Power Charging:
Hold LMB to fill the arrow’s power gauge. Release to launch the ball! Striking too early cancels the shot.

3. Collecting Stickers:
After striking, the ball bounces off walls, collecting stickers, coins, and crystals. The more you gather in one turn, the higher your combo and bonuses!

4. Triggers:
Collect special icons (magnet, x2, freeze, etc.) to power up the ball or alter sticker behavior. For example, "Ghost" lets the ball pass through triggers, while "Double Move" grants a second strike without new stickers appearing.

5. Buying Packs:
Before your first turn, choose a free Level 1 pack. Each pack contains 100 stickers, with 10 appearing per turn.

6. Strategy Tips:
Use "Freeze" or "Bonus" to increase the number of stickers on the field.
Combine triggers like "Magnet" + "x2" for double rewards.
Prioritize Holo-stickers - they grant x2 coins!

hits.title: Rooftop Run
hits.description:
Rooftop Run – Race Across the City! 🏃‍♂️💨

Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.

Controls:
Desktop: Hold the right mouse button and direct your movement.
Mobile: Use your finger to direct your movement.

Key Features:
• Only Forward: Run forward and only forward! Don't stop. You control only the direction of movement; everything else happens automatically. But don't think this will make it easy — you'll need to make decisions on the fly!
• Don't Get Caught by Enemies: They will try to grab you. Be faster and smarter!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: A true dynamic parkour experience! Run, jump from rooftop to rooftop, dive through skyscraper windows, roll, slide under obstacles, and run along walls! And of course, try not to get caught by enemies!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Try not to fall and avoid getting caught by enemies who will try to stop you!

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?
A: Insane dynamics! You run at high speed across rooftops, leap over obstacles, smash windows, roll, and at certain moments, you'll catch a stunning shot!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: Levels follow one after another, each presenting different obstacles in a variety of variations!

Q: Does the difficulty change?
A: Each subsequent level is harder than the previous one. You'll need to test your reflexes!

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization options?
A: Collect coins scattered throughout the levels to unlock various customization elements.

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not mandatory; play however you feel comfortable. However, turning it on will help you immerse yourself better in the dynamics.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?
A: At the start, you'll be shown everything essential. You'll immediately understand what to do.

hits.description: Play Cards in Fool – a strategic turn-based online card game! Outsmart opponents, make them draw cards, and climb the leaderboard. Flip cards, win matches, and earn points in this classic multiplayer challenge!
hits.howToPlayText: In the game of "Cards a Fool", the classic rules are that the one with the smaller trump card goes first. There are 36 cards in the deck. At the beginning, one trump card is selected, which determines the highest suit over all. The principle of the game is the same, First one goes with any card, the other must fight off with the highest of the same suit or a trump card. If the one who strayed then he walks and so on in turn. The winner is the one who has no cards left and the deck is empty. In the case when no one has any cards left, a draw is recognized, in this case no points are awarded or taken away. Track your score on the leaderboard.

hits.title: Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake
hits.description:
Join the enchanting world of Piece of Cake: Merge & Bake, an engaging game that combines puzzle-solving with café management. Explore a beautiful mansion, uncover family secrets, and help Emily grow her café into a culinary empire. Enjoy this unique experience for free on your phone or computer.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, drag items.
Mobile: Tap buttons, drag items with your finger.

Key Features:
• Expand your cooking table! : Combine ingredients and find matches on the table. Merge and expand your territory! This way, you can cook more masterpieces!
• Combine ingredients! : Want to create something more complex than a sandwich? Great! Combine ingredients to unlock increasingly complex dishes.
• Restore the café! : Restore the café and other areas with the money you earn. An incredibly engaging process where you’ll see progress at every stage!

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• 21 maps
• Café. : Your grandfather's café has fallen into disrepair. Why be sad when you can restore it and make it better than before? Get to work!
• Café facade. : You've done well inside the café, great! But the facade also needs repairs, it's time to work on that too!

Story / Setting:
You've come to your grandfather's café in the countryside. Unfortunately, it has long been abandoned. Once a popular spot, it's now your task to restore it and make it even better!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Revive your grandfather's café and breathe new life into its walls! Cook delicacies for visitors and develop your kitchen by unlocking new dishes!

Q: Is there a story?
A: You lived in a big city, but you had to return. Your grandfather had an old café, but sadly, it has fallen into disrepair. Help restore it and make it better than before! You will encounter new characters—delight them with your tasty treats!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?
A: Pleasant graphics, everything looks cozy and warm. It's especially satisfying to watch the progress of the café's reconstruction. With each amount earned, you can repair and upgrade your café and move on to other locations! With each new stage, you will see progress.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game features a total of 21 locations! You will restore them one by one, cooking food and drinks. Each location is unique with its own distinct style and theme.

Q: How can I level up faster?
A: Combine ingredients to get new ones. Expand your cooking table to hold more ingredients. Upgrade your kitchen tools to cook more efficiently!

Q: What unlocks as you progress?
A: As you play, you will expand your table, allowing you to accommodate more ingredients for cooking. You will also upgrade your kitchen setup, receiving new equipment. But you won't be limited to just the kitchen. New locations will unlock as you progress through the game!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can be bought/upgraded?
A: Upgrade the café and other locations. And don't forget about kitchen tools. With them, you can cook more delicious food!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: You start with an abandoned coffee shop and gradually, step by step, restore it. It's very engaging to watch life return to a once-popular place!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play anywhere and even without sound if that suits you better.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: From the first missions, the game will show you what to do and how to do it. Additionally, hints will guide you in moments where you might miss something. But don’t worry, you’ll understand everything quickly!
