hits.description:
Objective: Merge animal bubbles to create upgraded animals and ultimately achieve the final objective by collecting fully developed animals.
Gameplay Instructions:
Launching the Animal Bubbles:
Tap on an animal bubble to select it.
Drag the bubble backward to aim.
Release to launch the bubble in the opposite direction.
Merging Animal Bubbles:
When two identical animal bubbles collide, they merge to create an upgraded version.
Continue merging bubbles of the same type to progress.
Achieving the Objective:
Merge two basic-level animal bubbles to form an intermediate-level animal.
Merge intermediate-level animal bubbles to create the final full-fledged animal.
Once the final animal is created, it is automatically collected as part of the level objective.
Winning the Level:
The level is completed when you have successfully created and collected the required number of final animals.

Merge intermediate-level animal bubbles to create the final full-fledged animal.

The level is completed when you have successfully created and collected the required number of final animals.

hits.title: Dummies Football 2026
hits.description:
Get ready for an exciting football challenge with Dummies Football 2026, where you take command of a dummy representing your favorite national team. Immerse yourself in this captivating football game as you strive to score as many goals as possible before the final whistle. Choose from 32 national teams inspired by FIFA and engage in thrilling matches that will test your skills and strategies!

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on the buttons, drag the character.
Mobile: Tap the buttons, drag your finger.

Key Features:
• Dynamic matches: Drag your football player in different directions and try to hit the ball. Both the ball and the player can soar above the field and fall from great heights, perform flips, and score goals in the most unimaginable ways!
• Wide selection of countries: Play as your favorite team, switch them after or before the championship, and engage in unique matches!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Go for the football cup! Choose the country you want to play for and participate in the football championship. Progress through the stages and claim the cup!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Score more goals than your opponent within the allotted time while controlling your player.

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?
A: You can control your player's movements! Drag him in different directions and try to hit the ball to score against the opponent! You also have a wide selection of countries to play for.

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The championship consists of 8 stages. You will face different countries as opponents at each stage. Win and advance to the finals!

Q: Does the difficulty change?
A: With each new stage, losing a match becomes more perilous. If you lose, you will have to start the cup battle over! So prepare for the matches and win!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/improve?
A: Buy a freeze! A powerful bonus that gives you an advantage. You can freeze your opponent for a while. Use this to score as many goals as possible!

Q: Are there skins / customization?
A: Win matches and earn coins. You can use them to unlock skins for the ball!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: All countries are available to choose from right from the start! Play as whoever you want!

Retention & Engagement

Controls:
Desktop: WASD, arrow keys, click mouse to select an option, C to crouch.  
Mobile: built-in joystick, tap to select an option.

Game Modes:
• Graphics: Low: A less resource-intensive mode for the device, with fewer details, nuances, and volume in light-shadow rendering.  
• Graphics: High: A deeper contrast of light and shadow, more details, and greater load on the device.

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Buy cars and upgrade them to sell later. The higher the sales, the more opportunities arise. It's a great chance to showcase creativity by choosing designs and tuning, improve your online driving skills by maneuvering cars through the city without accidents, and develop the best sales strategy to expand your dealership.

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: What opens up as you progress in the game?  
A: As you play, more opportunities arise to purchase more expensive cars and parts. There’s always a chance to find a true rare gem of the automotive industry.

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: Lower the price when buying to maximize your profit from deals.

Economy & Customization  
Q: What is available from the very start?  
A: Buying your first car is easy! 7000 in-game dollars await you upon your first launch. Don’t forget to keep a little reserve for tuning.

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?  
A: The onboarding guides you through all the necessary scenarios, immersing you in the game in a careful and clear manner.

Q: Are there daily quests / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Complete quests and earn rewards in the form of in-game dollars to buy the most interesting cars faster.

hits.title: Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator
hits.description:
Dive into the exhilarating world of car crashes with the Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator. Perfect for those who love realistic car destruction and high-speed racing, this free online game is accessible on both mobile and PC. Prepare for an entertaining experience filled with destruction physics!

Controls:
Desktop: WASD — movement, right mouse button to click buttons, ZX — left and right turn signals. Mouse wheel — zoom in/out camera, left mouse button — rotate camera.
Mobile: Tap the buttons. Left/right buttons, accelerate forward, reverse.

Key Features:
• Realistic controls: The game features highly accurate controls, along with vehicle destructibility. Watch as cars crumple, tear apart, and explode into pieces!
• Create your own levels: If the basic maps aren't enough for you, create your own — you decide what will be on your map and how it will look!
• Choose your car: Pick the car you like and hit the road! Wonder how long your journey will be.

Game Modes:
• Classic mode: A classic mode where you can play on 8 ready-made maps and test the cars!
• Map Editor: A separate large world where you can create your own maps as your heart desires. Come up with your own challenges and obstacles or just create something unique.

Vehicles / Cars:
• Caro: A powerful muscle car. It will impress you with its speed and power. See how it withstands obstacles in its path!
• Flash: The futuristic electric car! Powerful and fast enough. Watch how it takes a hit!
• Syper: A sports car designed specifically for speed. Street racing is its forte, but how will it perform on the map? Find out!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Test the cars' durability by completing challenges, or create your own! It's your sandbox where you can play as you wish! Choose a car and go racing on the map! You can complete challenges or immediately destroy your car on the first obstacle! Watch as cars turn into heaps of metal, or try to keep them intact. The choice is yours!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: This is your sandbox where you set the rules. Destroy cars and enjoy watching them explode, or try to keep them whole!

Q: What grabs attention in the first minutes?
A: Realistic controls and driving physics allow for realistic scenarios. You can turn on the turn signal, honk, and even get out of the car or drive from a first-person perspective, witnessing all the chaos from inside! A wide selection of maps lets you play out numerous scenarios!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: There are 8 maps in the game, each differing in challenges and content. But if that's not enough, you can create your own map in the map editor! You're not limited in possible scenarios!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: Unlock new cars and test their durability! See how many challenges they can withstand.

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization?
A: Paint the cars in your desired color and see how they perform on the map!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Most cars in the game are available from the start. Begin your journey with the car you like!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not mandatory, but it can enhance the emotional experience!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it entail?
A: At the beginning of the game, you'll be taught how to control the car, and from the first seconds, you'll understand what to do!
hits.howToPlayText:
Driving/Walking/Flying - WASD
Right mouse button - Rotate camera
Space - Handbrake
C - Change camera
B - Look back
H - Horn
J - Hazard lights
Z - Left turn signal
X - Right turn signal

For mobile devices, use the in-game interface.

Your goal is to arrange all the cards into four piles according to suit: from Ace to King. Start with aces, then twos, threes, and so on until you reach the king.

On the game board, you can move cards between seven piles. You can only start a new pile with a king. You can place a card of a different color and one unit of lower value on a card in the stack. Groups of cards with alternating colors and ranks can be dragged between stacks, adding tactical depth.

You can review the deck an unlimited number of times, giving you the opportunity to carefully consider each move. The game ends when all the cards are neatly placed in piles.

Test your skills in this exciting solitaire card game and enjoy every victory!

hits.title: Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire
hits.description:
Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire is the classic one lower one higher solitaire you know and love. It sounds easy: just remove cards from the board one higher or lower than the next card in the deck.

But there's a whole other world behind these simple rules! The constantly changing locations and new cards on the board will keep you on your toes using new strategies. Don't expect to be an expert if you don't play for a couple weeks! The game sends you on a journey to a magical world and tells the story of an adventure across an enchanted land. Forests, mountains, seas and snowy peaks: get ready for a wild ride in Magic Tri Peaks Solitaire!

What makes our solitaire special:
Players can use different boosters on levels to give the game a special twist. Put any card from the board on a Joker. The Combo booster helps you get a five-card combo at the very start of a level, and Eye shows you what card is hiding at the top of the deck.
Start a new level and use the Sword to switch out a card from the deck with one you need. The Bow lets you remove any card from the board, the Fan shuffles cards and brings what you need to the top, and the Hammer flips over a portion of the hidden cards!

Features
♣️️ Hundreds of levels with new ones added all the time!
♦️ Different locations with fun original game mechanics!
♠️ Exciting battles against golems of different elements!
♥ Just lay out your cards in ascending or descending order!
♦️ Tons of different rewards and bonuses!
♣️ A fun game to boost your mood!
hits.howToPlayText: Select cards that are one higher or one lower in value than the card you drew to remove it from the board. To complete a level, you need to remove all cards from the playing field without running out of cards from your supply.

Explore six unique rooms, create family narratives, and enjoy activities like cooking and gardening. Play for **free** on your phone or computer and craft your ideal virtual family experience.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, move items and characters with the mouse.
Mobile: Tap on buttons, move items and characters with your finger.

Key Features:
• Endless possibilities: You have an entire house at your disposal! Play out your stories and interact with the environment. Cook in the spacious kitchen, turn on the TV, and much more!
• Your sandbox: The game doesn't limit your creativity! Create your own plots and come up with unique stories!
• Mini-games: Play various mini-games to earn a little extra! Wash the teddy bear or pop the right balloons, and much more. This adds variety to your experience!

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• You have access to a large two-story house with different locations!
• Kitchen: A big kitchen with a large table and a smaller one just for kids! Plenty of space to cook delicious meals. A wonderful place for a big family!

Story / Setting:
You are the author of your own story. Create tales and bring them to life in the game!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: You have an entire house at your disposal! Choose a family to live here. Play out your stories, cook meals, play in the backyard, tend to plants, and much more. Play mini-games to earn some extra and buy something!

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: In the game, you are the author of your own story. Create tales in a large house where everyone can find their place!

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?
A: The large interactivity in the house. Turn on the computer, bake something in the oven, make smoothies, change outfits, and much more. Combined with character selection and the ability to role-play your stories, your plots can become much more vivid!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game features one large two-story house. It has children's rooms, a parents' room, a bathroom, a kitchen, a backyard, and other locations. You have plenty of space to explore your ideas!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: As you progress, you will unlock new mini-games and characters for your stories!

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization options?
A: You can change the clothing for your characters. Choose the right outfit for your story!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Most activities in the game are available from the very beginning. You can start your story without restrictions! Plant flowers, choose outfits. At the start, you have access to 2 mini-games: pop the right balloons and wash the teddy bear!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily challenges / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?
A: A robot vacuum moves around the house. It carries a wheel of fortune! Take advantage of the moment and try your luck to win prizes!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not required, but it can immerse you in the atmosphere of home life!

Q: What achievements are there and how can they be earned?
A: Collect cards! By collecting cards, you can gather all the pieces for a family album. It's always nice to enjoy good moments!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?

hits.title: Popping Candies
hits.description: Popping Candies is an exhilarating puzzle game where you can match and crush candies to achieve various objectives. Play online for free without downloading and immerse yourself in the vibrant and colorful world of candy matching. This game offers a delightful escape into a realm filled with exciting challenges, engaging gameplay, and a visually pleasing environment. As you swap adjacent candies to form rows of three or more, you'll clear them from the board and create space for more strategic moves. With the potential to create special candies like striped, wrapped, or color bombs, Popping Candies keeps you on your toes with its dynamic puzzle mechanics. Overcome obstacles such as chocolate and blockers while completing each level’s unique tasks. The catch? Your moves are limited, so plan carefully. Use boosters for extra help and advance through challenging levels to unlock new stages. Whether you're on iOS, Android, or desktop, Popping Candies offers a seamless gaming experience across all platforms, making it a perfect match for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers alike.
hits.howToPlayText:
Objective: The main goal is to match and crush candies to complete specific objectives within a limited number of moves.

Matching Candies: Players can swap adjacent candies to create a row or column of three or more matching candies. This will make them disappear and score points.

Objectives: Each level has its own objectives, such as reaching a certain score, collecting specific candies, or clearing jelly. Players must complete these tasks to progress.

Special Candies:

Striped Candies: Made by matching four candies in a row; they clear an entire row or column when matched.
Wrapped Candies: Made by matching five candies in a T or L shape; they explode and clear surrounding candies.
Color Bombs: Created by matching five candies of the same color; they clear all candies of that color when combined with any candy.
Obstacles: Some levels include obstacles like chocolate, jelly, and blockers that players must clear to achieve their objectives.

Moves and Lives: Players have a limited number of moves to complete a level. If they run out of moves, they lose a life. Players start with five lives and can earn more over time or purchase them.

Boosters: Players can use boosters to gain advantages, such as extra moves, special candy combinations, or clearing obstacles.

Progression: Successfully completing levels allows players to advance through the map, unlocking new levels and challenges.

Get ready for an Epic Puzzle adventure like no other! Daddy Escape - Pull the Pin is here to challenge your wits, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills. Help Daddy make his daring escape by pulling the right pins and overcoming a series of mind-bending obstacles.

Who is Daddy? Well, he's not your ordinary dad! Daddy is an adventurous and fearless explorer who always finds himself in tricky situations. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to guide Daddy through a maze of perilous traps, ingenious contraptions, and devious puzzles. Can you lead Daddy to safety?
hits.howToPlayText:
Your goal is to safely navigate Daddy through each level to the exit door. 
But beware, there are pins blocking his way!
Tap and pull the pins in the right order to clear a path for Daddy.
Use your cunning to avoid traps, outsmart enemies, and collect valuable treasures along the way.
